The proposed scheme jointly exploits the Comb-DMRS and the adjacent DMRS for frequency offset estimation, and improves the estimation precision. Meanwhile, tracking algorithm is used to improve the robustness. We refer to this scheme as joint double pilot (JDP) estimation scheme. The simulation results show that, the scheme proposed in this paper has lower complexity and the best effect comparing with other estimation schemes in different speed environments.

articleTitle: A novel HT-TBD detection approach for near-space target
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Near-space target detection is usually difficult for radar due to this kind of target's characteristics of hypersonic velocity and weak echoes. A novel detection approach is proposed by employing Hough transform track-before-detect (HT-TBD) technique based on grading and dimensionality reduction mechanism. Firstly, in order to solve huge computational load problem of traditional three-dimensional Hough transform, three-dimensional points are mapped into range-time plane, azimuth-time plane and elevation-time plane successively for three corresponding two-dimensional Hough transforms. Then, a new double integration means of noncoherent integration and binary integration is adopted in parameter space to select points in every stage orderly, which could make full use of energy information and decrease impact from strong interference at the same time. Finally, motion constraints and trajectory merging are introduced to further reduce detected false trajectories after sequence association for detected points. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed approach.

articleTitle: Distributed power allocation for cooperative localization: A potential game approach
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the availability of position information is a critical problem for many commercial and military applications. Network cooperation between agents can improve the localization accuracy but the power consumption will increase at the same time. Then the optimal trade-off between localization accuracy and power consumption for cooperation is a challenging task. In this paper, we investigate the problem of distributed power allocation for cooperative localization in WSNs localization systems, using a potential game approach. First, we propose a local altruistic power allocation game, in which each agent not only consider localization accuracy and power consumption of itself but also localization accuracy of its neighbors. Then, we prove that the proposed game is an exact potential game with at least one pure Nash equilibrium (NE). Moreover, the ε-equilibrium solution as a refinement of NE can be reached by better response dynamics. Numerical results show that the proposed strategies can give an instructional trade-off between power consumption and localization accuracy for cooperation.

articleTitle: Modelling an IoT testbed in context with the security vulnerabilities of South Africa
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is envisaged as a transformative approach that provides any service over the Internet by enabling communications through the interconnection of heterogeneous devices. The potential threats and possible attacks against IoT devices have grown drastically and the cybercrime statistics from the South African Banking Risk Information Centre (SABRIC) shows that South Africans lose in excess of R2.2 billion due to the security vulnerabilities annually. Unfortunately, the security requirements are not yet well addressed as it is still in its infant stage. Therefore, before there is a widespread adoption of IoT, there needs to be stringent security and reliability in the IoT space. The proposed research aims to close this gap through the implementation of a user-centric and automated IoT testbed in context with a setting that is close to the real-world South African environment to address the specific IoT vulnerabilities in the country. Because of the limited amount of work performed so far in this field of study, this research will not only contribute in filling the missing gap in the area of IoT security vulnerabilities, but will also contribute towards a better understanding of the subject matter and uptake of the IoT technology.

articleTitle: An X-band 6-bits highly-accurate digital-stepped phase shifter MMIC for phased array system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents an X-band 6-bits highly-accurate digital-stepped phase shifter MMIC for phased array system. The proposed phase shifter employs high-pass/low-pass filter topology and an improved embedded device type topology to realize 64 states of uniform phase shift and reduce insertion loss at the same time. The MMIC is fabricated using 0.25umGaAs process. It has a maximum phase shift range of 354.375 ° with 5.625 ° steps. The proposed phase shifter exhibits RMS phase error of less than 1.5 °, and RMS amplitude error of less than 0.27 dB at 8-12 GHz. The insertion loss is 6.4 dB at10 GHz. The input 1-dB compression point is 29 dBm at 10 GHz, and the total chip size, including pads, is 2.5 × 1.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: A closed-form power control algorithm in cognitive radio networks based on Nash bargaining solution
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a power control algorithm based on Nash bargaining solution (NBS) in cooperative game is proposed for cognitive radio networks (CRNs). The uplink power control problem under interference power constraint (IPC) in cognitive networks for two users' case is considered from both non-cooperative game and cooperative game. A signal-to-interference plus noise (SINR) utility function is proposed for the cooperative power control game. Based on NBS, a close-form expression of the power control algorithm is derived for the CRNs. Simulation results show that the proposed power control algorithm based on NBS achieves an effective tradeoff between the fairness and the efficiency.

articleTitle: Capacity analysis based on channel measurements of massive MU-MIMO System at 3.5 GHz
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is considered as one of the promising fifth Generation (5G) technologies, one of its key properties is the favorable propagation condition which describes mutual orthogonality among channels to different users. In this paper, we investigate to what extent the favorable condition can be realized by increasing the number of transmitting antennas (Tx) to 256 in a practical Urban Macro (UMa) scenario based on channel measurements at 3.5 GHz. Multi-user MIMO (MU-MIMO) capacity based on the zero forcing block diagonalized (ZFBD) scheme is evaluated, and the results are compared to the independent identically distributed (i.i.d.) channel. The performance improvements are found to decelerate at 64 Tx and certain gap from i.i.d. channel remains for all cases. The eigenvalue distributions of the composed two users' channel matrix are then checked, and very limited decorrelation of the users' sub-channels is observed. Finally, we consider number growths of receiving antennas (Rx) and numerical results indicate that the capacity gain is dependent on the scenario conditions and the antenna configurations at both Rx and Tx sides, although sustained growths are observed. Therefore, the full gain of favorable propagation is not entirely achieved in our measured practical channel environment.

articleTitle: A detecting method for malicious mobile application based on incremental SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the rapid growth of android malicious application samples, traditional detection methods need to spend a lot of time for training, a detecting method for malicious mobile application based on incremental SVM was proposed to achieve incremental learning of the detection system. The method used the SVM as the classification and training algorithm, and extracted sensitive permissions and APIs as application characteristics. On the basis of SVM, a dual weight function was designed to filter the historical training samples to avoid redundant samples, and the incremental learning method of SVM was implemented in combination with KKT conditions. Therefore, the training time could be reduced and the learning efficiency of the malicious application detection system could be improved without reducing the training accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and application of grey neural network in equipment life prediction
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The forecasting of equipment life prediction is one of the important work of equipment maitainability support. This paper built Grey Neural Network (GNN) combination prediction model which combined grey theory and BP neural network. The fluctuation of data sequence is weakened by the gray theory and the neural network is capable of processing non-linear adaptable information, and the GNN model is a combination of those advantages. This paper forecasted some equipment electronic equipment failure time by three grey models and GNN model. The result indicates that GNN model is better than grey model, and that it is a practical prediction method of high precision.

articleTitle: Hybrid key management scheme for preventing man-in-middle attack in heterogeneous sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of Internet of things technology which considerably contributed to the research of heterogeneous sensor networks (HWSNs), the design of key management schemes and protocols is one of the most important aspects of HWSNs research. Besides, the key management in HWSNs meets many new challenges due to its intrinsic properties. In this paper, a hybrid key management scheme (NHKM) based on ECC and symmetric cryptosystem, achieving authentication of the node's public key by using certificates and nonce signature, can well prevent man-in-middle (MIM) attack. The simulation results show the overall effectiveness of the NHKM scheme, revealing better performance in terms of network connectivity, resource cost, scalability and resilience.

articleTitle: An image similarity measure based on joint histogram — Entropy for face recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Face recognition has become practically applied in many places such as airports, pay money and many other purposes. In this paper, we will address this hot topic by using the principles of information theory in the face recognition. Taneja entropy measure used in this paper and combination it with the joint histogram of two images under test. Two of the most popular face databases used in this paper are FEI and ORL show that the proposed measure outperforms existing measures.

articleTitle: Some improvements to logistic map for chaotic signal generator
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Chaotic sequences are widely used in spread spectrum communication, image or video processing and security communication for its properties, high sensitivity to initial value, pseudorandom, and etc. Generally, chaotic sequences are generated based on some chaotic map, such as logistic map. While, logistic map has a limited range parameter and symmetry distribution, which is not convenient and secure sin practical use. So, in this paper, some improvements are made to the logistic map, and its parameter range is greatly extended as well as its distribution is converted to uniform distribution, which is very useful for chaotic signal generator.

articleTitle: Labeled box-particle PHD filter for multi-target tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In multi-target tracking, complex data association problem can be avoided by box-particle filter (box-PF, BPF) based on random finite set (RFS), which reaches similar accuracy results with much considerably less computational costs compared to standard particle filter. However, the BPF based on RFS does not provide identities of individual target state estimates. In this paper, labeled box-particle filter (labeled box-PF filter, LBP) is proposed and its realization for PHD filter is developed in detail, which add a label to each box-particle to record the target identity. It can achieve track management while filtering. The effectiveness and reliability of the proposed algorithm are verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Joint DOA and frequency estimation with sub-Nyquist sampling based on trilinear decomposition and SVD
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the previous work for joint Direction-Of-Arrival (DOA) and frequency estimation with sub-Nyquist sampling, algorithm JDFTD has a superior estimation performance. However, the computational burden increases with the snapshot for iterative operation. In this paper, singular value decomposition (SVD) is employed to eliminate the effect of snapshot and a new version of algorithm JDFTD based on SVD (SVD-JDFTD) is proposed. Numerical simulations verify that SVD-JDFTD reduces the computational burden without loss the superior estimation performance of JDFTD.

articleTitle: A fast, affordable and extensible FPGA-based synthetic Ethernet traffic generator for network evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Development of widespread high-speed networks accelerates the research of Ethernet test, for which testing new algorithm is important. As a result, generating traffic is indispensable to hardware test, which may contain some feature such as number of TCP or UDP flows, payload content of frames and packet sizes. When data rate of traffic aims to the level of Gb/s, this task cannot be finished only with PC, which work by Linux kernel. Even though there are some hardware achievement for this task, they are some expensive and not affordable for daily research of network evaluation. We propose a solution in this paper and describe an affordable implementation of Ethernet traffic generator for network evaluation which is FPGA-based and work in rate of 10 Gb/s with a operation interface designed in software to upper computer. The design is affordable because of it can work on a board including a 10GbE interface and an FPGA chip, which is very easy to get and can accurately configure by upper computer.

articleTitle: Broadband microstrip line directional coupler with high directivity and small size
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A compact directional coupler with high directivity is presented in this paper. The coupling passbands characteristics of the multi-sections coupler which cascades two coupled lines via transmission line are analyzed. In addition, asymmetric coupled line and stepped impedance matching method are used to generate the isolation zero. A 1.9 GHz coupler is designed and implemented. The 3 dB BW of the coupling is from 0.93 GHz to 2.83 GHz with the corresponding FBW of 100%, and the directivity is better than 20 dB from 0.5 GHz to 3.0 GHz. The proposed coupler presents small size and excellent directivity compared with the traditional parallel coupled line coupler. Good agreement is achieved between measured and simulated results.

articleTitle: Rethinking intelligent transportation systems with Internet of Vehicles: Proposition of sensing as a service model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Modern vehicles are characterized by the massive incorporation of all types of sensors. However, sensor usage is often limited to the vehicle itself or at most a few basic applications on VANET. A good sensor system is a prerequisite for a successful integration of intelligence functions in vehicles and thus helps ITS to best reduce the monopoly of the human operator on transport systems. In this paper, we propose to model an Intelligent Vehicular Sensor Network (IVSN) from four types of awareness: spatial awareness, data awareness, group awareness and context awareness. This intelligence is fully exploited in developing the proposed Sensing as a Service (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>aaS) model for Internet of Vehicles. This model transforms raw data from vehicle sensors to real knowledge which cannot be produced if such data were processed individually. Roles and interaction description between different S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>aaS actors/entities is given to understanding the proposed model. Sensing resource discovery, ranking and selection techniques adapted for IoV are also integrated in this model. In the end, performance evaluation of the proposed pull request to obtain data from specific sensors is given.

articleTitle: Optimization and implementation of industrial control system network intrusion detection by telemetry analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Industrial control systems (ICS) are related to all aspects of human life and have become the target of many cyber-attackers. Attacks on industrial control systems may not only cause monetary loss, but also damage equipment, the environment and hurt staff, such as the Stuxnet and the cyber attack on the Ukrainian power grid. So the intrusion detection of ICS has a great significance. This paper based on the intrusion detection by telemetry analysis, optimized the system model, captured the communication packets between different nodes in the system, then extracted features for machine learning to achieve malicious traffic detection, and the attack types are further distinguished. Telemetry means that it does not need to enter the industrial control system network, but by capturing data packets remotely to achieve intrusion detection.

articleTitle: A hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the the poor local search capability of Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) algorithm, a hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the population is initialized by tent chaotic map to improve the diversity of the initial population. In the evolution process, the tabu search strategy is adopted to improve algorithm convergence rate. Combining the chaos optimization strategy, this algorithm could jump out of local optimization and improve the local search ability. The simulation results of constrained optimization problems are reported and compared with the typical PSO algorithm. Simulation results show that this algorithm could effectively avoid local optimization, have good global search ability and local search ability.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor data fusion system based on Apache Storm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of Internet of Things and multi-sensor data fusion technology, traditional off-line data processing methods have been unable to deal with massive data, which leads to a loss in timeliness of data. As more and more well-known companies start to focus on real-time big data applications, some computing frameworks have developed rapidly, in which Apache Storm is the most representative open-source, distributed one due to its high reliability and good processing mode. In this paper, a multi-sensor data fusion system that combines classical data fusion algorithms with Storm architecture is proposed, to achieve real-time streaming data processing. Data fusion process is split into functional modules according to the feature of Storm. Extensive experiment results show that these algorithms can achieve better performance of data fusion in a short delay.

articleTitle: Adaptive compressive data gathering for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Compressive sensing (CS) based data gathering is a promising approach to reduce data sampling and transmission in wireless sensor networks and thus prolong WSN's lifetime. The physical phenomena are generally nonstationary and thus the sparsity of sensing data varies in temporal and spatial domain. In order to guarantee the reconstruction accuracy with lower energy cost due to the variation of sensing data, this paper proposes an adaptive compressive data gathering scheme containing adaptive measurement and reconstruction. The adaptive measurement is that the number of measurements is tuned adaptively according to the prediction of the change trend of the sensing data. The adaptive reconstruction is based on the Stagewise Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (StOMP) algorithm and using the Proportional-Integrative-Derivative (PID) method to adaptively guarantee the reconstruction accuracy. At last, an adaptive compressive data gathering system is built on Crossbow Micaz WSN platform. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme can ensure reconstruction accuracy with low energy cost.

articleTitle: Visual saliency detection based on adaptive fusion of color and texture features
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Visual saliency detection achieved excellent performance in various fields such as object detection, image compression, and image retrieval. However, most existing methods for visual saliency detection only considered low-level features, ignored higher-level priors, and the fusion mechanism was simple. A novel visual saliency detection model based on color and texture adaptive fusion was proposed in this paper. On the basis of image preprocessing, the proposed method extracted color saliency map through color contrast feature and color distribution feature fusion, and texture saliency map through texture feature. Then they were fused adaptively according to the texture complexity of each image. The final saliency map was obtained by incorporating location prior. Experimental results on MSRA (1000) dataset demonstrated that the proposed visual saliency detection model outperformed the existing methods.

articleTitle: An optimal fair resource allocation strategy for a lightweight content-centric networking architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Content-Centric Network (CCN) is promising to rebuild the network to resolve shortage of network resources. CCN promotes ubiquitous caching in each router to enhance content delivery around the concept of content, thus the router can store the content with high popularity. In this paper, we focus on building a lightweight CCN network framework with good scalability. We innovatively put forward to a method, which combines the hit rate, average delay and the equity of resource allocation to measure the performance of the network architecture. First, we draw up this problem as a content placement problem and control content fair distribution through weight. Then we propose a heuristic algorithm with threshold to allocate resource reasonably. In comparison with ProbCache and greedy, the heuristic algorithm has better and more stable performance in the hit rate, delay as well as equity. Simulation results show that the model and algorithm is available and effective.

articleTitle: Multi-functional serial communication interface design based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI), Inter-Integrated Circuit (IIC) and Electronic Industry Association Recommended Standard-232 (EIA-RS-232) are universal serial communication interfaces, which have different communication protocols. Respective environment and conditions are applicable to each of them. This paper firstly introduces the structure and working principle of the three kinds of serial interface, compares the similarities and differences of them, also analyzes their respective time sequences and communication protocols. Then use the verilog hardware description language to design a multi-function serial interface can be controlled flexibly, which realize the function of the three interfaces respectively. Finally through the simulation the paper get the simulation waveforms. And according to the simulation waveform analysis, the design of the function of the module is proved to be correct. Furthermore, when realized the multi-function serial interface in the FPGA platform, it may saves a number of hardware resources compared with the three independent serial communication interfaces.

articleTitle: A deep network architecture for image inpainting
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A number of artworks have been damaged to some extent, over time, which greatly affect their visual quality. Therefore, it's a very valuable and meaningful work to repair them. We proposed a deep network architecture — Image Inpainting Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (II-CGAN) to address this problem. Based on the deep convolutional neural network (CNN), we directly learn the mapping relationship between the damaged and repaired image detail layers from data. Since the intact image corresponding to the real-world damaged image is not available, we synthesize images with lost blocks for training. To minimize the lost of information and ensure better visual quality, a new refined network architecture is introduced. We made a thorough evaluation of the Generator of increased depth(22 layers) using an architecture with the units consisting of 3 × 3 and 4 χ 4 convolution filters, and the Discriminator with small(3 χ 3) convolution kernel used instead of 4 χ 4 in all convolution filters. Experiments results prove that the method in this paper achieves better objective and subjective performance.

articleTitle: Single fog image restoration via multi-scale image fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The captured images and videos in bad weather usually have degraded quality by reduced contrast and faded colors, and is very difficult to achieve promising performance. The traditional prior techniques are not sufficient to address this challenging problem to deal with the halo artifacts and brightness distortion problems. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale fusion method for single fog image restoration. By creating two divided regions, the global atmospheric light can be effectively obtained in the sky regions. To properly optimize the transmission, our method is designed in a new Kirsch operators with adaptive boundary constraint. With a new multi-scale image fusion method, we can effectively remove and fuse the haze from these images. The proposed method reduces the halo artifacts by adaptively limiting the boundary of an arbitrary haze image. A new multi-scale image fusion method for single image dehazing has also been proposed to produce a more nature visual recovery effect. Experimental results show that this method outperforms state-of-the-art haze removal methods in terms of both efficiency and the dehazing visual effect.

articleTitle: An improved inter-cluster multi-hop LEACH protocol oriented reliable transmission in WSNs
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the problems of the degradation of data transmission reliability and the loss of important data caused by electromagnetic interference, environmental noise and node failure in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), an improved LEACH protocol based on the differentiated service model is presented. In this protocol, the gathered data are divided into different transmission levels according to the importance of the data; when the data are forwarded by the source cluster head node, the communication links between the cluster head node and the sink node are increased with the increase of the level of data; for the data with high level, the several redundant links with multi-hops are used to ensure packets to reach the sink node, and for the data with low level, the transmission strategy with low energy consumption is adopted to transmit data packets so as to realize the balance between the energy consumption and transmission reliability in WSNs. The simulation results show that this scheme can obviously improve the transmission reliability of the important data and additional network overhead is not obvious owing to the low occurrence probability of a monitoring event. Compared to the other three protocols, this protocol has better performance, which is very suitable for the application with the requirement for high reliability in data transmission in WSNs.

articleTitle: A model based on genetic algorithm for service chain resource allocation in NFV
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In traditional network, network functions are implemented by proprietary hardware. Its deployment, update and upgrade are complicated and costly. With the rapid growth of the number of end users and Internet services' diversification recently, it is a huge challenge for operators to deliver network services. In recent years, the emergence of Network Function Virtualization technology effectively alleviates this problem. However, the problem of resource allocation for service chains comes up successively. This paper presents an effective model on resource scheduling for service chain, and aims to explore a user-friendly Pareto optimal target. The probability of nodes' breakdown is also concerned. An improved genetic algorithm is used to search the best scheduling result. The model is proved to be effective by measuring the last service completion time and compute performance in simulations.

articleTitle: Modifying broker policy for better response time in datacenters
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cloud computing is an area that is rapidly gaining popularity in both academia and industry. Service broker controls the traffic routing between user bases and data centers based on different service broker policies. Service proximity based routing policy selects closest data center to route the user request. If there are more than one data centers within the same region, it is selected randomly without considering the workload, cost, processing time or other parameters. Randomly selected data center is prone to give unsatisfactory results. In this work, we propose modifying that policy by applying new schedule algorithm that can improve the time response, control the load balance. The evaluation is based on the Cloud Analyst, and the results verified the effectiveness of our proposal that can reduce the response time and the average processing time.

articleTitle: Electronic image stabilization algorithm based on smoothing 3D rotation matrix
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the camera shooting process, video jitter caused by camera motion results to instability of the image information and the fuzzy which is not conducive for people to observe, and reduces the compression ratio. To solve this problem, we propose an electronic image stabilization algorithm using 3D rotational motion model. 3D camera motion is calculated from image sequence. The image can be mapped on the virtual sphere where the optical center of the camera is in the sphere center. We match the feature points using optical flow method, and then calculate rotation matrix using Spherical SFM algorithm between previous and current frame image. The rotation matrix contains the rotation and translation of the camera. The motion trajectory of the camera can be expressed by the 3D rotation matrix sequence. We adopt the manifold structure of the rotation matrices sequence, and we smooth the 3D rotation matrix sequences based on geodesic distance on a non-linear manifold. We formulate the video stabilization problem as objective function of smoothed rotation, and use steepest gradient descent and Armijo rules to estimate the smoothed rotation. Finally, the current frame is compensated by calculating the difference between the smoothed path and the original path to suppress the influence of the camera translation on the obtained rotation matrix. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed algorithm does can effectively reduce random jitter without special hardware, which achieved the effect of image stabilization. Compared to the image stabilization algorithm based on 2D model, the proposed image stabilization algorithm greatly reduced the jitter and image distortion.

articleTitle: Research on unified information model for big data analysis of power grid equipment monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the integration of power grid developing further, some demand such as power grid analyses decisions centrally has become more and more urgent. At present, the information resources for the use of Power grid equipment monitoring analysis is becoming abundant, but these information, which exists in every professional system independently, is lack of connection and meets the demand of big data analysis on power equipment monitoring hardly. In this paper, a unified information model, modeled by IEC61970 common information model and IEC61850 hierarchical model, is proposed for the analysis of big data monitoring in power grid equipment, which can establish the first and second Equipment Association within the scope of the grid equipment monitoring data, as well as realize centralized access to all measurement information in the method of extending measurement model. This is significant to promote the process of deepening application of power grid equipment monitoring.

articleTitle: A novel one-bit feedback collaborative beamforming algorithm using two time slots
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Collaborative beamforming is an effective approach when transmitting common message to a relatively distant destination. In collaborative beamforming, it is necessary to compensate the unknown phase offset for the phase alignment at the receiver. We introduce a new method for the one-bit feedback collaborative beamforming scheme to achieve the phase alignment. The receiver feeds back one bit at each time slot, but the transmitters exploit two successive feedback bits, including the current and last feedback bits, to make decision. The algorithm can adjust the step of random perturbation and the size of directional factor accordingly. The results show that less time slots are required to achieve the phase alignment and the convergence speed is improved greatly.

articleTitle: Research and improvement of a multi-pattern matching algorithm based on double hash
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Multi-pattern matching is a matching algorithm that searches multiple pattern parallel in the given text. According to problems of the existing multi-pattern matching algorithm, the paper puts forward a multi-pattern matching algorithm based on double hash. The improved algorithm could reduce the number of comparison each matching by two hashes, whose hash table used to store patterns is a two-dimensional array of pointers. Each node represents head node of a single list in the two-dimensional array, all nodes of a single list with the same length and prefix hash of pattern string. Through the hash physical structure, text substring needs also two hashes in each matching to find the corresponding hash. It needs complete matching if finding node with the same value of hash of two times in this physical structure. Otherwise, the matching pointer of text string moves to the right quickly by jump distance of BM2 algorithm based on the multi-pattern strings. The experiment shows that the time performance of TH_MPMA algorithm is better than that of AC_BM2 algorithm under the same test environment.

articleTitle: Adaptive digital predistorter with improving feedback signal distortion over-compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a method for improving feedback signal distortion over-compensation of a digital pre-distortion(DPD) system is presented. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a distortion compensation characteristic parameter of an input signal in a forward channel of the digital pre-distortion system to form a forward channel distortion compensation lookup table(LUT), and compensating the input signal before digit-analog converter (DAC); acquiring an ideal compensation characteristic parameter of the input signal in a small closed loop without power amplification to form a feedback signal distortion compensation LUT for compensating in a feedback signal; and acquiring an ideal compensation characteristic parameter of the input signal in a big closed loop with power amplification to form a digital pre-distortion LUT dealing with power amplification non-linear distortion for compensating in the forward signal. Through the method, the over-compensation characteristic of the feedback signal can be further effectively counter balanced based on compensation to forward channel distortion to achieve the aim of improving the performance of the digital pre-distortion system.

articleTitle: A neural computation approach to model predictive control with hybrid constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: High computational burden in solving the quadratic programming problems associated with model predictive control is a major burden in industrial process. The neurodynamic optimization method has many advantages in solving optimization problems. In this paper, in order to reduce the optimization problem online calculation and calculation time, we apply a neural computation approach to solve an optimization problem which is associated with a hybrid-constrained predictive control problem. Numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Broadcast and multicast in the sector of several verticals-an evaluation of the current status
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In times of rare spectrum our generation has to think if it is useful that every service has its own spectrum. PMSE, broadcast and BOS services use different frequencies and methods to solve the current situation. Because of the upcoming 5G standard the question arises if mobile communication can support the other services or even at the end if there can be one platform for all services and which can use all frequency bands with the newest technologies. In this paper we are focusing on the broadcasting and PMSE services. There are two projects which are dealing with this task. Simulations, measurements and analysis are made if 5G can be a platform for all the mentioned services. The focus is on the unicast and multicast, as well as SISO and SIMO transmission modes. A simulator, which is implemented in matlab, is used as simulation tool. The simulation results are presented in dependence of bit error rate over the signal to noise ratio. This allows a qualitative statement about the receiving quality.

articleTitle: Research on individualized recommendation algorithm for Tibetan micro-blog
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Individualized recommendation is one of the hot spots of social media research currently. This paper has proposed a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on community discovery and applies it to Tibetan micro-blog. We should carry out community discovery by using the actual user behavior, find the user group with different preferences in the group, carry out interest differentiation by relying on community discovery and find the content recommendation of corresponding individual based on the community discovery result. It has achieved certain effect in the actual data set.

articleTitle: The research of intelligent overall design factor model analysing and constructing in thematic maps
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Not only every segment of intelligent overall design has to be analysed and researched independently but also there is restricted and affected relationship among the segments of the thematic maps intelligent design in the definitive functional requirement. For analyzing the relationship, this article has defined the concept of the intelligent overall design of the thematic map, designed the experiments constructing the model of intelligent overall design based the tool of SPSS, and testified the rationality of the model by the experiments.

articleTitle: An efficient priority-based polling scheme for wireless local area network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Quality of service (QoS) support is a key attribute for wireless local area networks (WLAN) but is limited in 802.11-based wireless LANs. Based on the IEEE802.11 standard, we present an efficient priority-based polling scheme for WLAN. It becomes increasingly important to support delay-based quality of service in such WLANs. The new scheme differentiates priorities by various access policies which uses exhaustive service for the central station and gated service for ordinary stations. The mathematical model of the new system was set up by method of embedded Markov chain theory and generating function. Then the key system performance characteristics including mean queue length, query cycle and throughput are explicitly analyzed. Simulation and theoretical results are identical and show that the new system efficiently meets the practical demands of priority-based applications well in WLAN.

articleTitle: Data path profiling for network virtualization
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The complicated network requirements of cloud computing service requests to choose the viable way to offer better performance. In order to leverage the virtualized I/O resource, especially network resource, we need to understand the network virtualization techniques and choose the proper way to establish the service avoiding respective limitations. This paper elaborates and benchmarks the mainstreaming I/O virtualization methodologies including device emulation, split-driver model and hardware assisted model, and conducts some implications for potential scenario.

articleTitle: Research on power demand response of smart home control system based on association rules algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to realize the Power Demand Response of residents, this paper designs the smart-home appliance demand management system based on intelligent gateway, and using Apriori algorithm to tap the user's association rules, and through the data preprocessing according to the peak-flat-valley period of the demand response, so that the algorithm can process the time information in the data, and finally realized the association rules mining for the residents' usage habits. Finally, a demand response control scheme based on association rules is proposed, which provides a theoretical basis for the real-time response of the user side.

articleTitle: Secure assignment strategy of virtual machines based on operating system diversity
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The co-resident attack across virtual machines is a serious security challenge to the resource sharing mechanism in cloud computing. The existing defensive solutions, mainly aiming at improving the isolation and dynamics of virtual machines, require modification of the monitor or frequent migration of virtual machines, which are hard to be deployed in large scale scenarios. Considering the strong dependence of co-resident attacks on the type of operating system, a diversified assignment strategy of operating systems for virtual machines is proposed to mitigate the attack by increasing the cost of attackers. Specifically, a diversified operating system mapping model is proposed, and an interactive workflow process is established between the user and the cloud service provider. The simulation results show that the proposed method can reduce the attack efficiency by at least 33.46%, which provides more security guarantee for the cloud environment when compared with the assignment strategy of single operating system.

articleTitle: A simultaneous-alternate relaying scheme for the two-cell two-hop MIMO X channel with shared relays
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We consider a two-cell two-hop X channel, where each of the two base stations sends an independent message to each of the two mobile stations via two half-duplex relays. It is assumed that each of the base stations and mobile stations has M antennas while each relay is equipped with N antennas. In this channel, the previously known upper bounds on the degrees of freedom (DoF) are characterized based on the alternate relaying and simultaneous relaying, respectively. In this paper, we establish a new DoF upper bound based on the simultaneous-alternate relaying, which provides superior DoF gain over the derived upper bounds of the alternate relaying and simultaneous relaying for the case of 3/2 < N/M < 8/3. Furthermore, an achievable scheme is provided to reach the DoF upper bound of the simultaneous-alternate relaying.

articleTitle: A simple and effective attack against an authenticaion protocol for RFID systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Authentication protocol is of great importance to ensure the security and privacy of users for RFID systems. In this paper, a lightweight authentication protocol for RFID systems was reviewed and a simple and effective attack was found. To launch the attack, an attacker only needs a rogue reader and sends a number of random values to a target tag. Then the tag will go on updating its state until it cannot be recognized by its server. Subsequently, the attacker repeats the attack to other tags, and he will paralyze the RFID system eventually. Finally, a countermeasure to fix the flaw was presented.

articleTitle: Executing real-time programs on negative-AND flash memory considering read disturb errors
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: NAND flash memory is widely used in embedded systems domain due to its non-volatility, low-power consumption, high degree of integration, and shock resistance. However, NAND flash memory only supports page-base read/write operations, to execute program codes from NAND flash memory, RAM whose per-byte price is much higher than that of NAND flash memory is essential. For the cost efficiency, there are researches for minimizing required RAM size to execute real-time tasks. However, since they do not consider read disturb errors, they have a limitation in terms of reliability. Therefore, in this paper, we propose an approach to execute hard real-time tasks on NAND flash memory with minimal RAM size while considering read disturb errors. The suggested approach requires 40% less RAM pages than Shadowing approach, and 36% more RAM pages than HRT-PLRU approach.

articleTitle: Cross-modal retrieval based on deep correlated network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The rapid development of deep learning provides opportunities for exploring cross-modal retrieval from a semantic perspective. How to exploit correlations of multimodal data which are heterogeneous in an unsupervised way is a challenging task. Previous models for this task still have defects, such as the result of retrieval is unstable and etc. To solve these problems, an unsupervised Deep Correlation Network (DCN) is proposed. DCN firstly incorporates multiple correspondence correlations, different neural networks into a whole. And the model can be divided into two parts. The first part models modalities by restricted Boltzmann machines, and using correlation leaning to learn a common information shared by different modalities. The second part uses autoencoder and the correlation learning to do the same work as the first part. Experiments on three real data sets illustrated that DCN has obvious advantages than existing models.

articleTitle: Research on printing registration recognition method
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A genetic algorithm (GA) optimization support vector machine (SVM) method was proposed to solve the problem of printing registration recognition. The printing marks images were collected and the image feature parameters of Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) were extracted. SVM model with radial basis function was established. GA was used to optimize the parameters of SVM, thus completing the recognition. Results show that the proposed method can effectively recognize the printing registration and meet industrial demand.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective simulated annealing algorithm for pyroelectric robot navigation fire extinguishing system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Multi-objective simulated annealing (MOSA) algorithm has been widely used in many fields as a simple and effective multi-objective intelligent optimization algorithm. In this paper, a fire engine based on pyroelectric sensor is proposed to improve the fire extinguishing system of data center and telecommunication engine room. Through the fusion analysis of the sensor data, the intelligent judgment is carried out, basing on the identified heat source. On the foundation of analyzing the principle of the MOSA algorithm, the multi-machine cooperative intelligent algorithm is used to realize the function of accurate fire source location and rapid fire suppression. This article focuses on the multi - objective simulated annealing algorithm of pyroelectric robot navigation fire extinguishing system and validates the feasibility of the algorithm by using MATLAB algorithm simulation results.

articleTitle: Improved anti-outliers Kalman filter based on the latitude and longitude for track data
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to adverse impact of the track data outliers on the test in real-time target tracking, and the lack of X, Y, Z axis speed, this paper proposes for the first time based on the longitude and latitude to remove outliers. Three correction methods of real-time anti field values are studied: the threshold method, the anti outlier Kalman filtering method, and the improved algorithm of Kalman filter. According to the threshold method to determine the initial value, improved Kalman gain update strategy, by extrapolation and compensation point for outliers, improve the outlier recognition rate to accurately real-time grasp the target information. The simulation test and flight test show that the method is stable and effective, and it can be used in real-time target tracking etc.

articleTitle: Robust stereo visual odometry using weighted and sparse optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A stereo based visual odometry was proposed to accurately estimate the 6DOF robot motion in real time. Uncertainties of feature point reconstruction are defined by covariance matrix to reduce the error propagation during egomotion estimation by weighted spare optimization. Ego-motion estimation was a nonlinear equality constrained optimization problem. It was transformed into a nonlinear unconstrained optimization by Lagrange theorem. The initial estimation was achieved by Weighted Least Square methods to reduce the effect of reconstruction uncertainty of the feature points. Sparse Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm was utilized to obtain more accuracy. The robustness and efficiency were validated by experimental results.

articleTitle: Rate of convergence for data augmentation and inverse Bayes formula method in the genetic linkage model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Many statistical problems can be formulated as the missing data problems. The data augmentation algorithm and the inverse Bayes formula are important tools for constructing iterative optimization or samplings via the introduction of unobserved data or latent variables. As a Markov Chain Monte Carlo method, the data augmentation algorithm has its autocorrelation. Nevertheless, the convergence rate of the data augmentation algorithm is not known in the Genetic Linkage Model, and the same is true for the inverse Bayes formula method. In this article, we analyze the convergence rates of the data augmentation algorithm and the inverse Bayes formula method in the genetic linkage model, and through simulation results we get their convergence rates.

articleTitle: A further study on nonlinear space-time adaptive processing with higher order statistics
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Many array processing methods with higher order statistics (HOS) have been developed in the last three decades. One of the main interests in using HOS relies on the increase of effective aperture and the number of sensors of the considered array. In particular, a nonlinear space-time adaptive processing (STAP) method using HOS, which is able to enhance the system degrees of freedom (DOFs), has been employed on the radar system with nested array in recent years. In this work, we further study the nonlinear space-time adaptive processing with HOS (HOS-STAP) based on the phased array radar system with uniform linear array (ULA). The purpose of this paper is to provide some important insights into the HOS-STAP, such as the output response, the SINR, the minimum detectable velocity (MDV) and the effect of internal clutter motion (ICM), via the numerical experiment. The simulations are also carried out for contrast with the conventional STAP. The results illustrate that the HOS-STAP can gain a narrower target main beam, a lower side-lobe level, an improvement of MDV performance and a less negative effect of ICM, under the condition of the same number of the array elements and the transmitting pulses.

articleTitle: Image super-resolution using siamese-based neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We propose a deep learning method for single image super-resolution using a siamese-based neural network. Our method directly learns an end-to-end mapping between high-resolution image and low-resolution image. Siamese structure is usually used in patch matching and object tracking. This is a try at image super-resolution. We propose that it also perform well on image super-resolution. Our structure, consist of a deep convolutional network(e.g., SRCNN structure) and a three “tower” feature filter with shared parameters. The deep convolutional network is used to get the final model for generating the high-resolution image and the three “tower” filter is used to extract features from the low-resolution patches, generated high-resolution patches and original high-resolution patches. We further explore weights settings to achieve a satisfactory performance. We also use standard images test our model and compare it to the traditional method.

articleTitle: A fixed-location random access scheme with spatial groups and TA information
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved scheme for random access procedure, especially for fixed location Machine-to-Machine devices. Based on a random access scheme with timing alignment information, the scheme improved the fairness of the procedure by dividing all the devices into spatial groups. According to the group number and the timing alignment parameter, the base station will fairly give devices the authority to access to the system even it is located at the edge of the cellular. The paper makes efforts with different gaps on collision probability and device access rate. Simulation results validate that the fairness of the access rating is distinctly improved by the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on relationship of leakage defects and temperature of EHV power transmission and transformation equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Through statistical analysis for leakage defects in power transmission and transformation equipment of China Southern Power Grid main framework during 2013-2015, the relationship between leakage defects and temperature fluctuation is studied, further the mathematic model is derived. And the amount of the leakage defects in 2016 is predicted based on the model. The result verifies the correctness of the model, which is significant for the defect management of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Research of automatic tagging method in news with statistical language model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of the network and the wide application of the related technologies, the boundaries between the new media and the traditional media are gradually blurred. As a new way of information classification, label has gradually come to most people's attention. In this paper, we present a news automatic tagging method. The method can be used to change the rigid and conservative structure of the traditional classification and gives the tagging right of the resources to users, who can define the resources more flexibly and accurately. This paper makes in-depth analysis on news content. Using the traditional information recommendation technology, we integrate the generative theory model with the news automatic tagging method. Thus, we propose a method for news automatic tagging based on language model. Finally, we validate our strategy's performance in label tagging through experiment.

articleTitle: Indoor positioning system using probability distribution comparison
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the small size and no battery needed, passive radio frequency identification(RFID) tag is easily integrated to everything. It is useful on item-level location scenarios like finding an important document at home. Received signal strength indicator(RSSI) based fingerprint indoor positioning methodology is not only appropriate for the active short range radio frequency(RF) system, but also suitable for passive RFID system. According to our repeated experiments, we find out that although a tag's received signal strength(RSS) values distribution against a fixed position doesn't conform to Gaussian process, the value probability distributions is always similar in the nearby positions. A fingerprint-like solution by using RSS value probability distribution comparison for passive RFID system is presented in this paper. The first phase is to build a probability distribution fingerprint database for the targeted area, while the second phase is the real-time probability comparison and location determination. Based on our experimental result, the new solution using our probability distribution comparison method performs higher positioning accuracy than the existing approach.

articleTitle: Research on the constraint satisfaction type of intelligence planning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The constraint satisfaction type of mission planning problems is with more constraints and computationally complex, the traditional algorithms difficultly solve such problems. After analyzing the constraint satisfaction type of mission planning problem and the shortcomings of related exist algorithms, the paper builds the constraint satisfaction type of mission planning model. According to the characteristics of the model, drawing on the advantages and disadvantages of genetic algorithms and tabu search algorithm, genetic algorithm is improved. By genetic algorithm and tabu search algorithm integrated, form the genetic tabu fusion algorithm. According to comparing analysis, it can be shown that the new algorithm can significantly improve the computational efficiency, reduce computing costs, which is feasible and efficient to solve the constraint satisfaction type of mission planning.

articleTitle: Data-based affinity analysis of power transformer defects with adaptive frequent itemset mining algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In worldwide power market, intelligent assessment techniques for power transformers are continuously necessitated to deal with the issues of aging apparatus, upgraded power networks, market deregulation, etc. Considering the disadvantage of subjective judgement with regard to the current assessment systems, data-based analysis approaches (e.g. big data and machine learning techniques) are intended to apply into condition assessment of power apparatus. The database related to power transformers needs multistage processes. The dataset thereof, which relates to familial defects, is considered containing valuable information for condition assessment of power transformers. Affinity analysis can help to mine this type of information. To perform the affinity analysis, this study presents a novel adaptive frequent itemset mining algorithm which is developed based on Apriori algorithm. This algorithm is proposed to meet the specific requirements of mining the familial defect information, thereby supporting an intelligent condition assessment system of power transformers. 11,266 real records from in-service power transformers are used to implement the affinity analysis. The results can quantitatively indicate the affinity among manufacturers, operating years, voltage grades of transformers and their defective parts.

articleTitle: Emotional modeling for a vision-based virtual character
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Emotion intelligence is an important component to enhance the credibility of virtual character's behavior. A virtual character who can perceive and timely to express the appropriate emotions can make the communication between a visual character and a human user more effective and natural. Based on emotional psychology and artificial psychology, this paper simulates the interaction between human emotions, needs and personalities, proposes a new generation method of virtual character's autonomous emotion, and constructs a vision-Based interactive system composed of a facial expression recognition module and a realistic human face model. The results show that the proposed method can make the virtual character produce a more natural emotional reaction in the interaction, and provide an effective method for designing the virtual character's autonomous emotions in the interactive environment.

articleTitle: Robust visual tracking based on extreme learning machine with multiple kernels features fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Extreme learning machine (ELM) has attracted attentions in machine learning fields due to its remarkable advantages such as fast operation, simple solution, and strong generalization. In this paper, a new ELM based multiple kernels features fusion method is proposed for visual tracking. Visual tracking using multiple features has been proved as a robust approach because features could complement each other. In order to capture the non-linear relationship of features, we extend the ELM into multiple kernels framework. The shape and texture features are fused into Gaussian kernel space. Experimental results on publicly available videos show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art trackers.

articleTitle: FM-CDR modification of Frequency Modulation Multiplexer
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Since the standard of FM-CDR has been issued in 2013, radio and television stations across the country are actively using this specification for trial broadcast. In this context, we must implement remold for existing Frequency Modulation Multiplexer of Wireless transmission system. This paper introduces the primary technological standards. Compared with analog frequency modulation multiplexer, we analyze system structure and technical feature and design several conventional schemes of Frequency Modulation Multiplexer's remold. We also pose some nonnegligible problems during the process of remolding and project implementation. At present, the solution methods of this paper have been applied to CDR remold in many provincial and municipal stations and gained a good effect.

articleTitle: Study of target tracking and recovery with low resolution image series
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Object tracking is one of the most important tasks in computer vision. It is aimed to track and identify the targets in every frame automatically, thus making it possible extracting the targets in the frames for the post-processing. The described method encompasses two important issues in image tracking system that have received increased attention in the few years: moving object tracking and object recognition. It is based on kernel algorithm and due to the continuously changing background and moving targets, object tracking has been a challenging task. We review strategies under kernel algorithm and successfully track and restore the image.

articleTitle: A homology-based coverage hole detection algorithm in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), coverage holes may appear because of sensors' random deployment, sensor destruction or consumption of sensor power. Discovery of boundaries of coverage holes is important for repairing these holes and optimizing the whole network. In this paper, we use Rips complex as system model based on homology knowledge. We adopt a detection algorithm to find non-triangular holes only dependent on the connectivity information between sensors. Rely on the definition promoted, we can find all boundary edges and then initiate the process of finding coverage holes. We prove that our algorithm can reduce computation complexity of coverage holes detection by comparing with another homology-based method. And simulation results show that our algorithm can discover almost all non-triangular holes with the accuracy reaching up to 99.99%.

articleTitle: Modification algorithm of DS evidence theory based on the evolution function of focal elements' energy
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Dempster-Shafer(DS) evidence theory can usually distinguish the uncertain information and the unknown information in a weaker constraint condition than the probability theory and Bayes' theorem. It is an efficient tool in information fusion, target recognition and decision-making under uncertain environments. But, the high conflict between evidences can generate fusion results contrary to practice in DS evidence theory. It is unavoidable that high conflict evidences are caused by noise or interference in practice, especially for the sensor data. In order to decrease the influence of the high conflict and noise or interference on the fusion results, in this paper, a new modification algorithm is proposed to improve the performance of DS evidence theory by modifying the evidence sources and the combination rule together. Firstly, in order to make full use of not only the basic probability assignments (BPAs) but the cardinality of focal elements, in the modification algorithm, a novel concept called the evolution function is defined in the form of the prior information ratio of focal elements' energy. Secondly, with a threshold of the average conflict coefficient between evidences, the evidence sources are modified by using the evolution function. Finally, based on the conflict information and the prior information, a modification method of the combination rule is presented by using the evolution function and the conflict coefficient in the modification algorithm. The experiment results prove the accuracy and the effectiveness of the proposed modification algorithm.

articleTitle: Dictionary matrix model and calculation algorithm in sparse representation for X-ray welding image recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The characteristics of circular defect, linear defect and noise of sub-arc x-ray images are analyzed here. In order to construct the sparse representation dictionary matrix for x-ray welding image recognition, the dimension of the dictionary matrix is determined by analyzing the correlation curve of x-ray images firstly. A new mathematical model for constructing dictionary matrix is proposed. The new mathematical model is appropriate to sub-arc x-ray images. The mathematical model is solved by using Hopfield neural network, the energy function and solving algorithm are also presented. A dictionary matrix for sparse representation is constructed by using the presented algorithm, and real x-ray images recognition test based on sparse representation shows that the constructed dictionary matrix can decrease the model images and has good robust in recognition.

articleTitle: Tasks management of manned space ground data processing based on OSWorkflow engine and Web Services
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Within a manned space laboratory ground data processing system, tasks management is a key component to the validity and stability of the system. How to combine the available data processing function of three types of earth observation payloads data effectively to meet the requirements of products processing and how to effectively schedule multiple concurrent tasks, are the important problems to be solved in the course of tasks management. This paper illustrated the characteristics and functions of manned space laboratory ground data processing system to discuss the design thought of tasks management and controlling. Three main workflow technologies including Web Services, OSworkflow engine, and OpenPBS scheduling would be used to design and implement tasks management and controlling. This function could be decomposed into algorithms management, workflow management, and task scheduling. The workflow visualization controlling interface would be developed to verify the task management subsystem based on blade cluster and parallel file system.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of hot topic detection system based on web
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To alleviate the problem of “topic drift” in hot topic on web, the hot topic detection system is implemented. Our system contains the parts as follow. First, news data are collected from Web and cut into the Chinese word segmentation; second, the word weight is calculated by the improved word frequency-inverse document frequency formula (TF-IDF); at last, the Single-Pass clustering algorithm is used for text clustering. The TF-IDF formula is improved, which contains the position information of the word. Experiments show that the hot topic can be effectively identified by this system.

articleTitle: Haplotype inference for pedigree data using the penalized likelihood method
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Although many methods have been developed to do haplotype inference, it is still a challenge work to infer haplotypes and their frequencies from the genotypes data, which are generally obtained at the present time. In this paper, we introduce a penalized method which performs better than the former used way to do the inference. Furthermore, we still use the software HAPLORE, which consist the following three steps, to identify all the compatible haplotypes from the genotypes. Finally, we test the accuracy of the penalized method, and have a comparison with the traditional way. Our simulation results show that the penalized method has more efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: A data recovering algorithm for LDPC codes in highly mobile satellite communications
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In highly mobile satellite communication systems, the rapid motion of terminals, such as airplanes and missiles, will lead to the interruption of the communication and data loss, which includes burst data loss and packet loss. For the burst data loss, we will improve the decoding algorithm of the LDPC codes, which set the initial channel information corresponding to the lost data 0. This method can exhibit good data recovering performance within a certain range. While for the packet loss, we propose the group coding method to turn the packet recovering into the erasure correcting in the BEC, and we also compare the performance and complexity between iterative decoding and maximum likelihood decoding. The simulation results suggest that, the proposed algorithm can recover the lost data with relatively low complexity, which will be well suited in satellite communication systems under high mobility environments.

articleTitle: Denoising fluorescence molecular image by K-Means clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Fluorescence molecular imaging tomography has the advantages of early intervention, low cost and easy use. FMT can acquire the distribution area of fluorophore in body without cutting the body or putting something into the body. But fluorescence molecular image is very sensitive to many kind of noises, such as autofluorescence, white noise and some other noises. The fluorescence signal is the major component in fluorescence image, the intensity of autofluorescence and other background signals are relatively low in the experiment result. The methods represented in this paper is to eliminate high frequency noises by Gaussian smoothing in frequency domain, then, to extract the major components of the fluorescence signals by wavelet transform, finally, K-Means clustering is used to separate the major component and background of the fluorescence image. Experiment results show that the proposed method is efficacy, it could obtain the fluorescence signal while eliminate the background noise, and increase the quality of fluorescence image.

articleTitle: An ant lion optimization algorithm with random fractal adaptive search strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the problems of the unbalanced capability between exploration and exploitation of ant lion optimizer(ALO), an improved ALO algorithm with stochastic fractal and self-adaption searching strategy (SFSALO) is proposed. On the one hand, the stochastic fractal searching function is used for ant so as to improve the capability of exploration. On the other hand, self-adaption searching method is adopted for ant lion at the best position in order to improve the convergence precision and the exploitation ability. The simulation on 3 single-peak and 3 multi-peak benchmark functions shows that the proposed algorithm can fully balances the exploration and exploitation and significantly improves the global optimization ability and the convergence speed.

articleTitle: Secure data deduplication scheme based on distributed random key in integrated networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the progress in space technologies, the future integrated network incorporating ground internet and spatial network is emerging as the times require. The particularity of space application requires secure transmission and storage of mass data. These data contain a lot of repeating data, which occupy an enormous storage space and many network bandwidth resources. How to efficiently delete the repeating data while ensuring the data confidentiality poses a great challenge to the data deduplication technology. This paper proposes a secure data deduplication scheme to be implemented in the integrated network. In this scheme, many key servers are distributed into the entire network so that the client can be linked to several nearby key servers at any time. Then a key generated by a key server is chosen randomly. The key fingerprint is saved to the key fingerprint server to ensure that the data with the same attributes can be encrypted by the same key for the purpose of ciphertext deduplication.
