The theoretical analysis shows that, compared with DupLESS and threshold blind signature, this scheme improves the security of the deduplication system, avoids a single point of failure, simplifies the signature verification, and thus reduces the computational overhead at the client side.

articleTitle: An algorithm for calculating web video download rate based on data acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the era of information explosion, a monotonically increasing amount of video data is produced every day. Calculating the web video download rate to simulate user perception quickly and accurately has become a valuable issue. The web video traffic was captured from broadband network users and analyzed by our own data acquiring system. In this paper, we described the data acquiring system and proposed four algorithms to calculate the video download rate based on the text log data, and then analyzed the accuracy of the algorithms to select the most reasonable one through the comparisons with conventional method. In addition, this paper also proposed a scheme that can quickly distinguish video data from other types of web traffic with a few log information instead of parsing the HTTP content. Through our experiments, the selected algorithm was proved to be reasonable, convenient and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Openstack access control based on regional authoritative access control MODEL
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cloud provider manager and cloud users are not fully trusted due to the separation of them, so there is a potential threat of user data leaks. The traditional access control models are not suitable for cloud environment, because they give the cloud provider manager too much authority. In this paper, a regional authoritative access control model based on the existing RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) is proposed to solve the problem of unequal permissions between users and owners of the cloud platform. A Four-Handshake Agreement is put forward and is realized to improve the business process how the users join the Openstack. By applying CPK (Combined Public Key) mechanism, the authentication pressure of Keystone is relieved while the unreliable environment access control is solved.

articleTitle: An improved GAF routing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, the energy of sensors is often limited. Therefore, how to use energy efficiently becomes a hot research topic. In this paper, we propose a new GAF(Geographical Adaptive Fidelity) algorithm which can utilize energy evenly. The main idea of the algorithm is connected into a straight line with the cluster head node and the sink node in the cluster head node as the center, and the sink node and line less than 90 degrees semicircle area, looking for a distance near the sink node, node residual energy as node sends the next message. We compare the proposed algorithm with the traditional GAF algorithm. The experimental results show that the survival rate of the proposed algorithm is higher than that of the traditional GAF algorithm.

articleTitle: A data mining approach to study risk factors of hyperuricemia
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Today, data mining is widely used to discover hidden information in the large amounts of data. However, data mining applied to medical databases is a challenging process. The unavailability of data in the source and data complexity are some of the difficulties in medical data research. This research work proposes a way of dealing with big medical data with a case study of gout patients disease. Gout is common chronic disease caused by the most important risk factor hyperuricemia. There is no drug to completely cure the gout, the patient is suffering a lot of pain. It is important to control the occurrence of gout and to study the association of gout with other metabolic diseases This paper discusses methods for the analysis of this complex dataset of this disease, to help get more understanding of the disease and associated diseases. Association Rule is used as the mining algorithm for the data processing. An associated relation is proposed according to the experiments, which applies auxiliary support for doctor's clinical diagnosis and disease research.

articleTitle: Research on a resource allocation algorithm based on energy conservation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, an ICS algorithm based on energy conservation awareness is proposed for resource allocation in cloud computing environment. Firstly, the cuckoo search algorithm is applied to the resource allocation, and the objective function and the fitness function are constructed based on the energy consumption and the performance index. Secondly, the simulation experiment was carried out using Cloudsim, and compared with the first adaptive approximation algorithm. Finally, it is found that compared with other algorithms, the energy consumption of ICS algorithm proposed in this paper is about 11.6%.

articleTitle: Overlap hyper-sphere clustering-based outlier mining algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Traditional clustering-based outlier mining algorithm only qualitatively judge whether a data point is an outlier, unable to quantitatively describe the outlier degree. It results to a low mining precision. In order to improve the performance of existing outlier mining algorithms, this paper proposes an overlap hyper-sphere clustering-based outlier mining algorithm. The experiment shows compared with the traditional outlier mining algorithms, it has higher precision and recall rate.

articleTitle: Blind speech extraction based on modulus diversity constraint
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the speech blind source separation (BSS), the convolutive mixed signals can be obtained when the speech goes through a microphone array. The convolutive mixtures can be solved efficiently in the frequency domain when independent component analysis (ICA) is performed separately in each frequency bin. However, it will cause the problem of permutation ambiguity in each frequency bin. Different from BSS, in the blind signal extraction (BSE) of the speech, we only need to extract the target speech from the noisy environment. Constrained ICA (CICA) is one of the solution solving the BSE problems. Compared with ICA, CICA takes full advantage of the prior information of source signals and the prior information can be used as the additional constraint. In order to solve the BSE problem, this paper presents a frequency domain blind signal extraction method to get the target speech in the presence of diffuse background noise. The proposed method is based on the statistical difference of the modulus between speech and noise in frequency domain where the difference is used as a constrained condition. Results of computer experiments demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Timing and frequency synchronization using ZCZ sequences for multi-cell OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a complete solution using zero-correlation zone (ZCZ) sequences for timing and frequency synchronization in multi-cell orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. The proposed scheme consists of the following operations: coarse timing synchronization, fractional carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation and compensation, and joint integer CFO estimation and fine timing synchronization. The ZCZ sequences from the same family set are designed as the training symbols applied to adjacent cells. Due to the perfect autocorrelation and cross-correlation properties of the ZCZ sequences within a certain correlation zone, the inter-cell interference (ICI) of the training symbols can be effectively mitigated by utilizing a time-domain (TD) correlation based synchronization scheme. Simulation results show that the proposed synchronization scheme using ZCZ sequences can effectively mitigate the inter-cell interference and thus improve the synchronization accuracy especially when the mobile stations (MSs) are on the cell boundary.

articleTitle: Forecasting method of aero-material consumption rate based on seasonal ARIMA model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: It is indispensable to scientifically predict the consumption of aero-material and to make scientific decisions on aviation equipment maintenance resources and make full use of existing resources to improve maintenance capability. In the process of aviation equipment maintenance and support, the consumption of aero-material tends to show a seasonal change. This paper proposes a seasonal ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) model to solve the problem of aero-material consumption rate forecasting. Then the mathematical model and calculation method of the seasonal ARIMA are introduced in detail. And the application of seasonal ARIMA model in forecasting the aero-material consumption rate is analyzed by examples. The results demonstrate that the approach of this article has high precision and reliability which could provide data support for the reliability maintenance and replacement of aero-material.

articleTitle: The polling relay selection strategy based on the optimal stopping theory
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Relay selection is a practical and effective way to improve the spectrum efficiency. However, most of the existing research about the relay selection is developed under the perfect instance channel state information (CSI) assumption. This premise limited the real application of relay selection. Fortunately, with the development of optimal stopping (OS) theory, we have a new way to overcome this shortage. In this paper, a polling relay selection strategy (PRSS) for the amplify-and-forward (AF) relay assisted (RA) network is proposed and analyzed. And, the OS theory is also investigated to cooperate with PRSS under the statistical CSI assumption. The simulation results show that PRSS with OS theory can improve the performance of AF RA network effectively.

articleTitle: Denoising by Markov Random Filed in distantly supervised relation extraction
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Distantly supervised relation extraction (DS-RE) gathers training data by aligning knowledge database with text and is an efficient approach for relation extraction. However, it suffers from wrong labeling seriously. We involve a Markov Random Filed(MRF) method to alleviate this issue. In our model, we first build a graph with sentences as nodes and sentence similarity as weight and then compute probability distribution of a random vector representing node labels to correct wrong labels. To reduce complexion, we choose a bi-directional KNN method to build the graph and only remain important connections. At last we extract relations on the denoised dataset by CNN and a bi-directional GRU network with two level attention. The experimental results show that MRF can effectively reduce noise and our model (MRF+BGRU+2ATT) for DS-RE achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Reliability estimation routing strategy for aeronautical cluster networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To guarantee the reliability of communication in future aviation cluster networks, a mobile prediction based link reliability estimation routing strategy is proposed. Firstly, preciously predicting neighbor node location by using a mobile location prediction method. Secondly, according to prediction results, the current node partitions it's communication range and estimates the corresponding link reliability function values to different neighbor node area. According to the obtained reliability value, the hop factor is combined to route selection. Finally, the OLSR protocol is used as the carrier to the routing strategy. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the routing strategy proposed in this paper. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the reliability of routing in aviation cluster network.

articleTitle: A three-dimensional enhanced imaging method based on deconvolution
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to recognize human target in three-dimensional (3D) space, we can use ultra-wideband(UWB) radar to get the parameters of distance, position and high in 3D imaging of human target. Because of the diffraction of antenna and the influence on imaging system about bandwidth of the radar receiver, the correlation between target signal and original signal reduces. The information on waveform is extended by the width of target, these lead to a lower resolution of human imaging. In this paper, the original 3D image of human model is obtained by echo signal based on finite-difference time-domain (FDTD). We focus on radar enhanced imaging method and use deconvolution to increase the azimuth resolution of human target. The effect of different deconvolution approaches is discussed.

articleTitle: Liver CT image segmentation algorithm research based on CV model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Liver CT images are greatly influenced by noise, and the area boundaries of liver image is fuzzy and part of the scanning fragments are scattered and discontinuous, which result in CT image contains some false contour points that affect the process of image segmentation and decrease the accuracy of image segmentation. In this paper, a kind of active contour model based on Wasserstein distance is put forward. Wasserstein distance was introduced in the model for comparison in different regions in the image histogram, to enhance the accuracy of similarity measure, calculate the curve near the point of local energy as a model, and the internal energy of the sum so as to improve the accuracy of image segmentation. Experiment shows that the algorithm can be used for accurate segmentation of liver CT images and the energy function has better convergence.

articleTitle: Adaptive structured subspace clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sparse subspace clustering (SSC) algorithm, founds a new pattern for the subspace clustering, and has led to the satisfactory results in many applications. SSC is implemented in two phases: learning a sparse affinity matrix and performing spectral clustering on the affinity matrix. However, SSC can not commendably cluster together the correlated data within cluster, as well as explicitly capture the natural relationship between the affinity matrix and the segmentation of the data. Motivated by some of the CASS and S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C algorithms, a combinatorial algorithm is presented in this paper. Using trace Lasso instead of l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> norm as regularization constraint, it can adaptively segment subspace and lead to more dense intra-cluster and more sparse inter-cluster. Using a joint optimization framework, it can organically connect two phases of SSC. The optimization model is solved by combining efficient alternating minimization and alternating direction method of multipliers. Experiments on Synthetic data, Handwritten Digits dataset, Extended Yale B and ORL facial databases demonstrate the effectiveness of ASSC approach.

articleTitle: A clustering analysis of news text based on co-occurrence matrix
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we use the improved TF-IDF formula to calculate the weight of the feature word of News. The keyword extraction takes into account the factors such as the parts of speech of feature words and inverse document frequency (IDF). And the K-core theory is used to determine the range of keywords. This study analyzes the co-occurrence strength of news keywords in a certain period of time, and obtains the cluster analysis of the co-occurrence intensity distance of news keywords. And the clustering results are analyzed in the end. In this paper, the quantitative research methods commonly used in bibliometrics are used in the news field to analyze the news content.

articleTitle: Interference Existence and Modulation Order Estimation for Downlink Multiuser Superposition Transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of intra-cell Interference Existence and Modulation Order Estimation in Downlink Multiuser Superposition Transmission(DL-MUST). In practical systems, the receiver needs to know the existence of interference before performing serial interference cancellation (SIC). An improved blind detection algorithm (SREBDA) which expands the searching range of candidate constellation points is proposed. The key point of the proposed algorithm is to find the suitable searching range for each candidate constellation, in order to improve the estimation accuracy as well as to reduce the computation complexity under high-order QAM. In addition, other factors, such as the range of SNR and the relation between all the selected candidate constellations points are considered. Simulation results show that the detection rate of proposed algorithm SREBDA not only enhances 31.3% under 256-QAM and 1024-QAM, but also reaches 100% under 4096-QAM, while the computation complexity reduces nearly 75%.

Author Keywords: intra-cell interference existence and modulation order estimation
search range enlargement blind detection algorithm

articleTitle: Graph theory based max-min path selection for a secure DF relaying system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The use of graph theory to improve the secrecy performance of a wireless multi-hop relaying system is investigated. Particularly, we consider a wireless wiretap network with multi-relay and multi-eavesdropper. A secrecy graph is first established according to the network topology. After building the weight of each edge, an efficient max-min path selection (MM-PS) criterion is then proposed to select an appropriate path for relaying based on shortest path algorithm. Simulation results verified the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed MM-PS criterion and show that cooperative relaying can bring considerable performance improvement.

articleTitle: Discussion on comprehensive and designing experimental teaching in universities
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper takes the comprehensive and designing experiment project (“Book Information Management System”) as an example in the training course of “Access Database Application”, introduces the necessity of setting comprehensive and designing experiment in the university computer courses, discusses the content selection of experiment, the methods and means of experimental teaching, analyzes the teaching effect after implementation. Practice has proved that through the development of the comprehensive and designing experiments, cultivate the ability of analyzing and solving problems, improve the students' ability of innovation, and further cultivate the students' ability of computer literacy.

articleTitle: Fitting methods analyzing in modeling cellular networks based on stochastic geometry
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The topology of base station is an important factor affecting network performance. With the increase of BSs types and density, the traditional hexagonal mesh model can no longer describe the distribution accurately. The model based on stochastic geometry, such as Poisson point process(PPP), attracts a lot of attention. This paper selected four regions of China to analyze, including urban and rural areas. Results show that the urban region can be modeled as Point cluster process(PCP) and the rural can be modeled as Strauss process(SP). This paper also used coverage probability to compare three fitting methods of Poisson cluster process. The conclusion is that the minimum contrast method is best.

articleTitle: A high-efficiency power amplifier from 0.25 to 1.25 GHz based on qualified impedance solution space
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A design approach based on qualified impedance solution space for a broadband high-efficiency power amplifier (PA) is proposed. It helps to automatically circle out qualified optimized load impedance under specific design constraints, and it can ease the design of broadband PAs due to expanded target space compared to manual settings. All the data containing initial power and power-added efficiency (PAE) contours are exported from load-pull test bench and transformed to a qualified fitted space utilizing computer-aided design (CAD) software. This fully explored space containing the fundamental and the second harmonic frequency is adopted as the impedance solution space in the design of matching network (MN). An example PA operating from 0.25 to 1.25 GHz is designed. The measured results show that 11.2-14.4 dB of gain, 40.1-43.4 dBm of output power and 60.5%-75.4% of drain efficiency is delivered.

articleTitle: A joint optimized scheme of transceiver precoding matrix based on interference alignment for multi-cell MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In downlink multi-cell multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems, the inter-cell interference has become the main factor to restrict the system capacity. This paper proposes a joint optimized scheme of transceiver precoding matrices based on interference alignment technology to mitigate inter-cell interference. At the transmitter, via the singular value decomposition of target channels, the scheme selects the precoding vectors which are matched with the best characteristic sub-channel to transmit the signal and enhances the signal strength. At the receiver, the scheme selects the vectors of the most matching target received signal from the null space of interference to form the receiver matrix based on the zero-forcing (ZF) criterion, which further improves the target signal strength. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme has improved the system capacity compared with the existing precoding matrix design method.

articleTitle: Image reconstruction based on multi-electrode excitation in ECT system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the uneven distribution of sensitive field in the single electrode measurement mode of electrical capacitance tomography (ECT), this paper puts forward a measurement model based on multi-electrode methods. By increasing the number of the measured capacitance, the multi-electrode excitation method improves the equilibrium of the sensitive field in the measurement area, and then improves the quality of the reconstructed image. For comparison, the traditional liner back projection (LBP) and conjugate gradient (CG) algorithm are used to reconstruct image, and the relative coefficient and relative error are used as the image quality evaluation indexes. We test the influence of different excitation modes on the quality of the reconstructed image. The simulation results show that the subjective and objective evaluation indexes are better than that of the single electrode excitation.

articleTitle: Study on airport route planning and management based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The analysis and management of the route is an important work in the airport life cycle. The effective visualization of the route is the premise of analysis and management. Through the study of various routes and the characteristics of GIS platform, the transformation of airport coordinate system and world coordinate system and the selection of projection coordinate system are discussed. In order to meet the requirements of visualization and analysis, the route is decomposed, Route segment model, and combined with GIS platform to achieve based on the model of the route visualization and management system.

articleTitle: Tracking algorithm of improved spatio-temporal context with particle filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that spatio-temporal context tracking algorithm is easy to generate drift when the target is in the occlusion condition and complex background, a visual tracking algorithm of improved spatio-temporal context with particle filter is proposed. During the target tracking process, first, the Bhattacharyya coefficient is used as a judgment criterion when the target is occluded. Then the particle filter is used to estimate and predict the position and trajectory of the target in the subsequent frame, and the target can be traced accurately. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can not only be applied to visual target tracking when the target is in complex conditions such as illumination changes, target rotation and background interference, but also is robust to the occlusion of the target and satisfies the requirements of real-time tracking.

articleTitle: Outlier detection in dairy cows estrus based on density clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the dairy farming, it's necessary to identify estrus of dairy cattle accurately in order to increase the milk production milk, prolong lactation and improve economic efficiency. In the modern large-scale farming, the artificial observation method can't meet the needs of the ranch because of the limiting conditions such as its large workload and the serious subjective factors. Therefore, this article uses the method of density clustering to analyze the outliers and judge whether the cow ruts based on the data collected from the dairy cradle and combined with the behavioral characteristics of dairy cow in different situation.

articleTitle: A linearized wideband low noise amplifier in 65nm CMOS for multi-standard RF communication applications
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband low-noise amplifier (LNA) with an improved feedforward distortion cancellation technique is proposed for multi-band and multi-standard RF communication applications. Based on the conventional wideband balun-LNA, the auxiliary path is connected in parallel with the main path to suppress the nonlinearity. The novel topology structure helps implement the scaling factor on the chip without pay extra price. Experimental results have demonstrated a bandwidth of 3.7 GHz bandwidth, a voltage gain of 15 dB, and a noise figure below 6.5 dB in TSMC 65 nm CMOS technology with 1.2 V voltage supply. Moreover, a 3.5 to 7 dB improvement in IIP3 is achieved within the bandwidth in comparison with the conventional LNA.

articleTitle: The implementation of an implicit LU-SGS scheme steady solver based on OpenFOAM
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: OpenFOAM is a popular open source numerical simulation CFD software. The density-based solvers released by the official are all explicit schemes. LU-SGS is an implicit scheme, LTS is a time marching method that can accelerate the convergence of a steady state problem. In this paper, a density-based implicit solver using LU-SGS scheme and LTS for steady state compressible problems based on OpenFOAM is implemented. The detail of the implementation of the solver is introduced. Oblique shock in OpenFOAM and transonic inviscid compressible flow pass through the NACA0012 airfoil are tested. The comparison of the results has shown a better convergence performance using the LU-SGS-LTS solver.

articleTitle: The angular distribution of electric quadrupole radiant power in anisotropic medium
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We introduce a novel approach which aims to simplify the derivation of the angular distribution of electric quadrupole radiant power in the anisotropic medium. First, we derive the expressions of radiant power and its angular distribution of the electric quadrupole oscillating along the polar axis in anisotropic rectangular coordinate system, then the relation between the radiated power of the electric quadrupole oscillating along the polar axis and its angular distribution is obtained by applying coordinate transformation, and then do next research. When the medium is isotropic, the results in this paper are consistent with that we expected, which verifies the correctness of the method we proposed. Achievement of this work can be used to judge the effect of radiation in anisotropic media, so that the radiation effect can be effectively utilized.

articleTitle: Video-based broken filaments automatic detection and counting
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Broken filaments is a common appearance defect of viscose filament surface, the number of broken filaments is a important quality index, the detection and counting of broken filaments is a important problem of quality inspection and control for viscose filament manufacturer. This paper considers this problem as random moving object detection and counting. First, viscose filament video is recorded, and is read into the MATLAB workspace; then a video image processing algorithm is proposed to process the video, and the target video stream with random broken filaments is derived; finally a method based on observation window is adopted to detect and count the broken filaments. Experimental results based on MATLAB show that this method can effectively detect and count the broken filaments, its accuracy rate can more than 90%. It turns out that the method has the potential to be used in the practical production.

articleTitle: Transverse wind measurement with Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Velocity and direction of transverse wind are important parameters of atmospheric turbulence, largely determining the future wavefront pattern. Real time wind estimation contributes to predictive correction which is used to compensate for the time delay in the control systems of adaptive optics (AO) system. This paper presents two methods to estimate the transverse wind from wavefront reconstructed with Zernike modal using Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensor (SHWS). We compare the performances of block match method and optical flow method, as well as presenting a comprehensive error analysis. It is showed that the transverse wind estimation error will be minimum while optimal mode numbers were chosen. For both methods, the percent deviation of velocity estimation are kept within 30%, and the estimation error of wind direction are kept within 6 degree. The variances of the two methods increase with the slope measurement noise variances increasing. When the slope measurement noise is around 1 pixel, the variance of the transverse wind estimation approaches to theoretical lower bound, which indicates the estimation methods are efficient. According to the minimum estimation deviation, the optical flow method is preferable. Numerical results are used to verity the conclusions.

articleTitle: Noisy SAR image classification based on fusion filtering and deep learning
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, Convolution Neural Network (CNN) has achieved a series of breakthrough results in large-scale identification tasks such as image classification and recognition, target location and detection. There are severe speckle noise and distortion in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image, and the traditional classification method has low recognition rate and low robustness to noise. To solve these problems, a novel approach for noisy SAR image classification based on fusion filter and CNN is suggested. Firstly, the noise suppression of the noisy SAR image is carried out by using the fusion filtering algorithm, and then the convolution neural network is used to classify the image. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy can reach 94.23% in the ten categories of target classification, which exceeds the traditional classification algorithm which is classified by artificial annotation. By testing under different noisy conditions, the verification algorithm has strong robustness to noise.

articleTitle: Quantifying the impact of big data's variety
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Among all the popular V-words such as volume, velocity, and variety, etc. that describe the properties or dimensions of the big data, both volume and velocity can be measured, however so far variety has not found a way to become quantifiable. Although, it has been used to capture the most important aspect of the big data - the complexity of the big data caused by various relationships embedded in the data. This paper has applied Kolmogorov's Complexity Theory as the foundation to develop a practical measurement to quantify the impact of the variety of a big data set D towards a specific processing target r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, i is an integer. Using the Inverse Compression Ratio defined by comparing the complexity of and the complexity of entire Relationships set R of the D, where R is the abstraction of the variety of the D, and r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, belong to R. This measurement can help computing resource planning for conducting big data analytics.

articleTitle: Controller elastic managing strategy based on distributed deployment in SDN
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to address the problem of unreasonable network dividing and unbalanced controller deploying in software defined networking (SDN), this paper proposes a controller elastic managing strategy (CEMS) based on distributed deployment in SDN. CEMS includes two phases: subdomain planning and controller optimizing. In phase 1, the nodes are clustered according to the attraction degree and attribution degree, and we could achieve the reasonable network partitioning and the selection of controller location. In phase 2, through the weighted summation of delay, failure degree and communication overhead, the nonlinear iteration is performed for the corresponding weights, then we optimize network overheads and the number of controllers in subdomains. Simulation shows that, compared with the existing schemes, this strategy could balance the network partitioning; reduce the delay and compress the backup space of controller.

articleTitle: Research on task-oriented maintainability index allocation method of warship overall
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The existing maintainability allocation methods came from the equipments maintainability allocation, which are not suitable for the large complex systems such as warship overall. The paper proposed a task-oriented warship maintainability allocation method, which allocates the warship overall maintainability index from the top to the bottom on the base of explicit maintainability parameters and maintenance tasks. The key point is to determin the associated maintenance task time before allocation. The maintainability parameter inherent availability(Ai) of warship overall is allocated to the maintainability parameter mean time to repair(MTTR) of the equipment step by step. Taking a warship example, the warship overall inherent availability(Ai) is allocated to the system inherent availability(Ai) of electric system firstly, and then transformed into the system MTTR and determine the associated maintenance task time, lastly allocated to the mean time to repair(MTTR) of electric system's equipment. This method provided a new idea for the maintainability allocation and analysis of complex giant systems, which solves a problem of allocating maintainability index of a warship overall to the equipments step by step.

articleTitle: Research on software upgrade in a large-scale network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The credit inquiry system is a large-scale network which is built by the People's Bank of China for users to query their own credit. It is composed of tens of thousands of inquiry machines distributed throughout the country. In this system, the software and hardware of inquiry machines may be different from each other. The traditional techniques of software upgrade are not suitable for this network. In order to solve the problem that the software upgrade in the banking system must be secure, automatic and controllable, and that each query machine must be upgraded accurately, this paper proposes a large-scale software upgrade scheme based on OpenCA and OpenSSL, which can accurately upgrade every inquiry machine in the credit inquiry system, and make the system extensible.

articleTitle: Network traffic data analysis based on DGX
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Skewed data appear frequently in network traffic data, this paper focuses on modeling and analyzing these skewed data. The research on data distribution model plays an important role in data mining. In many fields of science, various models have been proposed to describe skewed data. Most of them only perform well for particular data sets, but fail with others. The purpose of this paper is to fit and analyze the skewed data in network traffic data with Discrete Gaussian Exponential (DGX), and to estimate the model parameters with genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Researches based on neural network about optimizing combination of speaker verification
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The identity vector (i-vector) approach has been the state-of-the-art for text-independent speaker recognition, both identification and verification in recent years. An I-vector is a low-dimensional vector, which is called total variability space and is represented with a thin and tall rectangular matrix. In this paper, there is a novel interpretation of the Universal Background Model (UBM), and consider it as a mapping function that transforms the variable length observations (speech utterances) into a fixed dimensional feature vector (sufficient statistics). After this mapping, a similarity measurement is computed on the fixed dimensional features. With this novel interpretation, we proposed new combinations which produce improvements over the conventional UBM framework in both equal error rate and detection cost function. Performance can be further improved by progressively combining different kinds of the feature and the network construction in this vector space via the increasing numbers of neural network layers. Our algorithm makes use of a hybrid generative-discriminative framework: it uses a generative model to learn the characteristics of a speaker and then a discriminative model to discriminate between a speaker and an impostor.

articleTitle: Fast joint blind source separation for multiple datasets using decoupled relative Newton approach
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We develop a simple and efficient algorithm for multiple datasets Joint Blind Source Separation (JBSS). Specifically, a smooth nonlinear function is used to approximate the entropy of estimated Source Component Vector (SCV), and the update of the demixing matrix is decoupled into optimizing a series of row vector by using relative Newton method within each dataset. Simulation results are provided to show the superior convergence behavior and separation performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An independent method for estimating path delay in microwave time synchronization system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to accurately estimate path delays of microwave time synchronization system, an improved ray tracing method is proposed. In this improved model, Hopfield model is introduced to overcome the ray tracing method's dependence on radiosonde data. Meanwhile, Global Pressure and Temperature 2 wet (GPT2w) is used to provide meteorological data for Hopfield model. Some observations are selected to evaluate Hopfield model and GPT2w model, results demonstrate that these two models have high precision. An example is also presented to evaluate the improved ray tracing method. Path delays estimated by two improved models are presented. The meteorological data measured by equipment and estimated by GPT2w are provided to these improved models. Results indicate that the improved model can accurately estimate path delays.

articleTitle: Image matching for structured scenes based on ASIFT and homography constraint
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Images of structured scenes have uniform texture and few matches can be gotten in wide baseline case. Therefore, matching method based on ASIFT and homography constraint is presented. First, initial matches are obtained using ASIFT and epipolar geometry constraint. Second, the initial matches are divided into different groups based on homography constraints and homography matrix is estimated using RANSAC based strategy for each group. Third, the FAST features and homography constraints are used to extend the initial matches. Finally, homography constraints are updated using extended matches and outliers are removed with epipolar geometry constraint. Experiment results show that the proposed method can adapt to wide base image matching for structured scenes images matching and more matches can be obtained compared to ASIFT, which lay good foundation for accurate epipolar geometry estimation and three dimensional reconstruction.

articleTitle: Dynamic sorted convolutional neural networks for drug-drug interaction extraction
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) extraction as a typical relation extraction task in natural language processing (NLP) has always attracted great attention. In this article, we present a dynamic sorted convolutional neural network (DSCNN) based DDI extraction method. This method uses the fix word embedding vectors and dynamic sorted pooling layer in system to extract DDIs. Experimental results on the DDIExtraction 2013 corpus show that DSCNN obtains a better performance (a precision of 73.7%) than other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of secure transmission scheme for random cognitive wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper designs a new chance transmission scheme for the cognitive wireless network with randomly distributed wiretap nodes. Under the condition that the channel estimation error exists at receiver and the channel information of the wiretap channel is unknown, the closed expression of the system's secrecy outage probability, connection outage probability and secrecy throughput is deduced. Based on these, we obtain the trade-off between the secrecy throughput and energy efficiency. Finally, under the requirement of security and reliability, the optimal pilot length and transmit power under the transmission scheme are obtained by maximizing the compromise function. The simulation results verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and show that the gain of the net secrecy throughput is improved after adding the pilot. Considering the energy efficiency, the transmit power has an optimal value to maximize compromise function, and we obtain the expression of most superior power.

articleTitle: Modulation classification for cognitive radios with robustness against non-stationary additive noise
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Modulation classification (MC) is an important field in cognitive radios. Most MCs based on the cyclic spectral density (CSD) can only apply to the stationary noise environment, but fail to inhibit non-stationary noise which is common in practical use. In this paper, we propose a MC method for cognitive radios with robustness against non-stationary additive noise, which is based on the fourth-order cyclic polyspectrum (FOCP). The proposed method is robust to non-stationary noise and can identify the modulation scheme of primary user's signal in cognitive radios. Monte Carlo simulation results demonstrate that our method can achieve better classification accuracy than the existing CSD-based MC method in non-stationary additive noise case.

articleTitle: Speed compensation of phase-coded stepped-frequency based on modified spectrum peak estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the sensitivity of the phase-coded stepped-frequency signal to speed, the distance of the target is affected and the speed is compensated. In this paper, the time shift and waveform distortion caused by target velocity are analyzed, the common methods of speed compensation are introduced, and the advantages and disadvantages of various methods and their applicable range are analyzed. An modified spectrum peak estimating method is proposed., the maximum likelihood criterion is fitted by the scanning distance contour to obtain the estimated value of the target velocity, and the effect of different methods is simulated and the feasibility of the method is verified. This method can improve the accuracy of the speed estimation, the scope of application is relatively wide, and can be a good solution to the impact of the target speed.

articleTitle: Application of KMP algorithm in customized flow analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Internet technology has developed rapidly today, the Internet has become an indispensable part of the way everyone online more and more diverse, there are PC, mobile phones, flat and even watches, etc.; and the speed of the network with the increase in bandwidth and rapid growth The The traffic data completely records the behavior of each person online, if you can effectively use the flow of data analysis, it will be a huge treasure. The usage of virtualization technology can improve the utilization rate of data center equipment and bring convenience to cloud computing applications [1]. Based on the analysis of traffic, this paper introduces the basic idea of traffic analysis system, what is custom traffic analysis, and then explores how to improve the efficiency of traffic analysis. KMP algorithm is proposed for initialization based on the K-means partition algorithm[2], experiments show that KMP algorithm significantly reduces the disparity between the initial solution and the actual solution[3], so you can consider using it to improve efficiency, such as the application of KMP algorithm in traffic analysis.

articleTitle: Disambiguation for Chinese network encyclopedias based on semi-topic model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Network encyclopedias have been a major method for searching information or knowledge in our daily life. There are many hyperlinks pointing other entries to make readers better comprehend in network encyclopedias, but these may be ambiguous. Some algorithms have been proposed for disambiguation in natural language processing. Most of those are based on English, so in this paper we propose a novel algorithm based on Chinese. The paper focuses on the semantics and topic model to analyze the relationship between entries and the experiment indicates that it is more effective than traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Reuse ontology mapping based on the similarity of adjacent concepts
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to reduce redundant similarity computation and improve mapping discovery, a new algorithm for ontology mapping reuse is proposed, in which the similarity between the concepts to be measured and the concepts in the existing mapping can be inferred. First of all, we establish a semantic two diagram between the conceptual contours. Then, the similarity of adjacent concepts is obtained by the best matching of two graphs. Finally, inspired by similar transmissions between adjacent concepts, new mappings between concepts are determined by existing mappings of adjacent similar concepts. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A semidefinite programming approach for target localization in the presence of sensors location errors
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this work, a stationary target localization based on differential received signal strength in the presence of location errors is presented. In the proposed algorithm, it is considered that the exact position of the receivers are not available. By taking both the measurements and location errors into account, according to the Constrained Weighted Least Squares (CWLS) criterion, the Differential Received Signal Strength (DRSS) measurements are formulated as a form that is related to the target position. However, due to the non-convex nature of the CWLS problem, it is difficult to obtain the globally solution. Then the semidefinite relaxation (SDR) technique is applied to relax the CWLS problem into a Semidefinite Programming Problem (SDP), which can be efficiently solved by some convex optimization algorithms. By comparing with the method which without considering the location errors, the proposed one is able to provide a more accurate estimation. The performance of the proposed algorithm is examined by simulation results.

articleTitle: A spectrum allocation scheme for DASH multicast service over wireless network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (DASH) is a prospective video transmission technique. It can select appropriate bitrates for users according to channel conditions and capacities of user equipments. Multicast of DASH is a promising but challenging way to improve spectrum efficiency. It has not been sufficiently researched. However, in this paper, we focus on investigating a spectrum allocation scheme for DASH multicast service. To this end an optimization problem is formulated and a multicast spectrum assignment algorithm called DASH Multicast Fairness (DMF) is proposed. Simulation results show that the proposed scheduling algorithm outperforms others in multicast scenario.

articleTitle: A real-time robust filtering and fusion method based on multiple median estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the interference of complicated electromagnetic environment and the unrobustness of traditional method in the weighted fusion of multi-source electronic measurement data, with robust statistics theory as a guide, this paper proposed a robust filter method based on real-time median estimation and constant velocity model, and applied the filter residual error scale to the dynamic fusion weights calculation under the optimal weight assignment principle, then obtained a new distributed robust weighted fusion method. With typical experimental data, the weighted fusion was tested, and the filtering method was compared with Kalman filter. The results showed that the methods proposed, which less affected by gross error, were effective and robust in practical engineering application, and achieved the adaptation to measurement noise.

articleTitle: The generating algorithm of group meal recipes based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Although generating recipes by computers has the characteristics of convenience, speediness, accuracy and efficiency, the existing template displacement method has certain limitations. However, using genetic algorithm to generate group meal recipes has obvious advantages of artificial intelligence and evolution. This paper solves the optimization of group meal recipes in the newly built library of recipes by constructing a complete recipe generation model, which designs initial coding scheme, generates initial population and constructs fitness function by selected operation, crossover operation and mutation operation.

articleTitle: LSIS: Large scale instance selection algorithm for big data
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently enormous volumes of data are generated in Information Systems, and data mining area is facing new challenges of transforming this “big data” into useful knowledge. To get from “big data” a manageable volume, we propose a large scale instance selection for reducing the initial dataset, leading to a reduction of both time taken and the computational resources that are necessary for performing the learning process, and improving the accuracy of classifier model. Our experimental results demonstrated that the proposed algorithms could scale well and efficiently process large datasets by selecting relevant instances for classification problem. The experimental results show also the contribution of the instance selection on the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of diversity and multiplexing based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: MIMO technologies have been successful in cellular systems. Spatial diversity can provide diversity gain and is widely used to improve the stability of the signals, while spatial multiplexing can provide multiplexing gain for making full use of spectrum resources. Meanwhile, there is a trade-off between diversity and multiplexing called DMT. In this paper, the system performance of the open-loop transmission diversity and open-loop multiplexing technology in the eight transmission modes of the LTE system are studied with three scenarios through dynamic system-level simulation based on OPNET. The advantages of spatial diversity and spatial multiplexing are verified by channel utilization, delay and throughput, SNR and packets loss rate, etc. In simulation, we find out that the density of users can be used as a reference point of diversity and multiplexing. The results show that the communication performance of the central cell is much better by using the trade-off method than each single method.

articleTitle: The research and application of domain-ontology-oriented flexible query method
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To solve the problem of empty or incongruent results in semantic queries, the paper proposes a flexible query method of domain ontology. Starting with the synonym analysis of semantic dictionary, the method makes a synonym expansion combining the synonymy and hyponymy in ontology, calls word similarity formula to calculate the similarity between the query keyword and its synonyms, and then, on the basis, defines flexible query inference rules, and makes the flexible expansion of query keyword by calling the inference mechanism and then uses the standard SPARQL query engine to complete the flexible query processing. The experimental system and corresponding experiment results prove the effectiveness of the method proposed.

articleTitle: A framework analysis of personalized recommendation system with media tags
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: On the basis of the research on the recommendation of media information resources based on tags, this paper uses the theories of system dynamics and data mining, to study the formation mechanism and influencing factors of recommendation system of media information resources, and to construct the system dynamics model of dynamic media recommendation system based on tags. Moreover, Vensim PLE software is used to simulate and test the model, which further gives insights about how user's adoption situation, density and centrality affect the media recommendation system.

articleTitle: A joint sequence design for multi-beam detection in millimeter wave cellular systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the scarcity of spectrum resources, the millimeter wave bands have been considered for 5G New Radio. Highly directional and multiple beams are used to overcome the isotropic path loss in mmWave cellular systems. Therefore, the synchronization signals should include more additional information, such as the synchronization signal block index and the beam resource index. In this paper, an efficient sequence of tertiary synchronization signal is designed, carrying the SS block ID and the beam ID. And a joint detection scheme is proposed, to reduce the complexity of detection in synchronization. Finally, simulation results show that the proposed scheme can provide robust capabilities and good performance, which contributes to the standardization of 5G.

articleTitle: Image super-resolution based on multi-scale self-similarity and gradient constraint
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this study, we proposed a single image superresolution based on multi-scale self-similarity and gradient constraint. Instead of depending on an external set of example images required in most learning-based super-resolution algorithms, the proposed algorithm exploit self-similarity and generates example image pairs directly from the image pyramid of the input low resolution image. The algorithm is patch-based. Therefore, these images including input low resolution image are divided into patches firstly. Gradient feature of the patches is extracted. Then, similar example patch pairs are searched for each input patch. The gradient feature of high resolution patch can be estimated by weight of the similar patches. At last, the solution model constrained by gradient is set up, which can solve the weight and estimate high resolution image patch by alternated iteration. The model can reduces the influence of weight estimation error on performance of the proposed algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm performs well.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for enumerating all maximal cliques
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Enumerating all maximal cliques is a fundamental problem in graph theory, notable for its capability of modeling other combinatorial problems and real-world applications. In this paper, a new depth-first search algorithm with several pruning methods is proposed to generate all maximal cliques of undirected graphs. Different random graphs and real networks are used to prove the efficiency of our algorithm in the experimental studies. Computational experiments show that our algorithm has better performance than Bron-Kerbosch algorithm in those graphs.

articleTitle: Development of remote interaction system in drilling field
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The remote interaction system in drilling field was developed for various units to overcome the disadvantage of the technical support of tunnel drilling rig, such as the low efficiency, the high cost, and the backward of support and management way. It realizes the interaction of audio-video and the effective management of drilling maintenance resources. Firstly, we analyze the function and technical difficulties of the system. Then we design the hardware interaction platform for different drilling fields, and develop the interaction software through the access mod of “centralized server + C/S + B/S” architecture. Finally, the system was created with the PC client, the mobile client and the WEB server. Verification test shows that the hardware platform has a reasonable structure with high reliability and the software platform is powerful with stable running.

articleTitle: Research and realization of ontology-based Tujia brocade knowledge base system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Tujia brocade as one of the national intangible cultural heritages in China, is an outstanding representative of traditional Chinese folk handicraft. However, there are many problems with cultural resources on Tujia brocade skills, such as its distribution is not concentrated, lack of semantic organization, difficult to obtain and dissemination and so on. In view of these problems, this paper constructs a set of Tujia brocade cultural knowledge base system based on ontology, initially, we proposes a method of ontology modeling in Tujia brocade domain, and constructs the ontology model of Tujia brocade domain via using ontology technology, and then design and realize the ontology annotation, semantic association and knowledge retrieval and display functions for Tujia brocade cultural knowledge through the system demand analysis. The system has realized the reasonable organization of Tujia brocade cultural resources, it will contributes to the widespread dissemination and sharing of Tujia brocade cultural knowledge.

articleTitle: Sparse Anchor Nodes Cooperative Localization Algorithm for WSN
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Dynamic localization is one of the important and difficult points of localization for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN). The mobility and uncertainty of the nodes seriously affect the success rate and accuracy of localization. To improve localization performance, a Sparse Anchor Nodes Cooperative Localization Algorithm (SANCL) is proposed in this paper. The algorithm can solve the problem that the unknown node cannot be located when the number of its neighbor anchor nodes is less than three. When the number of neighbor anchor nodes for an unknown node is more than three, the node can be located by the Trilateration Localization Algorithm (TLA). When the number of neighbor anchor nodes is two, the node can be located through limiting its moving direction. At the same time, it uses the historical localization information to predict the present location. When the number of neighbor anchor node is one, the BP neural network and historical localization information are used to predict its moving velocity and location. Simulation results show that the localization success rate is improved by about 42.80% compared with TLA algorithm. Compared with Mobile Nodes Predictive Localization Algorithm (MNPLA), the localization success rate is improved by about 12.34%, and the average relative error is reduced by about 0.24r.

articleTitle: Parallel acceleration on simulation of a 2D Takeuchi electrophysiology cardiac model using GPUs
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Modeling and simulation of cardiac electrophysiology has the advantages of economic and security than anatomical experiments. However, the simulation of a cardiac model that matches a real one always demands very high computing ability that an ordinary CPU could hardly satisfy. In this paper, a parallelized solution of the simulation of a 2D electrophysiology cardiac model based on CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture) using GPUs is introduced. CUDA is a parallel computing platform and API (Application Programming Interface) model created and released by NVIDIA, which offers us a way of using GPUs as co-processors to implement parallel computation. Through our work, it is shown that the simulation of electrophysiology cardiac propagation model is an ideal candidate for GPU computing and achieves impressive speedup compared to ordinary CPUs.

articleTitle: A truthful auction-based mechanism for virtual resource allocation and pricing in clouds
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A major challenge faced by the cloud providers is to design an efficient mechanism for virtual resource allocation and pricing. We formulate the virtual resource allocation problem in cloud computing as an integer program and design a truthful auction-based mechanism that solve it. Our proposed mechanism enables the cloud providers to effectively utilize their virtual resources and obtain higher profits. We design a heuristic allocation algorithm in which each user can submit multiple requirements. In addition, we design a payment algorithm which takes into account the interests of both the cloud providers and the users. We perform extensive simulation experiments using real workload traces in terms of social welfare, execution time, and resource utilization. We show that our proposed mechanism achieves promising results for virtual resource allocation.

articleTitle: Research on calibration technology of vehicle laser scanning system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development and maturation of GPS technology, inertial navigation technology, CCD imaging and laser scanning technology, vehicle movement measurement technology has become a trend of urban spatial information acquisition. In the process of the vehicle to improve the measuring precision, the calibration field layout processing is particularly important. This paper takes Daxing Campus of Beijing University of Architecture calibration field as an example. According to the established calibration mathematical model, use control point calibration method. The error equation is established and the algorithm is realized by programming. The attention of control field layout fully described, and the acquired data is processed. At the end of the 3D laser scanning system of vehicle after calibration is making accuracy analysis.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Energy-aware virtual machine management optimization in clouds
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

“Energy-aware Virtual Machine Management Optimization in Clouds”
by Xiaoqing Zhang
in 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications, December 2017, pp.2434-2438

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE’s Publication Principles.

This paper copied content from the paper cited below. The original content was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

“Optimal online deterministic algorithms and adaptive heuristics for energy and performance efficient dynamic consolidation of virtual machines in Cloud data centers”
by Anton Beloglazov and Rajkumar Buyya
in Concurrency and Computation: Practice and Experience, October 2011, pp.1397-1420

“Energy-aware resource allocation heuristics for efficient management of data centers for Cloud computing”
by Anton Beloglazov, Jemal Abawajy, and Rajkumar Buyya
in Future Generation Computer Systems, May 2011, pp.755-768


Cloud computing provides a kind of dynamic and scalable service on demand. However, clouds consume huge amounts of electrical energy. Meanwhile, delivering the negotiated QoS defined as Service Level Agreement (SLA) to users is necessary. A virtual machine placement strategy based on the equilibrium between energy and SLA is proposed. Aiming at dynamical changes of application workloads, an adaptive placement strategy RLWR based on robust local weight regression is presented, which decides the overload time of hosts dynamically according to the historical resource occupation of application workload. Then, two virtual machine migration selection algorithms, MPM and MNM are presented. The migrated virtual machines are deployed using bin-packing algorithm PBFDH. Contrasting to static algorithms such as STH, MPA and DVFS, virtual machines are not only deployed on fewer hosts in our algorithm, which promotes energy efficiency, but the load prediction can bring high-reliable QoS delivery and avoid overmuch SLA violations. Experimental results show that our strategy has an obvious effect on decreasing SLA violation under ensuring energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Detection of pilot spoofing attack in multi-antenna systems using modified FDC criterion: A random matrix approach
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We investigate the detection of one kind of active eavesdropping which happened in the physical layer of a timedivision-duplex (TDD) multi-antenna system, in which malicious eavesdroppers send the identical pilot signal in the uplink channel estimation phase to disguise as the legitimate receivers This attack could lead to a huge secrecy information leakage to the eavesdroppers, called pilot spoofing attack. Consider a multi-antenna system which has one base station with M antennas, N single-antenna users, and K single-antenna eavesdroppers. Aiming at the physical layer security which would be threatened by the pilot spoofing attack, we propose a novel pilot spoofing attack detection algorithm by using random matrix theory (RMT) to modify flexible detection criterion (FDC). The simulation shows that the detection performance of the modified FDC is much better than FDC, especially when the length of pilot signal becomes smaller and has the same order magnitude as M.

articleTitle: Synthetic aperture image formation for multi-receiver syntehtic aperture sonar
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the phase centre approximation method, the multi-receiver data can be converted to the monostatic format. This conversion is usually carried out with the data preprocessing, i.e. interpolation and complex multiplication. After the data conversation, this paper presents a range-Doppler algorithm for multi-receiver synthetic aperture sonar (SAS). Finally, simulated data is used to test the presented method. It shows that the presented method can obtain imaging results with high performances.

articleTitle: Computerized analysis of tongue sub-lingual veins to detect lung and breast cancers
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Among all cancers, lung and breast can be attributed to a large number of deaths worldwide. Given the various inconveniences and risks associated with traditional diagnostic methods, efficient non-invasive detection approaches using computerized methods are needed. With recent advances in medical biometrics, particularly focusing on the analysis of facial and tongue images to detect various diseases, there is a lack of studies in tongue sub-lingual veins. Therefore, this paper will analyze tongue sub-lingual veins in order to distinguish those that are healthy from those that have cancer (either lung or breast). Tongue sub-lingual veins are first captured using a uniquely designed device. Segmentation is then carried out to separate the vein foreground pixels from its background. This facilitates feature extraction in the form of color and geometry. As for the last step, classification is performed. Experimental results on a dataset consisting of 628 healthy samples, 81 samples with lung cancer, and 147 with breast cancer yielded an average accuracy of 82.07% at healthy vs. lung cancer, and 79.23% at healthy vs. breast cancer, proving the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Specific emitter identification based on horizontal visibility graph
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Specific emitter identification (SEI) techniques are often used in civilian and military spectrum-management operations and they are helpful to enhance the security of wireless network. In this letter, we investigate SEI problem by using features generated by the nonlinearity contained in received signals. First, the horizontal visibility graph (HVG) method is applied to the instantaneous amplitude, phase and frequency of received signals to derive their degree distributions. Then, a feature vector formed by the normalized Shannon Entropy (NSE) and the Fisher Information measure (FIM) obtained from these degree distributions are used as RF fingerprints. Finally, four emitters produced by a certain manufacturer are utilized to evaluate the performance of the proposed method. For comparison purpose, the method based on the normalized permutation entropy (NPE) is used as a gold standard. Experimental results show that the proposed method is quite effective and its performance is better than that of the NPE-based method in the case of small amount of data. Moreover, the proposed method does not need to distinguish between transient signals and steady-state signals and there is no parameter to be determined before performing the SEI system, which makes the proposed method relatively practical.

articleTitle: A method of frame synchronization for high speed pulse signal based on GTX
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A frame synchronization method with low cost and low resource consumption is proposed for high-speed laser signals with bandwidths of GHz. After the high-speed laser signal is photoelectric converted, the output is sent to the comparator to make a hard decision. Then a high speed baseband pulse signal is obtained. Through the Gigabit transceiver, the frame of high speed pulse signal is synchronized, in the monobit way. After a brief introduction of Gigabit transceiver usage and monobit receiving structure, simulation is taken for the proposed frame synchronization method. We confirm that the frame synchronization head can be effective captured. The performance of the capture is analyzed to verify the feasibility of the proposed frame synchronization method.

articleTitle: Target tracking based on extended Kalman particle filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Angular glint is a main error source influencing target tracking in terminal guidance radar. However, the classic particle filter suppressing angular glint fails to take dynamic information of current moment into account when selecting importance density function and particle degrades in the resampling process. To solve these problems, an improved algorithm based on extended Kalman particle filter was thus proposed and applied to suppress angular glint in target tracking in this paper. Results of traget tracking simulation experiments show better suppression effect of the proposed algorithm. And the proposed algorithm is expected to have a wide application prospect due to great superiority and feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on time synchronization algorithm of TTE multi-hop system based on IEEE1588 protocol
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Accurate and precise frequency synchronization is an essential requirement for different areas in avionics system. Emerging practice for time synchronization is to utilize Time-triggered Ethernet(TTE) network which is peer-to-peer network since it is highly deterministic. However, for some situations, TTE network contains uncertain communication delay, such as the node of the TTE network has an external clock source or contains a controller other than the TTE controller etc. This problem can be overcome by applying IEEE1588v2 synchronization protocol to TTE network. In this paper, the feasibility and the synchronization error of the algorithm not only are analyzed theoretically but also are verified from the simulation point of view. Specifically, the first step is the construction of model of the clock offset and clock drift state space between master and slave clocks. Subsequently, the Kalman filter algorithm is used to estimate the clock offset and skew between master and slave clock and compensate for its. Lastly, the algorithm's performance is evaluated using simulation. In the simulation process, above method is applied to the TTE multi-hop system, considering the effect of timestamp accuracy on the synchronization effect. The result of this simulation shows that, the algorithm with the 1588 synchronization protocol on the TTE network has more accuracy and stability than without it, when the timestamp accuracy is microsecond or higher.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic bandwidth allocation algorithm in bluetooth piconet based on multipriority
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
