abstract: Bluetooth is a short range wireless communication technology, which is widely used in our daily life, In-Vehicle Communication, industrial control and so on. How to make the main equipment fair and timely schedule services from the device is the key to scheduling algorithm. In this paper, in order to solve the problems of efficiency, fairness, real-time service and non-real-time service coexistence, proposes a dynamic bandwidth allocation algorithm in Bluetooth piconet based on multipriority, dividing business into multiple priorities and implemented a fair and efficient scheduling algorithm to guarantee the Qos demand of different types of business.

articleTitle: Using Unity3D to simulate VHF sailor 3520
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, due to the rapid development of information technology, the application of technology for simulation of equipment in the navigation has had many changes. In previous studies of simulations which have only been performed on two-dimensional (2D) system's, as a result there is a lack of realism and interactivity. In this article, the authors used relatively common software for designing the game currently, named Unity3D. The VHF Sailor 3520 is uses 3ds Max to conduct model object into three-dimension (3D) models and then used Unity3D to realize the interaction. We used User Interface (UI) to design VHF's screen and used RGB to draw the screen's color, which controls the VHF in the three-dimension space by geometric transformation: rotation, translation and scaling. The simulation equipment can be published on multiple-platforms, such as windows, iOS, Web player and other smart devices. The result of this article will allow a new way of three-dimensional (3D) simulation for training crews and students majoring in navigation.

articleTitle: Cell clustering-based resource allocation in ultra-dense networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A dynamic cell clustering-based resource allocation algorithm is proposed in this article aiming at the interference at the same layer between femtocells and the cross-layer interference between femtocell and macrocell. The algorithm includes two steps: In the first step, it allocates sub-channels for users of macro by utilizing the improved Hungary algorithm, followed by power allocation with the water-filling algorithm. In the second step, it firstly conducts clustering for FAPs by utilizing the genetic simulated annealing algorithm according to the size of the weight of the interference among femtocells, and then allocates sub-channels for FUEs by utilizing the heuristic channel allocation algorithm, and then allocates power for users by adopting KKT conditions. According to simulation results, this algorithm can restrain both of the two interferences effectively, satisfying the demands of users on speed and improving the network spectrum effectiveness.

articleTitle: An adaptive algorithm based on levenberg-marquardt method and two-factor for iterative extended Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The iterative extended Kalman filter (IEKF) algorithm is dependent on the previous data and estimation accuracy of the noise. The noise will result in filtering precision decrease and divergence. This paper puts forward an adaptive algorithm based on Levenberg-Marquardt method and two-factor for IEKF, which optimizes the iterative process by using Levenberg-Marquardt method, adjusts the prediction covariance by suboptimal fading factor. A simplified calculation method of suboptimal fading factor is also presented. The previous process noise is suppressed by exponential fading factor, and the observation noise is corrected by the residual and innovation, so that filter gain becomes larger, which improves the accuracy and robustness of the filter algorithm. The experiment results indicate the improved algorithm can effectively suppress the filter divergence. Compared with the classical extended Kalman filter (EKF), IEKF, and the modified IEKF, the filter accuracy and robustness of the improved algorithm are sufficient, and the algorithm can better meet the requirements of engineering applications.

articleTitle: Application of an intelligent algorithm in estimating the fire site
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To the questions of the multiple of fire accident, diversity and complexity of fire cause, lack of effective and direct-vision technological method in fire investigation, this paper proposes an intelligent algorithm for estimating the fire site, on basis of gravitation model and elastic force model. The feasibility of the algorithm is verified by the affirmed fire scene in the past using a fire scene recognition system assisted in estimating the fire location compiled in Java language to fulfill HCI. The test shows that the algorithm is accurate and reliable, which has an important practical significance for reconstruction, simulation and analysis of real fire information to help the fire scene investigator conclude the fire position accurately, improve the efficiency of fire investigation, and understand fire trace characteristics scientifically and correctly.

articleTitle: Research on armored vehicle classification based on MFCC and SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To solve the problem of the passive acoustic recognition for ground battlefield armored vehicle target, in order to improve the recognition rate, a new noise recognition model of armored vehicle is put forward. Which is based on Mel frequency cepstral coefficients (Mel Frequency Cepstrum Coefficient, MFCC) and the support vector machine (Support Vector Machine, SVM). Two representative tanks and two armored vehicle are selected as the recognition object, and the noise of truck and rain are selected as the interference. Extracting MFCC and calculate the average value as the eigenvector, and input it to the SVM whose parameters is optimized by the bat algorithm. Experimental results show that this method has good recognition effect and the recognition rate is above 95%.

articleTitle: Time evolution of the importance of nodes in VANET based on temporal networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As the key nodes in the vehicle ad hoc network (VANET) play a vital role in the dissemination of information, evaluating the importance of nodes is necessary. In this paper, based on Intelligent Driver Model with Lane Changes (IDM-LC), the VanetMobiSim is used to study the time evolution of important nodes for VANET. Firstly, the temporal network model of VANET is built. Then, we analyze the evolution of important nodes in VANET based on four temporal metrics. The results show that the communication radius of VANET does not affect the ranking of important nodes. The evolution of important nodes is similar under temporal degree, entropy degree centrality and temporal Bonacich (a, β)-centrality, and the ranking of important node is basically stable. We also show that in temporal closeness centrality case the key nodes in VANET that are consistently important over time, this result shows that the temporal closeness centrality cannot be used to evaluate the importance of nodes in VANET. These results will help us choose methods appropriate to evaluation the nodes importance in VANET.

articleTitle: EDCS: An enhanced distributed color selection algorithm for anti-collision in RFID system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) is an automatic identification technology which need not manual intervention. The RFID system is consist of lots of readers and tags. It often uses multiple readers to meet the demands which are cover area and identify speed. And reader collision happens when identification range of two or more readers is overlapping. Distributed color selection (DCS) protocol have been proposed to reduce reader collisions by arrange readers identify tags in different slot. However, it does not take remaining readers of prior slot into consideration. This paper proposes enhanced distributed color selection (EDCS) algorithm to increase the contemporary readers to identify. We give a new chance to collided readers in prior time slot to compete and identify. We conduct extensive simulations and demonstrate the efficiency of our algorithm. The results show that our protocol can improve total activated reader number by about 10% in a frame. It is a great progress for the multireaders environment.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of power communication room monitoring system based on IEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A dynamic environment monitoring method of power communication room based on IEC 61850 protocol was proposed in this paper and then the system using this method was designed and realized. Finally, the power environment equipment of power communication room is realized by unified management and scheduling, which improves the efficiency of operation and maintenance. In this system, all power environment monitoring equipment protocol of electric power communication equipment room are all connected to the IEC 61850 protocol converter developed in this project, and then the information with unified IEC 61850 protocol was directly uploaded to the background management system, the power environment equipment management realized a unified management and scheduling. Besides, the power environment equipment of power communication room achieves the county, city and provincial unified monitoring and management. The system has the advantages of centralized management, clear structure, standard transmission, flexible configuration, security and reliability, so the market prospect is broad.

articleTitle: Influence of network delay on human perception of weight in virtual environment
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates the influence of network delay on human perception of weight in virtual environment by experiment. In the environment, each of two users manipulates a haptic interface device, and the users collaboratively lift up a stick by holding two ends of the stick in a 3D virtual space. A weighted ball is placed on the stick, if one end of the stick is lower than the other end, the ball moves to the lower end. The users try to keep the ball at the center of the stick while lifting up the stick. We also implement the local lag control as QoS (Quality of Service) control and compare results with the control and those without it. Experiment results demonstrate that the local lag control is effective.

articleTitle: Texture adaptive steganography via Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the investigation of the steganography, most of the current algorithms focus on how to describe the noise of an image. This paper proposes a new paradigm for steganography to automatically evaluating the modification priority of each pixel in image by using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). An image is decomposed into several sub-images which center pixel is modified, steganalysis method is used to judge which sub-image is secure, this suggests the center pixel suitable to embed message or not and obtain an appropriate priority. Corresponding stenographic cost assigned to each pixel on the foundation of priority. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves the state-of-the art performance on resisting advanced steganalysis.

articleTitle: Fast sparse channel estimation for many access MIMO system: On the benefit of block sparsity
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We consider efficient methods for active users detection in Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) system. To support massive connectivities, all active users are allowed to transmit information simultaneously. We use greedy algorithm to get the set of active users and their channel state information(CSI) in limited time. The Block Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (BOMP) algorithm needs many iterations and the knowledge of sparsity level. To make explicit use of block sparsity, adaptive Compressive Sampling Matching Pursuit(ACoSaMP) algorithm is proposed to decrease the iterations we need. And new stop conditions has been found to get accurate sparsity level which is the number of active users. Combining those two methods, we can have better performance and lower complexity than BOMP at the same time.

articleTitle: Semidefinite programming for NLOS localization U sing TDOA and FDOA measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Non line of slight (NLOS) propagation has a serious impact on localization performance, especially in indoor and urban environment. In this paper, a localization method using time difference of arrival (TDOA) and frequency difference of arrival (FDOA) measurements has been proposed to suppress NLOS error. This method does not require the distribution but bounds of NLOS error, which can be obtained according to the magnitude in practice. Based on this priori knowledge, we elaborate the constraints and introduce auxiliary variables to formulate a constraint weighted least squares (CWLS) problem. Although it is highly non-linear and non-convex, we can transform it to a semidefinite programming (SDP) problem through proper convex relaxation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method can mitigate NLOS error and performs better than the weighted least squares (WLS) method.

articleTitle: Confusable vehicle feature extraction and recognition based on cascaded SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Target vehicle identification from a large number of confusable vehicles having very similar appearance is significantly needed and plays an important role for management. In this paper, we extracted 6 types of face features of the driver, they are Sobel feature, HoG feature of the whole face, HoG feature of driver's chin, morphological feature in YCbCr Color Space, face energy feature and face triangle feature. We utilize these features to train a cascaded SVM classifier which achieved the excluding of vast amounts of suspected targets and the recognition of target vehicle. Experiments verify that this algorithm is effective and accurate in confusable vehicles recognition.

articleTitle: HOS image similarity measure for human face recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Facial recognition is a very hot topic due to its importance in security, surveillance systems, law enforcement, etc. Many methods are proposed to achieve high accuracy in face recognition but each method has its weaknesses as well as its points of strength. In this paper, we present an effective similarity measure to recognize human faces this measure is called (KSM). The proposed measure is based on the statistical properties of the image by using the high-order statistics (HOS), specifically kurtosis and skewness, for facial recognition. Performance evaluation was conducted using face images from AT&T database and FEI (Brazilian) database. The simulation results show that the proposed measure KSM outperforms the well-known Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) and Feature Similarity Index Measure (FSIM) by the ability to detect similarity even under the difference in illumination, facial expression and pose variations.

articleTitle: A secure control plane for SDN based on Bayesian Stackelberg Games
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Vulnerabilities of controller that is caused by separation of control and forwarding lead to a threat which attacker can take remote access detection in SDN. The current work proposes a controller architecture called secure control plane (SCP) that enhances security and increase the difficulty of the attack through a rotation of heterogeneous and multiple controllers. Specifically, a dynamic-scheduling method based on Bayesian Stackelberg Games is put forward to maximize security reward of defender during each migration. Secondly, introducing a self-cleaning mechanism combined with game strategy aims at improving the secure level and form a closed-loop defense mechanism; Finally, the experiments described quantitatively defender will get more secure gain based on the game strategy compared with traditional strategy (pure and random strategies), and the self-cleaning mechanism can make the control plane to be in a higher level of security.

articleTitle: Research of test modeling and analyzing of warship power system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A test modeling and analyzing method based on relevant model was proposed in this paper. Through establishing the task model, relevant graphical model and relevant mathematical model of the product by this method, the fault diagnosis tree and test prediction of warship system products could be accomplised based on that, and provide a suggestion for optimizing the product diagnosis strategy. Meanwhile, according to the warship power system, the test model, fault diagnosis tree, test prediction and test point optimization were done by this method. The result showed that, this method was intuitive and efficient for test modeling and analysis, and could provide a new idea and means for improving the fault detection and diagnosis capability of warship power systems.

articleTitle: Research and application of illumination processing method in vehicle color recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Accurate recognition of the vehicle color plays an important role in the intelligent transportation systems, and it can make up for the lack that license plates are blocked and corrupted. However, one of the challenges of vehicle color recognition is illumination. In this paper, three kinds of methods are used to process the images, aiming at improving the recognition accuracy of the vehicle color. In order to reach a better result, different methods of processing images and parameters are used for different types of images, so as to improve the accuracy of color recognition, which are different from the previous methods. Experiments show that the method in this paper is better than that of the existing methods.

articleTitle: Security-aware attribute-based access control for fog-based eldercare system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Electronic and remote eldercare is a promising technique in the aging society where security and privacy are crucial issues in the system. In this paper, we propose a security-aware Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) for eldercare system. The elder's health information is encrypted and sent to the fog. The fog processes the data in ciphertext by using homomorphic encryption. Then, the result is forwarded to the caregiver, who is the guardian of the elder. The caregiver judges the elder's health status by decrypting the result. The caregiver sends a medical service request to the medical service provider if the elder is in bad health condition. For preventing irrelevant entities from getting the elder's health information, only the medical service provider who satisfies the access structure can access the data.

articleTitle: Online/offline attribute-based encryption with keyword search against Keyword Guessing Attack
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the exposure of security events in cloud storage, encrypting data before uploading has become the most favorable choice for cloud users, which makes search on encrypted data an important issue. Attribute-based encryption with keyword search (ABKS), which achieves data access control and search on encrypted data at the same time, has risen in response to the proper time and conditions. Traditional ABKS schemes are bounded to low efficiency and the security problem of Keyword Guessing Attack (KGA). We proposed a novel ABKS scheme named O2ABKS, which adopts the online/offline technique to enhance the efficiency, and designs an index generation mechanism that requires the private key of data owner to deal with the challenging concern of KGA. The scheme is proved to be IND-CKA and IND-KGA secure under the standard model. Compared with other schemes, our scheme is more expressive, efficient and applicable to cloud storage.

articleTitle: User-grouping based resource allocation in downlink MU-MIMO systems with proportional fairness
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: User-grouping can significantly reduce the complexity of resource allocation when a base station (BS) serves a multiplicity of users. In this paper, we investigate the resource allocation problem in a multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) system with zero-forcing (ZF) precoding and propose a suboptimal algorithm to solve it. We first calculate the priorities of all active users according to proportional fairness (PF). Then the user with the highest priority is selected, and its corresponding resource block (RB) is decided. Further, other users allocated to the above RB are selected by our proposed user-grouping strategy based on the channel state information (CSI) and spatial correlation. Simulation results show that our new scheme can achieve a good balance between the sum data rate and fairness of users.

articleTitle: A novel power allocation algorithm for D2D communications underlaying full-duplex cellular networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This article puts forward a novel power allocation algorithm to optimize the system performance in half-duplex (HD) device-to-device (D2D) communication underlaying full-duplex (FD) cellular networks. To mitigate the interference between FD cellular and HD D2D communications, an optimization problem is first formulated to maximize the D2D communications while guarantee the quality of FD cellular communications. Furthermore, the achievable rates for both FD cellular and D2D communications are derived. Finally, under a practical condition, which requires that the FD cellular transmissions should be always at work, the optimization problem is solved by optimizing the transmit power at base station (BS), the cellular user equipment (CUE) as well as the D2D user equipment (DUE). Through numerical simulation, we find that the proposed algorithm is effective to achieve a better rate for the D2D communication without decreasing the rates of FD cellular communications.

articleTitle: A short-term power forecasting model for photovoltaic plants based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Short - term power prediction is an important issue in the fine operation and maintenance of photovoltaic power plants. The estimation of power generation of the existing models is based on characteristics such as irradiance. The models are suitable for long-term power forecasting, and not suitable for short-term power forecasting. The irradiance can not be accurately predicted, it is generally obtained from previous years with large particle size such as annual irradiance and monthly irradiance. In this paper, a photovoltaic power generation prediction model - DaPoF model is established based on the data mining method, using the partial least squares regression method. The model uses features that are readily available in daily life, such as month, time, temperature, weather, temperature of the first three days, power generation in the first three days, and weather features within 7 days. The results show that the accuracy of the model reach 83.53% on 5 minute-prediction. So, the model shows advantages of high availability and high accuracy compared with the existing methods.

articleTitle: Prediction models for network multi-source dissemination of information based on multivariate chaotic time series
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Accurately predicting the future tendency of network sentiment plays a critical role in supervising and guiding the diffusion of network public event. In response to the distinction of different network platform in occurring time and dissemination mechanism, according to information diffusion theory, this paper adopts data on multi-platform, which could more completely describe the propagation of hot events. Univariate time series is extended to multivariate time series in order to improve the forecasting accuracy. At the same time, the phase space of multivariate time series from diverse platform is reconstructed and the existence of chaotic characteristic of real multi-source network information diffusion is proved by small-data method. In the end, the predicting model of wavelet neural network based on chaotic time series is constructed to forecast the future public opinion trend of real information. Simulation experiments show that compared with the way of prediction by the unit chaotic time series, multivariate time series has better predictive effects, which provides a new way for forecasting online hotspots.

articleTitle: Group-based association for UAV networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper studies the group strategies of multi-UAVs for network association. The system consists of many small UAVs and two master UAVs. Small UAVs connect to the master UAVs according to their location. They make choices to select different group strategies and the leader of the group. In the group formed by the small UAVs, some small UAVs connect to the master UAVs directly and the others connect to the master UAVs through the leaders they select. In order to achieve two levels of spectrum sharing and transmission power optimization, a group-based algorithm is proposed to optimize the throughput and the cost of the transmission power. The simulation shows that this method is much better than the typically method which only considers spectrum sharing or power optimization. The group-based algorithm improves the throughput of the entire UAVs group and reduces the energy consumption.

articleTitle: Noise benefits of statistics with sign function in robust estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates noise benefits to the statistics with sign function in robust estimation problems. Sign function, as the score function of a robust M-estimator in location estimation, composes a median estimator. We show that, the mean-square error (MSE) of this statistic can be effectively decreased both under the background of the symmetric and asymmetric contamination noise by adding additive noise. Furthermore, the noise-enhanced effect observed in the linear regression estimation demonstrates that the conclusions in the location parameter estimation can be extended to multidimensional parameter estimation tasks.

articleTitle: Locally weighted support vector clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Support vector clustering (SVC) has been successfully used to achieve robust clustering. SVC has the capability of dealing with noise and outliers, and can identify clusters of arbitrary shapes. Moreover, SVC has its superiorities for automatically obtaining the number of clusters and having no requirement for prior knowledge to determine the system topological structure. However, in most cases, it is not possible to choose the best of input parameter values for an input dataset which restricts the application of SVC. In this paper, we propose a support vector clustering approach termed locally weighted support vector clustering, which tackles the automatic parameter estimation problem for SVC. An exponential weighting to each data point is assigned to reflect the within-class importance of different data points in order to detect outliers and noise efficiently. The experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Pulse compression for velocity search based on half precision floating point format
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Traditional methods of target velocity search based on pulse compression using GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) with single precision floating point format are difficult to meet the requirements of real-time processing. In this paper, a novel method for accelerating search process with half precision floating point format, which is based on the latest NVIDIA GPU card Tesla P100, is proposed. The scaling factor is defined to avoid the overflow issues with half precision floating point numbers. And the expression of scaling factor for LFM (Linear frequency modulation) signal is also derived. Measurement results show that about 50% promotion of computation speed is attainable with half precision floating point format when compared to single precision floating point format, which indicates the method can accelerate the searching speed efficiently.

articleTitle: Dynamic Migration of Virtual Links
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The exposure of tenants sensitive information becomes a serious problem in the cloud computing and data center environments. Covert channel attacks are the main ways which steal private information of tenants. The existing defense approaches can defend against attacks, however there are some issues about low success ratio of VNE and low utilization of physical resources. Hence, we propose a Dynamic Migration of Virtual Links (DMVL) method. Firstly, the corresponding migration strategy of virtual links is to maximize the time interval of dynamic migration of virtual links, then remapping goal is to minimize migration cost to reduce migration cost associated with virtual links migration. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach can satisfy the security requirement of tenants on the premise of ensuring the success ratio of virtual network embedding and the utilization of physical resources.

articleTitle: A novel Group Template Pattern Classifiers (GTPCs) method in protein secondary structure prediction
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Protein secondary structure prediction is a fundamental problem and is much more challenging. In this study we propose a novel method called Group Template Pattern Classifiers (GTPCs), which captures the long-range interactions of the whole protein at a great degree. Firstly the protein dataset is divided into several groups based on the length of proteins. The proteins with “similar” length in each group are used to build the prediction model. Then Wavelets are used to extract the features of PSSM profile, and characterize the changing information of PSSM profile. A new protein can be predicted by the corresponding GTPCs model based on the new protein length. Experiments are performed on 25PDB, CB513, CASP9, CASP10, CASP11, and CASP12 datasets, and the good performance of 86.38%, 84.11%, 83.92%, 83.07%, 81.98%, and 82.35% is achieved respectively using 6 GTPCs model. Our experimental results are better than other state of the art methods.(http://qilubio.qlu.edu.cn /protein_GTPC).

articleTitle: Multi domain joint evaluation method for radio frequency stealth performance of airborne electron
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, it designs a method to evaluate the RF (radio frequency) stealth performance of the airborne electronic system which does not depend on the enemy detection equipment and get the RF stealth performance evaluation index. It first analyze the factors that affect the RF stealth performance of the airborne electronic system in the polarization domain, wave domain and energy domain and then build the polarization domain, energy domain and domain waveform RF stealth index. Finally, the multi domain combined evaluation method based on the radiation characteristics of the airborne electronic system is proposed. Simulation results show that RF stealth performance evaluation index can accurately reflect the performance of airborne electronic systems RF stealth.

articleTitle: Power allocation for multiple targets range-only tracking in widely distributed MIMO radar systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Considering the demands of different location estimation performance and less computational complexity for multiple targets tracking, we present a power allocation scheme in distributed multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar systems. Restricted by different location estimation mean square error (MSE) requirements and transmitted power upper bound, combining sequential parameter convex approximation (SPCA) algorithm and heuristic allocation (HA) algorithm, we propose a modified SPCA (MSPCA) algorithm to address the non-convex optimization problem so that the total power budget can be minimized. Extensive simulation results indicate that, compared with uniform allocation (UA) algorithm and HA algorithm, the proposed algorithm presents approximate optimal power budget with much less computational complexity.

articleTitle: Top-down sampling convolution network for face segmentation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The paper adopts two different convolution sampling paths: from large scale to small scale sampling (top-down) and small scale to large scale sampling (bottom-up), and propose the top-down sampling convolution neural network for face segmentation (TDNN). On the LFW and the Helen dataset, it is demonstrated about the advantage of face segmentation by TDNN. In addition, the shared weight is added to each convolution integral, we propose TDNN with shared weight (TDNNSW). On the Helen dataset, TDNNSW with shared weight further improves the accuracy of face segmentation. Since TDNN is trained end-to-end, our model has advantageous properties such as less parameters and more rapid calculation for face segmentation.

articleTitle: The estimation and tracking for frequency offset in faster-than-Nyquist signaling
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Frequency-offset estimation, which is related to the performance of faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) signaling system, is one of the most crucial processes at the receiver. Data aided method has higher accuracy in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) region. However, it need fine estimation and tracking further duo to the presence of residual frequency offset. In this paper, we would attempt to design frame structure and provide estimators for residual frequency offset. Numerical simulations reveal that the satisfactory bit-error ratio (BER) performance can be achieved with the proposed scheme in FTN signaling system.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an intelligent biology vocabulary learning cloud system for college students
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Specialized vocabulary presents a big challenge for college students especially when learning professional science curriculums such as biology, chemistry, etc. The traditional rote memorization, which is used by 89% students in China, has its limitation on efficiency and sustainability. This paper shows a new cloud-based cross-platform vocabulary learning system to give a more efficient and intelligent solution for vocabulary learning. The system can be used to search words, learn vocabulary and make a self-test. The search module contains a multifunctional dictionary, which supports speech recognition, can provide a precise, textbook and bilingual interpretation of a biology word. To learn vocabulary, users can add words to an exclusive word book and revise them anytime they want. The self-test function allows users to check their proficiency. Once a mistake appears, the word will be classified as errors and then added to a unique collection. The range of the test can be customized by users among the word book, error collection, the whole dictionary, or randomly mixed. The system greatly facilitates students' learning process and is expected to improve the learning outcome. Also, the compatibility in different systems enables students to learn vocabulary at any time through a smart phone or a computer.

articleTitle: Modeling large passenger flow safety by simulation and testing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Among various methods of monitoring passenger flow, WiFi sniffer monitoring method has the advantages of simple hardware layout and intermediate monitoring range. In order to ensure the safety of passengers, this paper proposes a novel scheme to calculate the real-time local passenger flow in large area by WiFi sniffer monitoring method. Firstly, the RSSI data of different propagation distances are collected by field testing, and the Kalman filter is used to obtain the optimal estimate of each distance. Secondly, the classical logarithm model of the signal decay is established by using the optimal estimate of each distance. Finally, dynamic threshold function can be generated to divide the passenger flow into smaller passenger flows. Compared with the actual count results, the simulation results of the method has accuracy up to 96%, which makes it possible to be used as the real time basic data of local passenger flow in large area, and help the authorities to formulate relevant measures to ensure the safety of passengers.

articleTitle: Monitoring deployment for rumor spreading in online social networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Along with the explosive growth of online social network, the rumor also takes the opportunity to behave like a tyrant. To defense against rumors, a timely, complete and accurate data acquisition method should be allocated. The monitoring deployment can solve the global data acquisition and real-time network traffic control. To ensure the full coverage with lowest costs, an effective greedy algorithm based on the theory of set cover problem is proposed to implement the monitoring deployment. The experiment is executed in synthetic scale-free networks. And the result shows the proposed deployment method achieves a full coverage efficiently.

articleTitle: HTML5-based interactive media editing system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Media with interactivity can significantly increase the richness and scalability of the video. However, most of the current media formats supporting interactions need to work with the browser plug-ins, while most of the HTML5-based video editing system can only support traditional non-linear editing without supporting the interaction with media. This paper presents an interactive media editing system by leveraging the HTML5 technology. Specifically, we solve three major problems, including the binding of the hotspot and video elements, the tracking of the video objects, and the data storage of project with hotspots. In summary, the proposed editing system can support the addition of hotspots, basic hotspot settings, hotspot tracking function, and so on.

articleTitle: Research on fiber optical sensing technology of monitoring OPLC operation safety condition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Temperature of OPLC cable is related to or even has decided operation Safety of OPLC. Aiming at the operation safety monitoring of OPLC cable, this paper presents a new technology of OPLC cable condition monitoring, state evaluation and fault diagnosis, which consists of information processing and display module, distributed optical fiber temperature measurement module, temperature and humidity monitoring module, power supply Module, current collector and transformer unit. OPLC condition monitoring technology can collect distributed operating temperature of OPLC cable, and other parameters related to distributed operating temperature. Based on information of collecting distributed operating temperature, it would been realized to analyze and evaluate operation condition of OPLC cable, such as OPLC temperature safety assessment, OPLC temperature anomaly state analysis, OPLC aging and residual life calculation, OPLC insulation performance evaluation, PON fiber channel transmission quality evaluation, etc. OPLC condition monitoring and diagnosis technology will provide a new analysis tool for the operation and maintenance of power fiber-to-the-home network, and assist the operation and maintenance personnel to better grasp the operation condition of OPLC cable, and promote and promote the popularization and application of OPLC cable.

Author Keywords: optic fiber composite low voltage cable

articleTitle: Single-image super resolution via hashing classification and sparse representation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Single image super-resolution technology is a fundamental and important issue in the field of computer vision. This paper presents a hash-based classified dictionary learning method to reconstruct images. Firstly, calculate hash value of each image patches and classify the image patches according to its hash values. Then tightly sub-dictionary is learned for each cluster. For a given test image patch, corresponding sub-dictionary is selected by hash value, and then super-resolution reconstruction of this image is complete. The experimental results show that the proposed method is superior to the recently proposed dictionary learning methods for image super-resolution resolution in details and ensures quality of the reconstructed images.

articleTitle: A fully-integrated differential transceiver for C-band radar application
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A fully-integrated differential transceiver for C-band, based on polyphase filters (PPFs) to achieve a high image rejection ratio (IRR), is proposed in the paper. The transceiver meets the requirements for the 5GHz band radar application, which is implemented in 1P6M 0.18μm CMOS technology. The receiver achieves 7.2dB NF, 29.3dB gain and 50.7dB IRR with 3-level digital gain controllability, while draws 93.1mA from 3.3V power supply. The transmitter achieves 16.4dBm output peak power, 29.5dB gain and 65.6dB IRR, which dissipates 138.4mA from 3.3V power supply. The die area is 2.7mm×2.9mm.

articleTitle: The constrained arborescence augmentation problem in digraphs
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The augmentation problem originally determines a minimum weight arc-set that is added to an original network to satisfy a given property. In the real communication network, continuous transmission may lead some transmission lines of this original network to be damaged such that communication network cannot be used. The problem that we consider is how to add other transmission lines to construct a more survivable communication network to service well. In details, we consider the constrained arborescence augmentation problem (CAA, for short) as follows. For a given weighted digraph (or network) D = (V, A; w;T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>), where w:A → R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, is a weighted function and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> (V, A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>) is an arborescence rooted at r in D, we are asked to find an arc-subset A' from A-A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> such that there exists still an arborescence in the new digraph D' = (V, A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> ∪ A'-{a}) for each arc a ϵ A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>, the objective is to minimize the total weight w(A') = Σ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eϵA'</sub> w(e). In this paper, we prove that the CAA problem still remains NP-hard, whose proof follows from a reduction from the 3-dimensional matching. In addition, we present an optimal combinatorial algorithm in O(m + n log n) time to solve this problem for special version where an arborescence in digraph D' = (V, A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> ∪ A'-{a}) still has its fixed root r, for each arc a ϵ A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>.

articleTitle: Adaptive combination of proportionate NSAF algorithm based on coefficient difference
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the convergence performance of the IPNSAF algorithm at a late stage, the IPNSAF algorithm based on coefficient difference (DIPNSAF) is proposed. In the new algorithm, adaptation gain for each tap is proportional to the absolute value of the difference between the current tap-weight estimate and the previous one. Moreover, to overcome the tradeoff of the fixed step-size DIPNSAF between the fast convergence rate and small steady-state misalignment, its convex combination version is proposed. Simulation results for identifying the impulse response with different sparsities have indicated that the proposed algorithms outperform their counterparts.

articleTitle: User information extraction in big data environment
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the era of large data, massive unstructured data contains a wealth of knowledge, and relying on artificial to find this knowledge is unrealistic, so we study the method of extracting attributes and attribute value automatically from unstructured text. We use the structured information box of the Chinese interactive encyclopedia to extract the relationship triples for generating the relationship knowledge base, and then use the relationship knowledge base for the back annotation. The sentence including the tuple is added to training corpus. This method avoids the manual annotation and solves the problem of insufficient training corpus effectively, which is proven by some experiments.

articleTitle: Development of mass spectrometer software project based on CMMI
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to construct and maintain efficient, practical, and high-quality software project for mass spectrometer, this paper adopts waterfall model, and then breaks down the software product to estimate software size through improved-Delphi method. Meanwhile, project size and schedule variance are tracked during project implementation. Experimental results show that, while seamlessly combines spectral peak calculating, external signal measurement, and chemical analysis, project size and schedule variance are both within ±20%, and schedule variance is converged late in the development process. The above results indicate that, implementing CMMI during industrial mass spectrometer software development can efficiently increase productivity and visual management level, and thus leading to broad prospect in application.

articleTitle: Kalman filter based nonlinear estimators of glucose and insulin concentrations
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the physiological treatment of diabetes, there is a pressing need to estimate the plasma and interstitial insulin levels which however are hard and expensive to measure directly and instantaneously. One promising engineering solution is to combine the convenient glucose concentration measurements through the subcutaneous layer with mathematical models of glucose-insulin homeostasis. In this work, we have proposed three Kalman filter based nonlinear estimators of glucose and insulin concentrations composed of the widely used Bergman's minimal model. Numerical results show that all these three Kalman filter based estimators are able to successfully track the plasma glucose and insulin levels from noisy subcutaneous glucose measurements. Furthermore, the Gauss-Hermite filter based estimator achieves the best estimation accuracy in terms of Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) at the expense of relatively slow tracking speed and high computational burden.

articleTitle: 3D cognitive radio: A way to improve spectrum utilization by exploiting the height dimension
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, the height dimension is exploited to improve the spectrum utilization and capacity of cognitive radio networks. As we notice that the majority of primary users are distributed in the low-height places, such as the street, shopping mall, subway, etc. Even in the metropolis full of skyscrapers, the users of primary networks at the top of skyscrapers are still the minorities. Thus the spectrum opportunities in the height dimension exist. Using directional antenna, the interference to primary users can be coordinated. This paper explores the possibility of height-dimensional spectrum access and constructs three-dimensional (3D) cognitive radio. Meanwhile, the conditions to exploit height-dimensional spectrum opportunities are provided and the relations are simulated.

articleTitle: Architecture design of avionics simulation configuration control system based on AADL
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Avionics simulation configuration control system (ASCCS) is a novel solution for the hardware-in-the-loop simulation of the avionics, which can avoid the complex reconnection due to the change of the configuration. This paper presents an architecture design method of the ASCCS based on AADL. According to the requirement analysis of the ASCCS, the AADL architecture model is designed in three levels: system level, task level and behavior level. The system-level design builds the top frame. The task-level design expounds the task process. And the behavior-level design describes the detail execution. Finally, through the consistency evaluation and the behavior verification, the correctness and performance of the proposed architecture are also verified.

articleTitle: Directionlet transform based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Directionlet transform belongs to third generation wavelet transform and it has been widely applied in many fields like image processing, fault diagnosis, medical imaging and so on. Although the separability, second sampling, the simplicity of calculation and design of the filter of the two-dimensional wavelet transform filter are preserved in directionlet transform, there also exists a problem of computing speed, that is, it would cost too much time when the test data is large. To solve the problem mentioned above, an efficient parallel algorithm based on the Graphics Processor Unit (GPU) using the Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the test images are decomposed into two cosets according to the generator matrix. Then the cosets are restored to normal matrixes by matrix transposition. Finally, we take the unequal number of one-D WT along the transform direction and queue direction to complete the directionlet transform. Besides, we use the shared memory and constant memory inside GPU to speed up the algorithm, that is achieving the parallelization. A group of images with different size are tested in the experiment before we draw a conclusion. The speed-up ratio of the parallel algorithm of directionlet transform based on GPU is about five to ten times than that on CPU. Thus, this algorithm can reduce running time significantly.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of karaoke system based on Android platform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of mobile internet and the improvement of culture life standards, people are no longer satisfied with the traditional mobile applications based on pictures and text. Video and audio applications have gradually become the focus of development. In this paper, we design and implement a karaoke system based on Android platform. The system is a typical C/S mode, the client has the functions of song retrieval (including humming search), audio recording, MV recording, singing score, and the server uses the classic JavaEE three tier architecture which is consists of Struts, Spring and Hibernate. The data of the system is stored by MySQL. We have improved the humming retrieval algorithm and singing scoring algorithm. After testing and running, the system achieves the predetermined target requirements, and has a certain stability and high software quality.

articleTitle: Integrity monitoring with MAIME upon integrated GNSS/SINS for SGEs
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: An integration of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) and Strapdown Inertial Navigation System (SINS) have revolutionized navigation industries significantly. However, the integrated GNSS/SINS system has the highest potential for detecting slowly growing errors (SGEs), which is the most difficult to detect in navigation field at the same time. A novel methodology has been developed for failure identification upon GNSS/SINS for SGEs. It is applicable to carrying on the integrated navigation Kalman filter and new dimension measurements, which makes full use of the historical epochs for multi-step extrapolation. Moreover, we manage to provide more effective test statistics compared with widely used Autonomous Integrity Monitoring by Extrapolation Method (AIME), which is called Enhanced Autonomous Integrity Monitoring by Extrapolation Method (EAIME). Correspondingly, theoretical thresholds of different false alarm are put forward. Making full use of the numerical modeling and test statistic approach, simulation results show that the statistics of EAIME could achieve better performance compared with classic AIME.

articleTitle: Study on soft combination for spectrum sensing in cognitive vehicular ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The increasing demand of vehicular network oriented applications (both safety and non-safety related services) would undoubtedly lead to shortage of spectral resource which is a challenge for vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication networks. As a promising solution to meet the increasing demand of spectrum resource, cognitive radio (CR) technology has attracted much attention. Compared with general communication environment, vehicle environment has its own features such as movement of second users (SU) that can be negative to the performance of spectrum sensing. In this paper, we introduce a cooperative spectrum sensing (CSS) scheme in vehicle environment where we reduce the spatial correlation between samples and improve detection probability in region with low signal-to-noise (SNR) and a soft combination rule is proposed where different ways are used to aggregate samples. Simulation results show that our scheme can significantly increase the detection probability in low SNR region with a slight loss in region with high SNR.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of ICM channel estimation with interpolations in OFDM/OQAM system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In OFDM/OQAM system, channel estimation is an important and a hard part in frequency selective fading channel. ICM is an efficient estimation method since its little pilot symbols and good estimation accuracy. The channel frequency response of non-pilot symbol can be obtained by interpolation and different interpolation methods have different influence on performance of system. In this paper, different types of interpolation methods are simulated including direct, poly and domain transform interpolation, with different pilot intervals. The simulation result shows that there is little different about NMSE and BER performance among the interpolation methods with small interval. Conversely, when the interval becomes larger, the NMSE and BER performance of the interpolation methods gets worse quickly, but domain transform interpolation can still hold accuracy compared with other interpolation methods.

articleTitle: Research of news text with word frequency statistics and user information
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the news collection of a single topic, analyzes the large number of keywords and phrases in the news, uses the traditional TF-IDF algorithm based on the word frequency, adds the weight to the tags, extracts the keywords which have certain use value in the news, and uses the tag selection formula to tag the news. In addition, collect user reviews on the Internet news portal to create user comments information tags library for the news tag group to make the news tags more fit user needs. In this paper, the value of the tag is measured by the recall rate and the F1 score, and the tag based on the news content is analyzed according to the intermediate variable in the model operation. It also summarizes the general content of the topic by analyzing the tags distribution of the news collection.

articleTitle: Time difference of arrival passive location algorithm based on grey wolf optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the nonlinear equation problems of time difference of arrival (TDOA) passive location, this paper proposes the improved grey wolf optimization (IGWO) algorithm. By adding the individual learning strategy to the standard grey wolf optimization (GWO) algorithm, and taking trigonometric function nonlinear convergence factor to balance the exploration ability and development ability, the proposed algorithm can search optimal coordinates of TDOA passive location. Simulation results show that the modified algorithm has stable performance and simple controlling parameters. The algorithm can quickly approach the global optimal solution with the small scale of wolf pack, and has faster convergence speed and higher locating precision.

articleTitle: A new color-to-gray conversion framework based on normalized cross correlation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays the color-to-gray conversion has many practical applications in many areas such as image editing, printing, pattern recognition and so on. Many recent researches have shown that the optimal weighted coefficients of the linear model could be applied to the color-to-gray conversion. In this work, an optimized framework to choose the optimal weights is proposed. This framework is based on maximizing the Normalized Cross Correlation. Using this framework we propose four different algorithms for the optimal coefficient determination. Experimental results demonstrate the advantages of the proposed framework, which is simple, practicable and effective.

articleTitle: Erasure code of small file in a distributed file system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of Internet applications, the data storage of many applications has some new characters. There always exists a huge amount of pictures in distributed file systems, and the size of these pictures is usually no more than 1M bytes. To meet the demands in small file storage system which contains so many pictures, we provide a kind of distributed file system to store large amounts of small files. In our system, small files (actual data files) are merged into large files (default 64M) which we call block, and we use two-indexed way to reduce the pressure of nameserver, which maintains the information of correspondence between blocks and dataservers. The result shows that the memory usage of block information in nameserver is less than 2G when the system capacity is 1PB. It shows good scalability. Meanwhile, to reduce the cost of storage, we introduce the technique of erasure code which is an alternative offers the same data protection but reduces significantly the storage consumption. After grouping, the cost of storage dropped by 25% compared with 2 replications.

articleTitle: Automatic vision inspection system for printing registration accuracy
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Registration accuracy is one of the important performances indictor for the quality of printing. In order to overcome the disadvantages of traditional manual to inspect register accuracy lead to slow efficiency and low precision, an automatic vision inspection system was designed. Register crossline mark images were collected. The crosslines were segmented by FCM algorithm. Based on Hough transform, a method was proposed to extract the edge features of crosslines. The system was visually calibrated and the distances between crosslines were measurement to get the registration accuracy. MATLAB GUI function was used to design system software. Results show that this system having high detection accuracy is feasible.

articleTitle: Visual tracking using super-pixel local weighted measure and inverse sparse model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, sparse representation and super-pixel mid-level cues have been applied to visual tracking with demonstrated success. The authors propose an efficient and precise tracking algorithm, it has three features: super-pixel local weight, a novel sparse model and double threshold scheme to determine weight update. In the super-pixel local weight, the authors segment the surrounding target regions into super-pixels in stage of training, and then apply mean-shift on the surrounding target regions super-pixels to obtain clusters. A confidence map is calculated according to the clusters. After that, we combine the template super-pixels with the confidence map to compute the initial super-pixel local weight. The inverse sparse model is adopted to improve the tracking efficiency. For double threshold super-pixel updates, we compare the super-pixels update areas with the double threshold to decision update or not. Experimental results show that our method is robust to illumination change, human body posture change and heavy occlusion.

articleTitle: A temporal approximation-based role mining approach for TRBAC
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, Role Based Access Control(RBAC) has become the de facto access control model and organizations usually adopt role mining to define a set of roles from existing user-permission assignments. However, there is few approaches to generate roles for Temporal Role Based Access Control (TRBAC), the extension of RBAC with temporal constraints. In this paper, we propose a temporal approximation-based role mining approach for TRBAC which can be applied to large-scale dataset and generate the minimal number of roles with all user-permission assignments preserved by allowing mismatches in temporal components. The experiment results demonstrates the viability of our approach.

articleTitle: Iterative auxiliary pilots channel estimation for OFDM/OQAM systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To the channel estimation problems of offset quadrature amplitude modulation/orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OQAM/OFDM) systems, this paper proposed an iterative scattered pilot channel estimation method. Through analysis the intrinsic imagine interference, this paper indicated to the low performance problem with common scattered pilot channel estimation methods. This paper decreased the number of the data symbol that whose interference canceled by the auxiliary pilot, and utilized an iterative process to cancel the interference of other data symbols. The simulation results shown that the proposed method has a better channel estimation performance when the auxiliary pilot power is the same as average data power.

articleTitle: A secure algorithm for image based information hiding with one-dimensional chaotic systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The goal of information hiding is to securely hide important information within digital documents such as files, images and videos. In this paper, we develop a new method that can efficiently and securely embed a sequence of binary bits into a gray-scale image in two stages. In the first stage, the sequence is divided into a few subsequences of equal length and a set of one-dimensional logistic mappings are used to shuffle the binary bits in the sequence. In the second stage, the shuffled sequence is divided into regions of equal length and the regions are sequentially embedded into the corresponding pixels in the given gray-scale image. The embedding of a region in the shuffled sequence is performed by replacing the least significant bits of the gray value of the corresponding pixel with the bits in the region. Analysis and testing results show that this information hiding algorithm can securely embed information into a gray-scale image without altering the content of image significantly and thus can potentially be used in practice for secure image-based information hiding.

articleTitle: Network coding resources optimization of coding-link cost based on the modified ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The network coding always brings additional resource consumption while it can make the network to achieve the required rate. It is necessary to minimize the resource consumption in the network while achieving the desired throughput. Most of the other papers consider the minimum number of encoding nodes or the minimum number of encoding links separately. Of course some papers consider trade-offs between coding and link cost, but the optimal choice for different trade-offs is not clear. This paper provides a heuristic judgment method to derive the optimal result on the selection. In this paper, the total value of the link cost and coding cost is treated as the only objective function, and the objective function is minimized based on the improved ant colony algorithm. The consideration of multi-source situation and the different value of different links is a new attempt.

articleTitle: A new construction of lightweight MDS matrices
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Since maximum distance separable (MDS) matrices can be used as the best building blocks of diffusion layer of block cipher or hash functions, extensive studies have been investigated. In this article, we provide a new method to search lightweight MDS matrices. By providing a new matrix representation of elements of finite fields and observing the special form of the matrices, we exhibit new search algorithms that greatly reduce the search space and make lightweight MDS matrices with low XOR counts. We provide the non-involutory MDS matrices with the least possible XOR gates for dimension 4×4 over finite fields GF(2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) and GF(2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>) respectively. Compared to the best known matrices, our new candidates have advantages for hardware implementation.

articleTitle: A homology and AOA based hole healing strategy in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Coverage hole healing is one significant part in deployment of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In this paper, we propose a decentralized homology and angle of arrival (AOA) based coverage hole healing strategy in wireless sensor networks. Our strategy exploits movement-assisted redundant nodes to repair coverage holes in interesting area which is partly covered by wireless sensors that are not required to move. Each process of repairing work heals part of coverage hole as well as shrinks the hole size. The hole healing mission would be completed iteratively. Simulation results show that our strategy could repair coverage holes to achieve over 99.5% average coverage ratio when the number of sensors deployed is adequately large to meet the necessary requirement of total coverage. Our strategy utilizes AOA for hole healing and simulation results show that our strategy could tolerate low degree AOA estimation error without obvious coverage ratio loss.

articleTitle: Security analysis of DoS attack against the LTE-A system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: LTE-Advanced (LTE-A) has become a mature communication system in the world, and its security is attracting more and more attention. Although the LTE-A is significantly improved in functionality and security. However, there are also attacks against the LTE-A network. This paper first studies the specifications of non-access-stratum (NAS) of Evolved UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTrAn) and uncovers two new denial of service (DoS) vulnerabilities about Tracking Area Update (TAU) procedure. Then we construct the attack scenarios based on the previous analysis. Finally using related devices including mobile phones and eNodeB simulator, we demonstrate the attacks about these vulnerabilities and obtain the corresponding results.

articleTitle: Research on reliability design of network nodes in operational command and control system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the problem of dual computer hot standby for key nodes, a new reliability design is put forward to enhance their usability in operational command and control system based on information exchange device. The original data exchange module can be replaced perfectly. The result does not affect the primitive design and function, but further support dynamically modifying network configuration, outputting priority of the device. This method can be applied widely in dual computer hot standby with higher performance demand.

articleTitle: An improved deep feature learning method for person re-identification
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Deep learning methods are widely used for person re-identification recently and outperform other methods. Models that combines identification and verification are proposed to learn feature embedding to satisfy intra-class compactness and inter-class dispension. However, sampling pairs in verification model remains complicated for it may not only create a large amount of redundant data but reduce the model accuracy. To this end, we propose an improved convolutional neural network whose verification model learns similarity by the distance between a training example and its center in favor of that of two examples so that no more sampling needed. Experimental results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with other leading methods on the benchmark datasets such as Market-1501 and CUHK03.

articleTitle: Research of multi-pattern matching algorithm based on characteristic value
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Large-scale and high-speed networks cause rapid increase in network flow, resulting in the omission of reports of the intrusion detection based on the string pattern matching algorithm. In this paper, a multi pattern matching algorithm C_MPM based on characteristic value is proposed. In the algorithm, the rule base is classified two times according to the length and the characteristic value, and obtains various pattern string queues, which can reduce the number of string matches that each text string needs to match each time; Secondly, the characteristic values of text strings of different lengths in the matching window are calculated in parallel, and the pattern string queues in the rule base are searched according to the length and the characteristic values of the text string, so that the full mode pattern matching can be carried out. The experimental results show that the time performance of the matching algorithm C_MPM is better than that of the AC_BMSH2 algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on data block storage strategy in cloud storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development and progress of computer technology, data computing has been moving from traditional computing to cloud computing gradually. Cloud storage technology is an important part of cloud computing technology, and the replica technology is the key technology in the cloud storage system. According to the thinking of replica technology, this paper presents a new model of cloud storage problem, links the storage reliability to the physical performance of the underlying storage disk by modeling. Use the optimization algorithm to obtain the optimal solution. At the same time, we propose a new data block storage strategy. The MATLAB simulation results show that the new strategy can get the similar solution and reduce the operation time greatly compared to the optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: 4G client remotely monitors the equipment of PROFIBUS-DP field bus based on cloud server and Android system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To achieve the purpose of linking field bus of PROFIBUS-DP to 4G communication module, and fulfilling the purpose of fast, convenient, and real-time remote monitoring the devices on the PROFIBUS-DP bus through mobile 4G network. In this paper, we proposes an embedded gateway method to realize seamless connection of these two heterogeneous networks, to achieve the purpose of remote monitoring the equipment on the PROFIBUS-DP filedbus through the ubiquitous 4G mobile network. The PROFIBUS-DP field bus data to the cloud server through the 4G communication module via a gateway, uploading the field bus data to the cloud server through the 4G communication module, and then the PROFIBUS-DP field devices can be viewed and controlled on the Android client.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of extended Kalman filter and particle filter in satellite relative measurement
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Satellite formation flying has arisen much attention in various space missions due to its wide application, low cost and strong adaptability. As relative position and attitude measurement is essential to satellite formation flying, a RF-based measurement model has been proposed in this paper. Two algorithms, extended Kalman filter (EKF) and particle filter (PF) are employed to estimate parameters of satellite relative position and attitude. Estimation performance of the two algorithms is analyzed and compared through simulations under different conditions. Comparison results show that both EKF and PF algorithms have respective advantages and disadvantages. By analysis and simulations, the paper provides a guidance that helps to choose proper filters to achieve better estimation performance in the scenario of satellite formation flying.

articleTitle: Spatial-polarization performance of hexapolarized MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) systems with six distinguishable electric and magnetic states of polarization is suggested to achieve full rank of six, which result in a total of six polarization degrees of freedom. As non-ignorable correlation still exist between such hexapolarized MIMO sub-channels, joint utilization of space and polarization diversity may decrease the correlation coefficients. A hybrid hexapolarized MIMO system model is established to study how hybrid diversity reduces sub-channel correlations. In such model, sub-channel correlations of hybrid diversity MIMO system are simulated from a discrete distribution of scatters. Simulation is made to check whether decreasing of such correlations is helpful to system performance, and it results in a limited increasing of channel capacity.

articleTitle: Research on abnormal traffic classification of web camera based on supervised learning and semi — Supervised learning
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The botnet is currently the biggest threat to cyber security, and the webcam is an important component of botnets.
