Therefore, it has attracted much attention to research communities, and its related standardization activities have been progressed. In this paper, we summarize the standardization activities on data aware networking (DAN) which corresponds to ICN in ITU-T. Thereinto, our contributions in recommendation Y. Suppl. 35 (ITU-T Y.3033 - Data aware networking: Scenarios and use cases) has been highlighted.

articleTitle: A two-stage stochastic model for cloud computing simulation of resource efficiency cost analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cloud computing has changed the traditional way of the Internet resource provision into the pay-per-use, but how to evaluate the performance and the Quality of service(QoS) by using simulation tool is a complex problem given the limits of physical resource. Considering these issues, we design a two-stage stochastic model based on queueing network theory for the cloud computing simulation. It composes the complete structure of Infrastructure as a Service and can be used to analyze the performance and the resource utilization rate under different running environments and resource specifications. To demonstrate the validity of the model, an example of the minimum resource for QoS guaranteeing search (MROGS) algorithm which can search the suitable threshold of resource size is given. The simulation results indicate that the model can accurately present the real performance of cloud computing platform, and the MROGS algorithm can find a suitable resource threshold to achieve higher resource utilization rate and assure the QoS simultaneously.

articleTitle: A new type of portable MANET terminal with two modes of CSMA and SOTDMA
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) is a new multi-hop, temporary, self-organizing network composed of wireless mobile nodes. As a flexible and infrastructure-less network, it has great potential applications in mobile communication. However, contention-based MAC protocols in MANET such as Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Avoidance (CSMA/CA) can't ensure a reliable channel transmission because of the access collisions. Although slot-based MAC protocols such as Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) can solve the collisions' problem, the network throughput rate of TDMA is less than CSMA/CA with small nodes. In this paper, the design and implementation of a portable MANET communication terminal are presented, which can support both CSMA and Self-Organized Time Division Multiple Access (SOTDMA) in order to take the advantages of CSMA and Time Division Multiple Address (TDMA) in different scenarios. In addition to the common functionality of text, voice and video transmission, it also provides emergency and military application oriented functions, such as network switching, situation awareness, data encryption, time synchronization, text-to-speech conversion, and network authentication and so on.

articleTitle: Joint domain based massive access for small packets traffic of uplink wireless channel
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The fifth generation (5G) communication scenarios such as the cellular network and the emerging machine type communications will produce massive small packets. To support massive connectivity and avoid signaling overhead caused by the transmission of those small packets, this paper proposes a novel method to improve the transmission efficiency for massive connections of wireless uplink channel. The proposed method combines compressive sensing (CS) with power domain NOMA jointly, especially neither the scheduling nor the centralized power allocation is necessary in the method. Both the analysis and simulation show that the method can support up to two or three times overloading.

articleTitle: Energy diversity and opportunistic energy harvesting based cooperative communication with SWIET under RF interference
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Wireless powered relaying is a promising cooperative communication technique which has drawn much attention recently. In this paper, we investigate a cooperative communication system where a source node (SN) communicates with a destination node (DN) with the help of an energy-constrained relay node (RN) in the presence of interference. We consider a general scenario where a direct link between SN and DN is available, though the quality may be poor due the long distance or obstacles between the two nodes. Based on the concepts of energy diversity (ED) and opportunistic energy harvesting (OEH), we first provide a new ED-OEH protocol, which allows RN harvests energy or processes information on a time-frame basis. Then, under the ED-OEH protocol, we propose a novel wireless power and information transfer algorithm for the cooperative communication system, which can adaptively switch the relay operation mode according to the amount of harvested energy, the interference power and the quality of the system links to efficiently utilize the ED of the direct link and achieve OEH in the investigated system to improve the system throughput. To verify the performance of our proposed algorithm, we conduct comprehensive computer simulations with various system settings. Simulation results show that our proposed scheme achieves significant throughput gains over the existing schemes in literature.

articleTitle: An improved time-domain channel estimation using compressive sensing based on wavelet transform multicarrier modulation system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Compared with OFDM, wavelet-based multi-carrier modulation system, due to the utilization of wavelet basis to construct the channels, have not only the orthogonal sub-channels but also the orthogonal transmission symbols of each sub-channel, which means it can resist ICI effectively without inserting CP. These characteristics brings great improvement of the system spectrum utilization and makes wavelet-based multi-carrier modulation system get wide attention. But the widespread use of the system is limited by high complexity of its channel estimation technology. In this paper, an improved time-domain channel estimation technique based on compressive sensing is proposed. According to the estimation feature of compressive sensing, pilot symbols are randomly inserted in time-domain, and the number of pilot symbols depends on the channel sparseness. Using the quasi-Toeplitz to construct the observation matrix makes CS channel estimation has better BER performance than traditional method. Furthermore, constructing index set using the received pilot signal and the local pilot by cross-correlation and estimating the number of iterations of the OMP reconstruction algorithm that reduces the number of iterations and the time required for the algorithm under the same reconstruction rate. In general, an improved time-domain CS channel estimation for wavelet transform multi-carrier modulation effectively reduces the system overhead and improves the precision of spectrum utilization, greatly improves the accuracy of channel estimation.

articleTitle: Network traffic measurement and management in software defined networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Enhancing the computer network, at both the performance and resource usage levels, are major objectives of Traific Engineering (TE). This paper describes deployment of well-known principles of TE in combination with new approach for building networks - Software-Defined Networking (SDN). Proposed solution realizes measurement of specific network parameters. Measurement is realized using standard OpenFlow or ICMP messages. Based on measurement, proposed tunnel selection algorithm performs critical decision-making. Selection of optimal path from the source to the destination improves network resources usage and may result in increased quality of experience (QoE). Proposed TE approach was implemented and evaluated to verify its contribution.

articleTitle: A CBPSOGSA-SVM hybrid system for classification
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The feature subset selection and parameter optimization influence the classification accuracy of support vector machines (SVM) significantly. In order to solve the problems and improve the performance of SVM for classification, a new proposed chaos-optimized binary version of PSOGSA which is the hybrid of particle swarm optimization (PSO) and gravitational search algorithm (GSA), termed CBPSOGSA, is developed in this paper to build a novel hybrid system (CBPSOGSA-SVM) for classification. In this system, features and SVM parameters are encoded together to form the binary code strings and the feature subset and SVM parameters are optimized simultaneously. A proper fitness function is also designed to convert this multi-objective optimization problem to be single objective, meanwhile, evaluate the binary code strings produced by CBPSOGSA. Eight standard datasets are employed in experiments to validate the performance of the proposed CBPSOGSA-SVM hybrid system for classification. The binary version of both PSO and PSOGSA are also used to do comparisons. The results of experiments demonstrate that the proposed CBPSOGSA-SVM hybrid system for classification is effective and has better performance and stronger capability of searching for the global best solutions.

articleTitle: Method for predicting hot spot residues at protein-protein interface based on the extreme learning machine
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Protein binding hot spots are those residues that locate at the interfaces of protein-protein interaction, which can influence the interaction of proteins significantly, although they consist of a small part of the interface residues only. Since traditional experimental methods for prediction of hot spots are quite complex and time-consuming, then recently, bioinformatics methods are adopted as efficient tools in the area of hot spots prediction at protein-protein interface. In this paper, a novel prediction model is proposed for the prediction of hot spots at the protein-protein interaction interfaces based on the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) and a new way for feature selection. Different from existing methods, the selection of the classifier in our method included two parts: the first part aimed for deleting some redundant features from the original features without prediction, and the second part aimed for constructing our final prediction model based on the prediction. Our major contribution was that the ELM and a new prediction model were introduced into the area of hot spots prediction, which could improve the prediction performance remarkably, when comparing with some traditional existing methods. And the simulation results based on two benchmark datasets ASEdb and BID showed that the newly proposed prediction model outperformed some of the existing well known methods such as the Robetta, KFC, and HotPoint, etc.

articleTitle: A dynamic network anomaly detection method based on trend analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Detecting abnormal behavior during network evolution is an important and challenging data analysis task at present, it is named as dynamic network anomaly detection in this paper. The network abnormal behavior differs from that of normal behavior, the probability of occurrence stays relatively low but may cause serious damages once happened. This paper takes the topological structure of the network as the research object and identifies the network anomaly through the change of network structure. Based on Cox-stuart test, we put forward a new type of method to detect dynamic anomaly. This method refers to an alarm of monitoring the trend change of the network structure parameters. Finally, an experiment was carried out in the real dynamic network-Enron Email Network, which verified that the dynamic network anomaly detection method proposed in this paper can effectively detect the network anomaly behavior.

articleTitle: Future access network framework and capability research
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: More and more social needs inject more complex social characteristics into future access network and cloud computing converging with access network supports more services. This paper proposes a novel framework and indicator for modeling the future access network. The framework frames the future access network in four dimensions: Highlevel Physical Capability, Softwarization & Virtualization, Service-Oriented Dynamic Networking and Deep Coupling with Social Elements. Based on this framework, an indicator is given which is used to optimize access network capability. Evaluation results demonstrate the framework and the indicator can make networking and service deployment clear and effective.

articleTitle: Research on inventory collaborative supply for multi-industrial chains based on cloud services platform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to effectively reduce industrial chain inventory cost and cut down supply disruption risks, this paper studied inventory collaborative supply for multi-industrial chains in a cloud environment. After analyzing a cross industrial chain supply mode of multi-industrial chains collaboration based on cloud services platform, an inventory collaborative supply model for multi-industrial chains based on demand forecast (Q, R) strategy was established, and the demand forecast strategy which based on exponential smoothing method was proposed to obtain the cycle purchasing quantity. Then a supply source selection optimization algorithm of cross industrial chain inventory supply based on k-means clustering algorithm was proposed to obtain the optimal supply source in the model. Research shows that the cross industrial chain supply mode was obviously superior to tradition inventory supply mode in reducing inventory costs and shortage cost.

articleTitle: The behaviors of heterogeneous users in a geo-location database-assisted cognitive network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cognitive radio is emerging as a promising technique to improve the utilization of the under-utilized spectrum. The success of cognitive technology relies on the robust detection of the radio environment (e.g., locating the idle channels). Geo-location databases are designed to provide idle unlicensed TV channels list to cognitive users and hence can help reduce the need for energy-intensive processes (such as spectrum sensing). In this paper, the behaviors of cognitive users in a geo-location database-assisted cognitive network is deeply investigated. These cognitive users can subscribe to database and randomly access available channels or perform spectrum sensing to utilize more suitable channels or purchase spectrum from licensed user to access some channels exclusively. The best response of strategy of heterogeneous cognitive users is discussed specifically. Meanwhile, a dynamic updating process in which each cognitive user can change its strategy at every time-slot is presented. The stable condition for this dynamic strategy-selection scheme and the network equilibrium are studied. The numerical simulation results show that the proposed model captures the main factors of the strategy selection process for these heterogeneous cognitive users, significantly reduces the superfluous sensing consumption, and improves system performance to the utmost extent. The proposed method can represent a promising framework for the design of cognitive radio systems.

articleTitle: A fast multi-patterns parallel matching algorithm for massive HTTP data processing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The development of data services in wireless mobile networks leads to the tremendous growth of net users, making user behavior grow rapidly. And it brings a great opportunity for researchers to analyze user behavior through large-scale network traffic, which is not only significant for Internet Service Providers (ISP) to optimize resource allocation, but also can provide users with more customized service. The analysis of user behavior is based on the extraction of user characteristics, and multi-patterns URL matching is the foundation. However, the efficiency of extracting user behavior from massive network traffic data is still a huge challenge problem. This paper focuses on the efficiency of extracting user characteristics and proposes a novel algorithm, Multi-Patterns Parallel Matching on HTTP Traffic (MPPM) that takes advantage of the hash map in data searching, and it can extract user behavior from massive HTTP traffic more effective and faster than conventional methods with the same accuracy. Experiments are conducted by using real-world HTTP traffic data collected from the ISP networks. It is demonstrated that the proposed algorithm is superior to the known methods, as well as the capacity of dealing with massive HTTP traffic data. The implementation of MPPM algorithm will be a solid base to build a high-performance analysis engine of user behavior for massive HTTP data processing.

articleTitle: Iterative alternating water-filling for wireless powered MIMO multiple-access channels
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Consider a wireless powered Gaussian multiple access channel (MAC), which consists of a power station (PS), multiple passive users and a sink node. Assume that each node is equipped with multiple antennas, and the PS has reliable power supply while the users have to harvest energy from the PS by wireless power transfer (WPT). The harvest-then-transmit scheme is adopted where all users harvest energy in the downlink (DL) timeslot, and then send their own information to the sink by time-division-multiple-access (TDMA) protocol in the uplink (UL) timeslot. The sum throughput maximization problem is investigated by jointly optimizing time allocation and precoding design. We first formulate the optimal design as a convex semidefinite programming, and an iterative alternating water filling solution is proposed to serve as a low-complexity implementation. The optimality of the DL beamforming scheme is proved. By investigating a special case where each user sends only one data stream to the sink, we propose a suboptimal scheme to further reduce the implementation complexity but incur little performance loss. Simulation results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Sparse channel estimation based on BP-MF improved algorithm in SC-FDE system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A low complexity sparse Bayesian channel estimation algorithm has been proposed for SC-FDE receiver. The algorithm of combined belief propagation with mean field (BP-MF) applied into the Bayesian Hierarchical prior Model is obtained at first, and then use the algorithm of an generalized approximate message passing (GAMP) by approximating the algorithm of BP. Then the channel estimated values that are obtained in first iteration are sorted from big to small, and these small values are deleted to further reduce the complexity of computational. Finally, the MF method is applied to the Frequency Domain Equalization. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method has nearly the same performance compared to the MF algorithm in estimation precision of the channel and Bit Error Rate (BER), and it also has much less computational complexity.

articleTitle: Trust and privacy in mobile participatory sensing: Current trends and future challenges
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the prominent advantages of sensing, processing, and storage resources available in current mobile phones, numerous and unique research challenges arise from mobile participatory sensing paradigm. Nowadays, mobile consumer devices are also increasingly used as personal sensing instruments, where users record their daily habits, track their physical activity, or monitor their health. In the absence of any protection mechanisms, most of these applications may however endanger the privacy of the participants and end users. Consequently, mobile phone users may also reluctant to contribute reliable data to the sensing campaigns and this would affect the relevance of sensing campaigns deployed at large scale as well as limiting the benefits to the users. By empowering people to contribute reliable data and encounter the risk that a user's privacy might be compromised and mechanisms to preserve user privacy are also mandatory. In this survey, we present a brief overview of existing privacy implications used in current participatory sensing applications, analyze different protection goals and assess the threats to user privacy when personal information is sensed and disclosed. We outline the latest trends in the area of trust and privacy in mobile participatory sensing campaigns. Based on our findings, we further provide an overview of current trends and future research challenges in this area.

articleTitle: An adaptive method for N-dimensional tensor factorization on sparse data processing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Big data produced in our life implies rich information and can help us better understand the world when used correctly. However, the data collected is always too sparse to be directly applied. Tensor factorization as an extension of matrix factorization has been more and more popular on data mining. The classical methods for tensor factorization are all for dense tensors, which is no longer efficient for sparse data tensor. The most-used factorization method for sparse tensor also exists some problems, such as long convergence time, low fitting precision, complex parameter settings and so on. In this paper, we propose an adaptive stochastic gradient descent method, called RMSGD for N-dimensional tensor factorization to deal with data sparsity problem and predict the missing values in a sparse tensor precisely. We evaluate our method based on two real data sets, i.e., the GPS trajectories generated by 2000 taxis in Beijing and the 311 complaint data collected from New York City (NYC). The results demonstrate that the effectiveness and efficiency of our method are better than the baseline approaches.

articleTitle: CPCR: Contact-prediction clustering-based routing in large-scale urban Delay Tolerant Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Routing in Public Transport Networks is particularly challenging due to the high mobility, rapidly changing topology. Though clustering of nodes can aid forwarding decision in these Delay Tolerant Networks (DTNs), centralized clustering cannot adapt to large scale DTNs for the temporary connections. Moreover, it is critical to choose proper clustering metrics. In this paper, we propose a contact-predict clustering-based routing algorithm, CPCR, for large-scale urban DTNs. This algorithm computes the probability for each node pair and cluster nodes into higher contact-strength clusters using nodal local contact information in a distributed way. Depending on the clusters, intra-cluster and inter-cluster routing strategies will be adopted. Extensive simulations indicate that CPCR maintains relatively stable clusters and enhances the routing performance. The results demonstrate that clustering-based routing algorithm is rational and promising for large-scale urban DTNs.

articleTitle: Full-duplex single-RF MIMO with coordinate-interleaved space-time coding
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we aim at improving the transmission reliability of multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) enabled full-duplex (FD) system. To this end, we investigate the implementation of coordinate interleaved orthogonal design (CIOD) based space-time block code in bidirectional FD system, and propose a novel scheme named CI-FD. Theoretical analysis proves that this scheme is able to achieve the full diversity gain of the CIOD technique when the self-interference (SI) of the FD system is effectively suppressed, while maintaining the same spectral efficiency and decoding complexity as the original FD system. Moreover, two performance enhancing schemes based on CI-FD are proposed: 1) CI-FD with antenna selection (AS) that further increases the diversity gain, and 2) CI-FD with spatial modulation (SM) that provides an additional spectral efficiency gain. Upper bounds on the average bit error probabilities of the proposed schemes are derived and their error-free information transmission capabilities are also investigated. Simulation results verify our analysis and demonstrate the advantages of the proposed schemes.

articleTitle: Robust beamforming optimization for multi-group multicast system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In next-generation wireless communication systems, multimedia multicast could improve spectrum efficiency markedly. In this paper, a angle-based limited feedback model is built for downlink multi-group multicast systems. Two parts of the channel state information (CSI), i.e., the quantized channel direction information (CDI) and the accurate channel quality information (CQI) are fed back to the base station (BS) simultaneously, where a proper codebook is shared by all users in the system and the BS. With the imperfect CSI available at the BS, the Quality of Service (QoS) problem for multi-group multicast systems is reformulated and the closed-form lower bound of the average signal to interference and noise ratio (SINR) of each user is derived. Conventional semi-definite relaxation (SDR) and Gaussian randomization are employed jointly to solve the original problem. Several simulation results are presented to demonstrate the satisfying performance of the proposed beamforming scheme.

articleTitle: System architecture design for coordinated-control of large-scale distributed equipment in energy universal service bus system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper designs a system architecture for the coordinated-control of large-scale distributed equipment (DE) in energy universal service bus (USB) system based on the consensus coordinated-control algorithm, the JADE-based multi-agent control platform and the grid-connected supporting platform. The interaction mechanism between large-scale DE and distribution network, the coordinated control mechanism of DE containing electric vehicles (EVs), as well as the consensus coordinated-control algorithm are investigated. The JADE-based multi-agent control platform and the grid-connected supporting platform are designed, based on which, the overall system architecture is developed for distributed-optimization analysis and coordinated-control of large-scale DE, making them access to distribution network in a universal interface standard (namely USB). The system can facilitate the production of DE in a grid-connecting operation mode, thus achieving optimal allocation of the renewable energy resources and supporting the development of unified standard interface for plug-and-play of distributed resources, i.e., distributed generation, energy storage, electric vehicles and controllable loads, in future.

articleTitle: Research on interconnection of power scheduling softswitch system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the process of evolving from the traditional circuit-switched network to the soft switch-based scheduling switching network, each pilot region of the State Grid Corporation has a lack of experience in comprehensive scheduling business interoperability between scheduling systems from different manufacturers of soft-switching network or TDM + IP hybrid network. This paper proposes a test scheme to evaluate the interconnection between the dispatching systems of mainstream manufacturers in a laboratory environment. We aim at solving the problem of scheduling business interoperability that existed in the testing process, and providing specific and feasible standards for the interoperability between the scheduling systems of different manufacturers. It is shown that the interoperability issues between scheduling systems are well solved after the manufacturers adopt the standards, providing technical support for accelerating the evolution process of power dispatching network.

articleTitle: Multi-mode images denoising algorithm for further improving the accuracy of oxygen saturation calculation in the retinal oximetry
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Image noise can dramatically affect image processing and hemoglobin oxygen saturation (SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) calculation accuracy in non-invasive retinal oximetry. Recently, the denoising algorithm based on Variance stabilizing transform (VST) and dual domain filter (DDID) has been proposed to address this issue by our lab. Actually, dual-wavelength retinal images belong to multi-mode images, in order to maximize the use of complementary information at the edges of dual-wavelength images and further reduce the calculation error of SO2, we improve the previous algorithm. Firstly, noise parameters were also estimated by mixed Poisson-Gaussian (MPG) noise model. Secondly, a novel MPG denoising algorithm which we called VST+CDDID was proposed based on VST and cross dual domain filter. To evaluate the proposed algorithm, both simulative and real experiments have been carried out and the results show that the proposed method can effectively remove MPG noise and preserve edge details. Compared with VST+DDID, the proposed method shows great advantage in terms of PSNR, SSIM and visual quality. The following simulation and analysis indicate that the images denoised by VST+CDDID can provide more accurate grayscale values than the images denoised by VST+DDID for retinal oximetry.

articleTitle: Hybrid monitor belt: A non-invasive health monitoring system with flexible printed ECG array
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel method of heart-rate calculation basing on the ECG signal acquired from abdomen. The result of the experience demonstrates the practicability of this method. Then a non-invasive and wearable monitor platform is designed and implemented, on which the electronic components are soldered and electrodes sensors are printed on flexible printed circuit boards(FPCBs). The ECG electrodes, FPCBs printed with gold, are distributed on the belt and connected to the core board through a FPC connector. In this paper, 3-lead ECG signals, which are chosen from six electrodes array through analog switches, are high qualified for heart-rate measurement. The core board also contains an accelerometer, which is close to belly and can acquire the data of belly vibrate. This system can calculate the respiratory rate and movement with this acceleration data. This sensor platform can be more sophisticated when the using of BLE SOC hard core board is replaced by integrating the BLE SOC IC on the FPCB.

articleTitle: Research on resource allocation strategy of industrial wireless heterogeneous network based on IEEE 802.11 and IEEE 802.15.4 protocol
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication technology, its flexibility, low cost, easy to deploy features make more and more industrial applications began to deploy industrial wireless network. Industrial wireless networks typically use ISM bands defined by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU-R), which is an open band and therefore we need to consider the resource allocation problem among different wireless network systems. In this paper, we will analyze the resource allocation problem between industrial wireless heterogeneous networks based on IEEE 802.11 and IEEE 802.15.4 protocols in detail, and propose a radio resource allocation system model and a multi-dimensional resource allocation strategy (MRAS) to meet the different business requirements of industry, simultaneously, improve the utilization of wireless network resources.

articleTitle: Analysis of RSRP measurement accuracy in V2X UE autonomous resource selection
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of vehicle to everything (V2X), many technical challenges have emerged, among which, the collision avoidance of user equipment (UE) resource selection stands out. Resource reservation and sensing before transmitting are proposed to be effective enhancements. Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) measurement is adopted in sensing procedure to exclude occupied resources. Theoretically, the physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH) RSRP measurement accuracy affects the selection result of sensing procedure, which further affects the performance of collision avoidance. Thus, in this paper, the accuracy of PSSCH-RSRP is analyzed. The Least-Square (LS) channel estimation algorithm is used in the measurement. Various scenarios are considered in our test, i.e., Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN), Extended Vehicular A model (EVA), Extended Typical Urban model (ETU). The measurement also takes different Signal-Noise Ratio (SNR) and measurement period into consideration.

articleTitle: Study on SAR target recognition performance based on convolution neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Though recent some methods of Synthetic Aperture Radar(SAR) image target recognition based on convolutional neural networks(CNNs) have been improving the recognition accuracy extremely, the procedures and guidance involved in the network design still require further research. Therefore, it is desirable to explore the influence of each element on network for achieving a higher recognition performance. In an effort to find out the role of different types network layers, we adopt the LenNet for the basic model and improved it. Moreover, we modify the network layer with some compare experiment to obtain highest accuracy while preserving its time complexity basically unchanged. Use this way to justify that our network(B3 network) have a outstanding recognition accuracy(99.3%) on the public data set.

articleTitle: A similarity computing method based Levenshtein distance and logic Petri net for renting cloud service processes
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: An appropriate cloud service process can be obtained by applying similarity computation between service request and the existing service processes in renting or recommending cloud service processes. To improve efficiency of the similarity computation, a similarity computing method based on Levenshtein distance and logic Petri net for renting cloud service processes was proposed in this paper. Cloud service processes were first modeled as service nets by logic Petri nets. A method to generate path strings for service nets was put forward by introducing the routing identifiers. Business flows of cloud service processes were then converted into path strings based on reduction and recursion. Similarly, service request was mapped as a request string by the path string generating method. Finally, similarity computation was performed based on Levenshtein distance between path strings and request string. The algorithm for similarity computation was also presented. A case study was finally presented to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: UE's trajectory assisted beam adjustment in 5G mmWave cellular network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The upcoming 5G will be the combination of many technologies, including ultra-dense network (UDN), beamforming, and millimeter wave. Some original network operations, such as how to cover the area, may not be the best choice when these technologies appear together. The normal full-cover method in UDN faces with the interference problem when they are transmitting at full power. In this article, we want to find a way to reduce the interference caused by the dense deployment of eNB. Therefore, we propose a beam adjustment algorithm to assist the core network to cover UE. This algorithm use UE's trajectory information in the next time slot to find the proper beam to attach. The selected beam would adjust its parameters (beam width, orientation and transmitting power) to provide required receiving power to this UE. In this way, the transmitting power increase gradually and do not cause too much interference to the UEs that under other eNB's coverage. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm could improve the UE's SINR and reduce the total power consumption compared to the normal network without beam adjustment.

articleTitle: Distributed massive MIMO performance with channel reciprocity error and pilot contamination
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we restrict on the distributed massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) downlink that incorporates the effect of reciprocity error and pilot contamination. The closed-form expressions of achievable rate with maximum ratio transmission (MRT) beamforming and definitive rate are derived with both matrix normalization (MN) and vector normalization (VN). We show that distributed antenna layout with VN outperforms other counterparts in large transmit antenna regime. As for the reciprocity error, the deviations at base station side result in much severer performance penalty than those at user side. However, there impacts on the definitive rate are both slight. On the other hand, the impact of pilot contamination decreases with increasing level of reciprocity error.

articleTitle: A roaming authentication protocol based on Elliptic Curve Cryptography in IOV
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of Internet of Vehicles, security and privacy issues have become a research hotspot. As the specific application of IOV, roaming service also faces privacy threats such as position sensitive information leakage. In this paper, we propose a framework of roaming authentication protocol based on Elliptic Curve Cryptography system in the scene of roaming scene in IOV. We describe the registration, login, authentication process systematically in order to obtain outside services from hometown to another place. In the security analysis, we use SVO to prove the security of the protocol. Through the comparison of the simulation data with existing protocols, the proposed protocol framework is proved to have a low computational cost.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis system of high voltage switchgear based on cloud computing technology
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a high voltage switchgear fault diagnosis system is designed with cloud computing technology, which is used for distributed storage and distributed processing of large-scale switching device status information data. This paper takes the high voltage switch cabinet as an example, to design a high voltage switchgear fault diagnosis system by cloud computing technology. In this paper, the three sets of characteristic parameters of the switchgear are analyzed, and the working status of the high voltage switchgear is judged. To speed up the fault diagnosis, the Hadoop cloud platform is built. The Hadoop distributed configuration is completed. A probabilistic neural network algorithm based on MapReduce is designed, and parallel processing of diagnostic data is realized in the cluster environment. The operating speed of fault diagnosis system in a stand-alone environment and the cluster environment are compared. The simulation results show that system running time can be reduced by using Hadoop clusters in the case of large data size. As well, the obvious advantage of cloud computing technology in processing large-scale fault diagnosis data is revealed.

Author Keywords: fault diagnosis of high voltage switchgear

articleTitle: Design and development of computer assembly virtual simulation platform based on vocational education
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aimed at the problems that students' opportunity of practical operation in the course of Computer Assembly during vocational education is so few that they cannot master the skill of computer assembly, this paper solved it by establishing computer assembly virtual simulation platform. This paper mainly introduced how to realize the design and production of computer assembly virtual simulation platform through Eon studio and pro/e tools. To carry out experiment teaching by using computer assembly virtual simulation platform is a new development direction because it promotes the revolution of teaching form, teaching method and teaching concept. Meanwhile, it can effectively solve difficulties in teaching and enhance the quality of experiment teaching.

articleTitle: Research on image classification based on HP — Net convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the Caffe deep learning framework and the first convolution layer inversion operation, this paper presents a deep-learning framework, denoted as HP-Net, to achieve image classification problem, The HP-Net network consists of three convolution layers and max-pooling layers followed by three fully connected layers. The first convolution layer adopts the inversion operation to add the transmission of the effective feature information and uses a smaller convolution kernel to extract more texture features. Finally, the softmax classifier is employed to identify image classifications. In this method, we use a very efficient graphics processing unit implementation of the convolution operation to further reduce training time. The HP-Net model demonstrated better performance two real-world datasets than two related state-of-the-art approaches, CaffeNet and AlexNet.

articleTitle: Joint resource allocation for secrecy wireless powered communication networks with an active eavesdropper
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a secrecy wireless powered communication network, where an information source (IS) transmits message to a legitimate information receiver (IR) with the energy it harvests from the energy source (ES) and a full-duplex (FD) active eavesdropper (AE) performs eavesdropping and jamming simultaneously with the energy it harvests from the ES. With a goal to maximize the achievable secrecy rate, we jointly optimize the energy beamforming and the artificial noise (AN) beamforming at the ES, the information beamforming at the IS and the energy transfer time at the ES. Numerical results are given to show the superiority of our proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Analytic study on the poles and zeros for mechanical plants
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: It is well known that controller design is often unavoidable for extreme and zero stability, and that unstable poles (zero) limit the performance of the controller. In this paper, we study the limit zeros and poles of the discrete-time model where the sampling period tends to zero in the case of zero-order hold (ZOH) or generalized sampling-data hold function (GSHF). We first introduce GSHF and give its transfer function. Then we discuss the distribution of zero polarity with discrete time systems using ZOH or GSHF, and give their stability behavior. When the GSHF is used for signal reconstruction, the stability of the limit zero of the discrete-time system can be significantly improved and a discrete-time design with a stable zero in the case of GSHF is given.

articleTitle: The research of multimedia curriculum design and curriculum development in modern distance education
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This In recent years, with the development of modern distance education, the teaching quality of distance education is becoming higher and higher. For distance education, curriculum design and development is the fundamental guarantee of the whole teaching process. There are still plenty of shortcomings in the existing distance education curriculum design. After the analysis, the paper puts forward some suggestions for improvement. Meanwhile, this paper looks forward to the new development of distance education curriculum construction. The emergence of new concepts, such as micro courses and massive open online courses (MOOC), has made up for the lack of distance education curriculum construction largely. And it accelerated the speed of the network curriculum design and development obviously.

articleTitle: A fast SIFT parallel match algorithm combined with pipeline technology on multi-core DSP
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The speed of traditional match phase of Scale invariant feature transformation(SIFT) descants in some cases. For example, the speed descants straightforward when the number of feature points is small. Besides it will lead a lower execution efficiency if it is transplanted to the Digital Signal Processing(DSP) platform immediately. So a fast SIFT parallel matching algorithm combined with pipeline technology on multi-core DSP is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the algorithm divides the image into a 3*3 grid image, then marks each grid. Secondly, the algorithm executes grids quantization parallelly. Finally the algorithm matches grids of the two images parallelly. And this algorithm leverages the parallel architecture, pipeline technology, and mixed scheduling mode of the multi-core DSP. Finally, experiments show that this algorithm can reduce the time consumption under the almost same accuracy rate as traditional method.

articleTitle: Influence of pointing error and detector noise on the bit error rate performance in ground-to-satellite laser uplink communication system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In space optical communications, bit error rate of a system is an important indicator for the communication quality. Here, we propose a combined effect of combined pointing error and detector noise on the bit error rate. Firstly, the probability density function of the received light intensity is presented in the optical communication uplink. Secondly, we obtain the bit error rate expression of a receiver system combined probability density function and detector noise. Finally, based on the system model, the influence of system jitter, transmission power, transmission aperture and boresight on the bit error rate are analyzed. These research works are beneficial for the study of communication performance in satellite-to-ground optical communication uplink.

articleTitle: Inference of protocol state machine using a semantic-related labeling method based on dynamic taint analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A protocol state machine is a description of essential behaviors expressed when protocol messages exchanged between network applications. The inference of protocol state machine (IPSM for short) is a process of learning the inner workings of a protocol. The existing methods are mainly based on the idea of passive monitoring, and the protocol state machine is inferred by constructing an APTA tree and simplifying it. But in the phase of state labeling, they distinguish between different states only according to the similarity of messages, which would result in different states to be treated as the same states, so the states would be merged by mistake, causing the state machine to be over generalization and can't describe the behaviors of protocol accurately. This paper proposes a method to improve the accuracy of the protocol state machine inferred by semantic-related labeling based on dynamic taint analysis technology. We rely on DECAF to analyze the network applications, then construct an APTA tree and use the semantic information to distinguish the states, and the similar states would be merged to get the final results. At last, TCP, and Agobot control protocol are selected to be tested for this method. The results show that the method can overcome the shortcomings of the existing methods, the final results are more accurate.

articleTitle: POF-ICN: An architecture of information-centric networking over Protocol-Oblivious Forwarding
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As two of the mainstream future network architectures, Software-Defined Networking (SDN) has been applied in real network, while Information-Centric Networking (ICN) is still in the experimental stage. Existing research shows that combination of ICN and SDN is feasible but need further research. In this paper, we propose a novel architecture POF-ICN based on the new SDN protocol- Protocol-Oblivious Forwarding (POF). In POF-ICN, control plane takes responsibility for route computation, and forwarding plane is responsible for forwarding data according to protocol-independent flow tables. In our architecture, Named-Object Routing Protocol is proposed based on object's name which consists of the resolvable name and its corresponding global unique identifier (GUID). Besides, we present a caching scheme based on object classification. Experiment results prove that our proposal can combine ICN and SDN effectively, and make better use of the in-network cache to reduce the content acquisition delay.

articleTitle: Model analysis of risk queuing and its application in port bottlenecks management
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the ability of the port logistics system based on the bottleneck node and the ability of the line in the port's supply chain. Firstly, the model construction of the bottleneck system is carried out, and then the flow capacity of the single bottleneck node is analyzed. Finally, the bottleneck optimization method of the whole system is given with instances. In order to make the port's logistics system to achieve the optimal state, it is necessary to make the output of port's logistics system consistent with the needs, so as to prevent the waste of capacity and resources. This paper also points out two ways to optimize the bottleneck system of port's logistics, one is to discover and alleviate the bottleneck, the other is to keep the capacity of bottleneck node flow coordinated. However these methods only play the role on judging, the specific optimization methods still need to research further.

articleTitle: A wideband signal simulator for radar seeker test
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the development of radar seekers, it is essential to build up an infield test system, whose key part is a real-time radar return simulator. At present, digital radio frequency memory (DRFM) structure has been more widely used in the radar return simulator. This paper presents a wideband radar return simulator based on DRFM. This simulator comprises radio frequency (RF) front-end, high speed analog to digital convertor (ADC) and digital to analog convertor (DAC), and large scale field programmable gate array (FPGA). Design aspects are discussed, and detailed system scheme is illustrated. Corresponding test results are given to verify the validity of whole system.

articleTitle: An adaptive channel allocation algorithm for hierarchical wireless network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of information technology those years, big data and cloud computing technology has been widely used. Those new communication scenarios require the network with very powerful computing power and real-time business processing capabilities. But limited by the number of channels that can be used in 802.11b/g, there are a lot of channel interferences in WLAN system. In this paper, firstly we propose a hierarchical WLAN architecture suiting for big data communication environment, which can ensure the transmission of important information and enhance the central control capability of the system. And then we give a channel allocation algorithm RCE for typical and hierarchical WLAN architectures. Especially, the algorithm can make use of all 14 channels by introducing channel interference factors. A large number of experiments show that our channel allocation algorithm has better result in reducing overall system interference and improving channel utilization, and can be applied to different network structures preferably.

articleTitle: Optimizing virtual machines scheduling on high performance network NUMA systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Non-Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) architecture is being widely used in virtualization and cloud computing due to its scalability. In NUMA system, previous works mainly focused on how affinity between processor and memory could be optimized by scheduling. However, we observed that in NUMA system with high-performance virtualized network enable, the network affinity is also an important factor affecting the performance of VM. In this paper, we analyze the affinities among processor, memory and NIC in depth. Based on the analysis, we designed and implemented a VM scheduler, named as vNAASched, in KVM. vNAASched monitors and collects performance events of VMs at runtime and schedules VMs based on the affinities among processor, memory and NIC. Experiment results showed that vNAASched is able to improve performance of real-world Apache Spark workloads by up to 36%.

articleTitle: Node selection based distributed cooperative compressive spectrum sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the existing distributed cooperative spectrum sensing scheme, the nodes that participate in the cooperative operation are predetermined. However, the nodes in the deep fading wireless environment usually corrupt the performance of cooperative sensing. To deal with this problem, we propose a node selection based distributed cooperative compressive spectrum sensing (NS-DCS) algorithm for wideband cognitive radio network (CRN). In this scheme, we first use Bayesian network learning to remove the redundant nodes based on the compressive data collected from the different cognitive radio (CR) users in a fading environment. And then we employ a proposed weighted average consensus-based distributed cooperative compressive spectrum sensing algorithm with the prior parameter exchange (PE-WDS) to identify the occupied spectrum. The simulation results show that our proposed scheme can improve the accuracy of wideband cooperative spectrum sensing.

articleTitle: A parallel-filterbank-based Hammerstein predistorter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A parallel filterbank based Hammerstein predistorter is proposed for improving the compensation performance of the traditional Hammerstein predistorter. A two-stage scheme is used to identify the Hammerstein predistorter, which firstly identify the nonlinear part offline, and then adaptively identify the linear part. Simulation results demonstrate that the performance of the proposed PD is superior to the traditional Hammerstein predistorter, especially for the power amplifier with strong memory effects.

articleTitle: Efficient interference management for device-to-device communication underlaying cellular networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the interference management for device-to-device (D2D) underlaying cellular networks, where the objective is to maximize the total transmission rate while satisfying maximum power constraints and interference limitations. We develop a two-stage procedure to address the formulated problem. At the first stage, we perform subchannel allocation scheme to remove the integer constraints. At the second stage, we propose an efficient power distribution procedure by employing barrier method. The effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed scheme are verified by numerical experiments.

articleTitle: The finite state multiple-access wiretap channel in the presence of delayed feedback
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, the finite state Markov channel (FSMC) with an additional eavesdropper and delayed feedback from the legitimate receiver to the transmitter has been shown to be a useful model for the physical layer security of the practical mobile wireless communication systems. In this paper, we extend this model to a multiple-access situation (up-link of the wireless communication systems), which we call the finite state multiple-access wiretap channel (FS-MAC-WT) with delayed feedback. To be specific, the FS-MAC-WT is a channel with two inputs (transmitters) and two outputs (a legitimate receiver and an eavesdropper). The channel depends on a state which undergoes a Markov process, and the state is entirely known by the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper. The legitimate receiver intends to send his channel output and the perfectly known state back to the transmitters through noiseless feedback channels after some time delay. The main contribution of this paper is to provide inner and outer bounds on the secrecy capacity region of this new model. The capacity results are further explained via a degraded Gaussian fading example, and from this example we see that sending the legitimate receiver's channel output back to the transmitters helps to enhance the security of the FS-MAC-WT with only delayed state feedback.

articleTitle: Analysis of dose rate around molten corium deposited on the seabed after a severe bottom of the ship melt-through nuclear accident
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: After a severe nuclear accident in nuclear powered ship, molten corium may pass through the bottom and enter the sea, which will cause severe marine radioactive consequences. There are few reports about the marine radioactive consequences caused by cooled molten corium deposited on seabed. This paper uses MELCOR code to establish the model to analyze severe nuclear accident induced by the blackout in ship, calculates the amount of radionuclides in the molten corium entered in sea, uses MCNP5 code to calculate the dose rate in sea water around the sedimentary debris. It is found that (1) on surface of debris, dose rate can reach 4.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> mSv/h; (2) sea water has a good shielding effect on radiation, there are almost not affected by radiation at 150 cm away from the debris; (3) Within 100 cm around the debris, the dose rate is too high, the survival of marine biological resources received great threat. This research can provide technical support for emergency response after a severe nuclear accident in nuclear powered ship and the protection of marine ecological environment.

articleTitle: Barcode character defect detection method based on Tesseract-OCR
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, the applications of barcode have become more and more widely, and its quality requirements are also increasing. Due to the poverty typography and printing equipment, and the imperfect printing technology, there are a lot of problems such as flying ink, missing printed, wrong print, black spots and improper registration existing in the process of barcode printing. The traditional way of manually sorting defective barcode is not only inefficient but also easily influenced by many factors, which leads to the low precision of the detection. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a method of barcode defect detection based on Tesseract-OCR, firstly, the method uses the horizontal projection method to segment the barcode, and then it uses the Tesseract-OCR method to recognize the characters in the barcode, lastly, it combines Levenshtein Distance algorithm to detect the character defects. In this paper, 1000 barcode images were used to the experiment, and the experimental results show that the accuracy of detection results can reach 94.3%, which proves the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: A log-linear probabilistic model for prioritizing extract method refactorings
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: 'Extract Method' has been one of the most widely used refactorings, which extracts a piece of code to form a new method. Approaches that automatically recommend Extract Method refactorings have been investigated to facilitate this process. These approaches usually generate candidate Extract Method refactorings, and rank them according to a specific software metric. However, software developers conduct Extract Method refactorings for various reasons. In this paper, we propose an approach that combines method-level software metrics to learns a probabilistic model from real-world refactorings. Experiments compared with two state-of-art approaches have shown the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Extended target tracking algorithm based on improved Bernoulli filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: According to the requirement of high real-time target tracking extended clutter environment, and the problems that need to be addressed between nonlinear and area measurement, this paper proposes a singlarticle filter box. The first single for extended target Bernoulli model is briefly introduced, and then to implement single extended target Bernoulli filter is proposed by using partice extended target Bernoulli filtering algorithm based on ple filter box, extended target pseudo likelihood function and the state is established for the area measurement update equations, finally for extended target measurement determines the number of problems, put forward a kind of extension of interval form based on the measured number estimation method. Simulation results show that the algorithms proposed by our study could lead to significantly lower computational complexity with tiny effect on tracking performance.

articleTitle: A block based encoding approach for improving sliding window network coding in wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The theory of Network Coding (NC) has been studied in recent years and makes significant benefits to the performance of Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) in lossy and/or dynamic wireless networks. However, due to the asynchronous packet transmission between the transport layer and the network coding layer of the protocol stack, sliding window mechanism with a fixed size of coding window may lead to network delay and thus the performance gain of network coding cannot be fully exploited. In this paper, we propose to use an advanced architecture named Encoding Block Manager (EBM) to optimize packet encoding and scheduling process in a parallel manner. Further, a dynamic encoding algorithm is introduced in EBM to adjust the size of encoding block adaptively according to the Round Trip Time (RTT). To demonstrate the performance of EBM, simulation works are implemented with Network Simulation (NS) 2. In comparison with TCP/NC, the results certified the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Set-membership proportionate NSAF algorithm with individual activation factors
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a new set-membership proportionate normalized subband adaptive filter (SM-PNSAF) algorithm, named IAF-SM-PNSAF algorithm, by assigning an individual-activation-factor for each filter coefficient instead of a common one for all filter coefficients as in the standard SM-PNSAF. The proposed IAF-SM-PNSAF algorithm obtains a large improvement in terms of the convergence rate and tracking capability for highly sparse system as compared to the NSAF, PNSAF, SM-PNSAF and SM-IPNSAF algorithms. Simulation results verify the superiority of the proposed IAF-SM-PNSAF algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on development architecture of WeChat platform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the widespread popularity of intelligent terminal devices, WeChat is an important user entrance to mobile Internet era as an instant messaging application. WeChat public platform is an important module of WeChat, and the application of WeChat platform has gradually penetrated into all aspects of people's life. WeChat public platform application development, therefore, there is great demand, in order to reduce the development difficulty and cost of developers, improving the efficiency of development, this article based on the development of WeChat platform architecture research, puts forward a high performance and universal, easy to extend the rapid development of architecture, which is used to help users to better implement WeChat platform application of rapid development.

articleTitle: Real-time user-click recognition based on spark streaming
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of internet, data produced by users tends to be larger. The web page structure is becoming more and more complex and contains more and more different types of embedded objects as well. How to identify the user click requests from a large number of data set, is the first step as well as one of the difficulty of analysis of user behavior. Based on the spark streaming algorithm and some other previous algorithms, this paper proposes a real-time user-click recognition algorithm. The experimental results show that our algorithm is with high accuracy and is suitable for large scale data processing.

articleTitle: The APT detection method in SDN
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: SDN is a new network framework which can be controlled and defined by software programming, and OpenFlow is the communication protocol between SDN controller plane and data plane. With centralized control of SDN, the network is more vulnerable encounter APT than traditional network. After deeply analyzing the process of APT at each stage in SDN, this paper proposes the APT detection method based on HMM, which can fully reflect the relationship between attack behavior and APT stage. Experiment shows that the method is more accurate to detect APT in SDN, and less overhead.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid wolf pack algorithm with harmony search for global numerical optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Though the wolf pack algorithm (WPA) is a new optimal algorithm with good performance in optimation, its convergence is slow. Aiming at speeding up the convergence of the wolf pack algorithm (WPA), a novel hybrid wolf pack algorithm with harmony search (HS) was proposed, which named WPAHS for short. Harmony search is introduced into the process of the wolves updating to substitute the random update. With the help of the employment of harmony memory, pitch adjusting, and randomization mechanisms of HS, the WPAHS not only obtain a faster convergence, but also keeps a feasible adaptability for a wider range of optimation. Six standard benchmark functions are applied to verify the effects of these improvements. It is shown that the performance of WPAHS is superior to, or at least highly competitive with, the standard WPA and other swarm intelligence optimization algorithm, such as GA, HS, PSO, and ABC in most situations.

articleTitle: Extended class-wise sparse representation for face recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sparse representation classification (SRC) performs well in classification problems, especially in face recognition. When it comes to the undersampled and occlusion problem, the performance of SRC, however, decreases rapidly. In this paper, we propose a robust method called extended class-wise sparse representation (ECSR) to tackle the issues. ECSR extends SRC to applications where there are very few training samples per gallery subject. The proposed ECSR constructs a subsidiary intraclass variant dictionary to represent the intraclass variations between the query image and training samples. Moreover, it minimizes the number of selected classes of training samples to seek an optimum representation of the probe image. For the undersampled problem with variable expressions, disguise and illuminations, experimental results on EYB, AR and CMU Multi-PIE show that ECSR has much better generalization ability and higher recognition accuracy than the competing methods.

articleTitle: A new box-counting method for image fractal dimension estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A fractal dimension is an effective feature for texture analysis, segmentation and classification in many fields. The most frequently used method to estimate the fractal dimension of an image is the differential box-counting method. This method is simple but not accurate enough. Many researches have been done to improve its counting accuracy. So far, the counting accuracy along z direction has been improved more effectively than along x and y directions. In this paper, some typical improved methods are summarized and analyzed. And then a new method based on the idea of dilation is proposed, which is simple and understandable, and has the same desired counting accuracy in x, y, and z directions. Simulation results demonstrate our method can outperform other existing methods in estimation accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Driving self-learning system based on the virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the continuous improvement of people's living standards, people's demand for cars has been growing, which also leads to more and more people learn to drive. But there are many problems behind this phenomenon. For example, too long waiting time, low-quality coaches, lack of spare time, high test cost, and low pass rate. The paper mainly proposes a Driving self-learning system based on the virtual reality, which is used to solve the problems on above. This application runs in the form of a Unity executable file on PC and uses the Oculus Rift as a head mounted virtual display and a force feedback steering wheel as the controller. The application is aimed at new drivers who have little or no experience driving a car but can be used by experienced drivers who wish to improve their driving.

articleTitle: Strategy of storing and accessing small web log files on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Hadoop distributed file system(HDFS) was designed to manage large files. For a large number of small files, such as genomic data and web log data, HDFS would suffer from low access and storage efficiency and bring much less benefit. In this paper, we propose an asynchronous merging algorithm based on monitoring the task queue (MTQM) and a prefetching strategy based on Hash index. On the basis of client merging small files, uploading and merging small files can be asynchronous by monitoring the task queue. Meanwhile, small files can be quickly accessed by using prefetching and caching scheme. The experimental results show that the approach proposed in this paper can improve the efficiency of storing and accessing small files and effectively reduce the metadata storage space of NameNode.

articleTitle: User association and remote radio head selection strategy in cloud radio access networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cloud radio access network (C-RAN) is introduced as a promising architecture to meet the ever-increasing mobile data traffic. In this paper, we focus on the minimization of both transport network power consumption and transmission power of remote radio heads (RRHs). First, we develop a user association strategy in order to better utilize wireless resources of the active RRHs. Then, an efficient local search algorithm is developed in order to select a subset of RRHs with the minimum total power consumption while satisfying a series of network constraints. Numerical results indicate that the proposed user association strategy can utilize the wireless resources efficiently and effectively. Moreover, our RRH selection scheme can significantly reduce the total power consumption of C-RANs.

articleTitle: Incentive mechanism design for participatory sensing: Considering task quality and users' effort
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Participatory sensing is the concept of recruiting mobile devices to collect data and engage computing. However, there are many problems in this mode of cooperation, poor quality of received information caused by task executors has been one of them. So incentive mechanism is proposed for attracting users to participate in and submit high-quality data. Inspired by contract theory, we model participatory sensing as a contractual relationship and design rewards for multiple results depending on the quality requirement of tasks which maximize the benefit of task publisher. Under complete information scenario where task executors' efforts can be observed and incomplete information scenario where task executors' efforts cannot be observed, we obtain optional contract for task executors respectively through solving maximization problem. Finally, we evaluate our contract based approach by thorough simulations to show its effectiveness and accuracy and analyze the influence of result, cost and probability on reward from aspects of theory and reality.

articleTitle: An information-theoretic outlier detection method for prescription data
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Medicare has been a particularly vulnerable target for fraud in recent years. Prescription analysis is an effective outlier detection method. For many years, this process has been qualitatively carried out by experts based on their experience, which may lead to subjective judgment. Data mining technology can identify the potential structure and knowledge behind large-scale data, which plays an important role in reorganizing data and helping users find relevant information. we propose an Information-Theoretic Outlier Detection(ITOD) approach which uses global outlier (GO) and local outlier (LO) to measure the distance between prescriptions to cater for the difference between objects, and incorporate them. We test the approach on real prescription data sets and compared to other approaches. The experimental results show that the ITOD is promising for discovering the outliers from the real health care data sets.

articleTitle: A reduced-complexity successive-cancellation decoder of polar codes
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Polar codes are the first provably capacity-achieving family of codes which have recently attracted more and more attention, especially in 5G network. The complexity of successive cancellation (SC) based decoders is O (N log N), where N is the blocklength of the code. Because the frozen bit is known to the transmitter and the receiver, many redundant computation done in the conventional SC algorithm. In this paper, we prune the computation of frozen bits, and as to non-frozen bit, we further utilize the property of butterfly architecture to update the likelihood ratio (LR) messages. Compared with the conventional SC decoder, the proposed method reduces the complexity without any loss of performance and the complexity of memory.

articleTitle: Beamforming optimization for full-duplex MIMO multiuser system with channel estimation error
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We study the beamforming optimization of full-duplex (FD) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) multiuser system, where full-duplex communication (FDC) is enabled at the base station (BS). The system suffers not only from self interference (SI) and co-channel interference (CCI), but also from channel estimation error. We focus on the effect of imperfect channel state information (CSI) owing to nonideal channel estimation which is an inevitable problem in practical communications. To address this issue, a beamforming optimization problem is formulated to maximize the achievable sum rate.
