Since the problem is non-convex, a low complexity iterative algorithm based on gradient projection (GP) is proposed. Numerical simulations demonstrate that with the proposed beamforming optimization, FD system can outperform HD system even under imperfect CSI condition.

articleTitle: An OpenFlow based Dynamic Traffic Scheduling strategy for load balancing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the Software Defined Networking (SDN) based Data Center Networks (DCN), load balancing is one of the research hotspots. This paper proposes a Dynamic Traffic Scheduling (DTS) strategy for load balancing taking the advantages of the SDN central controller. Considering the realtime network status, the paths can be adjusted during the flow transmission. A flow equilibrium degree is defined as the trigger of enabling DTS. The implementation process of DTS are also described in detail. An OpenFlow based SDN simulation platform is constructed. The experimental results indicate that DTS strategy generate better performance compared with other routing strategy without dynamic rerouting mechanism under various load.

articleTitle: Latency constrained trajectory planning in wireless sensor networks with mobile sink
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Data collection is a fundamental task in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). Recent research shows that significant benefits can be achieved for data collection in WSNs by introducing mobile sink (MS). However, the slow movement speed of MS usually incur unbearable latency. The rendezvous-based data collection scheme provides an efficient approach to tackle this problem. In this paper, we propose an rendezvous algorithm based on k-hop domination set to construct the rendezvous nodes (RNs). We first give the problem definition and then we propose an efficient distributed algorithm to construct k-hop domination sets. After that, we apply algorithm of solving Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) to generate the traveling trajectory of MS, along which the MS collects the cached data when it arrives the communication range of RNs. Finally, the effectiveness of our algorithm is validated by performance simulations.

articleTitle: An improved adaptive-step butterfly mating optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of slow convergence for the butterfly mating optimization algorithm (BMO), an adaptive variable step size butterfly mating optimization algorithm (ASBMO), which combines threshold step size control mechanism with vector shift concept, is proposed for the first time. The algorithm adjusts the iteration step by adjusting the displacement of the individual population before and after two successive iterations, and uses the attenuation characteristics of exponential function to limit the range of the step size. From the simulation results and compared with the same type of optimization algorithm, ASBMO has better performance in convergence speed, optimal solution, search efficiency and calculation accuracy. Moreover, the ASBMO is also applied to the design of matching network of a kind of broadband antenna, from the simulation results, the VSWR decreased significantly after antenna matching, indicating that ASBMO in engineering application is also achieved good results.

articleTitle: Design and research of cross-regional large power grid GIS platform architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems such as difficulty in the function expansion and low performance caused by the tight coupling design of the existing large-scale GIS platform, the connection between GIS platform and power grid operation system is studied, the tightly coupled architecture of the existing system is analyzed, and the architecture design of GIS platform of trans - regional high power grid is studied in detail, and a combination of loosely coupled with the business system is proposed, which is unified loosely coupled architecture design model for service architecture, multi-level cache and client rendering technology. Finally, POC verification is carried out for loosely coupled GIS architecture design, which proves the superiority and feasibility of loosely coupled GIS platform architecture in constructing cross - regional large - scale GIS platform.

articleTitle: A hardware supported method of RDMA transmission for unreliable networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As to unreliable networks, like Ethernet, waiting for connection establishment can be inefficient during RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) transmission. Aiming at solving long waiting problem, a hardware supported RDMA method, DRDMA (Dynamic RDMA), was proposed in this paper. DRDMA, providing a new indirect transmission mode and corresponding dynamic switch policy based on traditional RDMA method, allowed starting RDMA transmission at the same time with connection establishment by sending packages first to indirect buffer in RNIC and copying them later to host memory, which was totally transparent to upper layers. Based on Gigabit Ethernet, we built node models of DRDMA method and set up simulation platforms to perform experiments. Experimental results show that for unreliable networks, DRDMA not only can solve the long waiting problem of connection establishment with little extra hardware cost, but also can provide higher transmission performance compared with traditional RDMA method.

articleTitle: Color image steganography scheme based on FLD ensemble classifiers
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to preserve the statistical properties of information hiding when embedding changes are constrained to pixels, a color image steganography method is proposed based on FLD Ensemble classifiers and content-adaptive quadtree algorithm. First, the color cover is divided into several non-overlapping sub-blocks by quad-tree algorithm, and each block is prioritized depending on its texture complexity. Then, we extract the statistical feature of blocks with high priority from three channels respectively. Then, we use such feature as the input of FLD Ensemble classifiers, which are trained by color stego images generated by the current steganography schemes LSBM, WOW and S-UNIWARD. Then, we design the additive distortion function of color images and the pixel distortion is computed by results of the Ensemble classifiers. We use STC embed secret message into R, B, G channels respectively. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme can achieve a competitive performance compared with the other steganography schemes LSBM, WOW and S-UNIWARD when resisting SPAM steganalysis methods for color images effectively.

articleTitle: On the security of a realistic lightweight anonymous authentication protocol for securing real-time application data access in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Most recently, Gope and Hwang (IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, 2016. doi:10.1109/TIE.2016.2585081) proposed a realistic lightweight anonymous authentication protocol for securing real-time application data access in wireless sensor networks(WSNs). They demonstrated that the scheme could resist various attacks. However, in this paper, we find out that Gope and Hwang's scheme suffers from several security flaws, including smart card loss attack, known session-specific temporary information attack, de-synchronization attack, and known transaction sequence number attack. Some possible countermeasures are provided to avoid these design flaws in the future design of lightweight authentication schemes.

articleTitle: Short-term wind speed forecasting in wind farm based on C-C and ELM
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Point at the problem that traditional wind speed forecasting techniques being the slightly larger error, this paper put forward the short-term wind speed forecasting method of wind farm based on embedding dimension extreme learning machine. Using wind speed data gained from a wind farm located in Chongqing and establishes prediction models respectively using 3 different network methods including the BP network, the SVM network and the ELM network for comparing their result to find the best one. Through the graph and performance indicators of predicted results compared with the actual results, found that the predicted effect of ELM is best. This will be conducive to the wind farm itself and the stable operation of power system, improve the limit of penetration power, effectively reduce or avoid deviation, fluctuation and harmonic voltage.

articleTitle: Power load forecasting in the spring festival based on feedforward neural network model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Spring Festival is an important festival for family reunion, when the crowd returns to their hometown together, causing transfer and concentration of the power load. Accurate load forecasting can effectively enhance reliability of power supply in the Spring Festival. In order to solve the problem of load forecasting during the Spring Festival in Sichuan Province, the t-test is used to analyze the change trend of load during the Spring Festival. Then, considering the randomness and non-linear relationship of power load, the predecessor model is used in other fields, the accuracy of the power load during the Spring Festival in Sichuan Province. It is indicated in the result that there are laws for change in load during this period, and that Feedforward Neural Network has good effect on forecasting of load, providing bases for power load dispatch.

articleTitle: Fine-grained opinion mining : An application of online review analysis in the express industry
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Opinion mining of online review can identify the key aspects of consumer focusing, thus can provide the decision basis for business administrators to improve customer services. The paper proposes an opinion mining framework of online review, which uses review sentences as input, and fulfills two kinds of analysis tasks: one is clustering analysis, the other is sentiment classification. For clustering analysis, we adopt VC-Word2vec (Voting Based on Clustering Word2vec) to identify the aspects of online reviews. For Sentiment classification, we extract features of review sentences based on ED-TextRank (TextRank Based on Sentiment Dictionary), and by identifying sentimental words and increasing the weight of them, the accuracy of sentiment classification can be improved. As an application, we fulfill the online review analysis for express industry to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the framework.

articleTitle: Joint energy-efficient relay antenna selection and power adaption for two-way full duplex MIMO relay
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper analyze and optimize the energy-efficiency (EE) performance for two-way full duplex (TWFD) amplify-and forward (AF) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) relay system when residual self-interference (RSI) is considered. For EE maximization, an iterative energy-efficient relay antenna selection (AS) scheme with power adaption is proposed, which jointly select the active transmit and receive antenna subsets at relay node, and find optimal transmission power at each communication node. Specifically, we derive the closed-form iterative equation of EE based on greedy algorithm and select a pair of receive and transmit antenna that achieves the largest increment of EE at each iteration. The optimal transmission power at each node is updated immediately by using the tool of fractional programming under certain selection. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme show significant EE improvement and power consumption degradation with lower complexity than conventional scheme. Furthermore, RSI and the number of relay antenna also show important effect on the EE performance of TWFD AF MIMO relay.

articleTitle: Inpainting of multiple blind motion-blurred images based on multi-scale tight wavelet frame
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Inpainting of degraded images due to motion blurring is one challenging problem in digital image processing. Many techniques on blind motion-blurred images have emerged in the literatures. One promising approach is to restore the clear image by using multiple images captured from the scene. However, the existing inpainting approaches via multiple images use the uniform model to restore the clear image, ignoring the fact that the uniform inpainting model to one type of blurred images does not imply that it is practical to the other type. In this paper, we propose different image inpainting models for different types of multiple blind motion-blurred images via multi-scale tight wavelet frame after roughly classifying the degraded images to texture and piecewise smooth images, and give the experimental results which show that the proposed method can not only improve the quality of different types of motion-blurred images, but remove the motion blurred image noise effectively.

articleTitle: Price-based resource allocation algorithm for energy harvesting massive MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates the price-based resource allocation in the energy harvesting massive multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems. The power beacon (PB) can admit the sensor nodes (SNs) to harvest power from it by pricing their harvested energy. Then, the SNs transmit their data to the base station (BS) with the harvesting energy in massive MIMO systems. The interaction between the PB and the SNs is modeled as a Stackelberg game. The optimal prices, harvesting time and energy for SNs can be obtained by a convex optimization algorithm. In order to reduce the complexity of the convex optimization algorithm, a sub-optimal pricing algorithm with closed-form expression of harvested time for the PB to maximize its revenue is given. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed sub-optimal algorithm.

articleTitle: Low-complexity energy-efficient mode selection and resource management for D2D communications
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Mode selection among direct-idle mode, relay-idle mode and direct-reuse mode and resource management including resource block (RB) assignment and power control are two important research aspects related to the effectiveness of device-to-device (D2D) transmission in cellular networks. To maximize the overall system energy efficiency (EE) while guaranteeing the rate of both D2D and cellular links, this work takes both of them into consideration and develops a low-complexity two-step scheme. In the first step, considering the influence of the number of idle RBs, the mode selection and RB assignment are performed jointly by assuming the maximum transmit power usage. And then, the transmit power of each user is optimized based on the obtained mode selection and RB assignment. Specifically, to accomplish efficient and low-complexity power control, a noncooperative game based scheme is proposed for the users suffering from interference caused by RB reuse. Simulations are done and results show that the system EE can be significantly improved by the proposed low-complexity mode selection and RB assignment algorithm and the power control scheme.

articleTitle: A slope one algorithm based on item activeness and uncertain neighbors
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Slope One algorithm is one of the most widely used algorithms in personalized recommendation systems. It is efficient and easy to maintain, but it doesn't take the item similarity into consideration when it works. For instance, if the item similarity is low, there will be a deviation in the recommendation. So the ratings should be denoised before prediction. This paper analyses the item similarity and the item activeness in the nearest-neighborhood. Based on Slope One algorithm, a new collaborative filtering model which combines the item activeness in uncertain neighbors is presented. Firstly, the neighbors of each item are dynamically selected according to the item similarity and activeness in uncertain k-nearest neighbors matrix. Secondly, the average rating deviation between items is only generated from the selected neighboring items. Lastly, the target ratings are predicted by linear regression model. Experiments on the MovieLens dataset show that the proposed algorithm improves recommendation quality and gets better prediction accuracy than some other collaborative filtering algorithms.

articleTitle: Smoke identification of low-light indoor video based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of low-light indoor fire detection, and forewarn fire timely, a video smoke recognition algorithm based on support vector machine is proposed in this paper. After extracting the smoke target, the area diffusion and the main direction of motion are chosen as the dynamic characteristics for the identification of low-light indoor smoke, the texture features are chosen as the static characteristics for the identification of low-light indoor smoke, after the feature extraction, the support vector machine (SVM) is used to build the classifier to realize the identification of smoke. Finally, the smoke recognition algorithm is tested under different conditions. The experimental results show that the algorithm has high adaptability, high recognition rate and good anti-interference ability, Which provides an effective solution for the fire smoke identification in low-light indoor conditions.

articleTitle: False comment recognition based on the combination of content features and user behavior characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The comments of network goods leads consumer's purchasing behavior to a certain extent. Under the drive of benefit, more and more false comments appear in front of consumers. So it is very important to identify false comments in the network. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a method of false comment recognition based on the combination of comment content features and user behavior features. Firstly, using the Naive Bayesian model to calculate user behavior features which was selected, then the result will be combined with the comment content features, and finally use the model of Support Vector Machine to identify false comments. Experimental results show that the proposed method has higher accuracy and recall rate, and the validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of resource management network of constrained device
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As sensor networks, embedded and wireless communication technology is constantly developing mature, more and more equipment accesses to the Internet of things. However, most of the Internet of Things equipment called constrained device is limited by its power, memory and CPU. These devices are usually small in size, inexpensive, and have low power consumption. In this article, we propose a new architecture named RMN (Resource Management Network) for constrained device based on Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP). The architecture provides a decentralized peer-to-peer resource management overlay network. It defines the constrained device resource model, designs the methods of resource interaction between user and device and build efficient resource management network. By using the model, the system of IoT devices can be optimized effectively.

articleTitle: An effective interference mitigation scheme for downlink NOMA heterogeneous networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) is a promising technique to improve spectral efficiency in the fifth generation (5G) mobile communication networks. However, as multiple users are multiplexed on the same subchannel, the interference becomes more serious in NOMA heterogeneous networks than in OFDMA heterogeneous networks. Eliminating interference is an emergency issue, especially for cell edge users. In this paper, an effective interference mitigation scheme is proposed to improve spectrum efficiency for the downlink NOMA heterogeneous networks, which takes advantage of both coordinated multipoint (CoMP) transmission and load balance, including coordinated beamforming (BF) and joint transmission (JT). In order to reduce inter cell interference, beamforming matrix is designed according to maximum signal to leakage noise ratio criterion. Joint transmission is adopted to convert intra cell interference into signal. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can improve spectrum efficiency obviously.

articleTitle: Phase errors compensation algorithm of inverse synthetic aperture ladar based on CS-Fmea
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the vibration and initial phase errors, the azimuth defocusing of the inverse synthetic aperture ladar is seriously affected and the imaging quality is poor. A phase compensation algorithm based on Circular Shifting-Fast Minimum Entropy Algorithm(CS-FMEA) is proposed. Firstly, based on the imaging geometry model of inverse synthetic aperture lidar (ISAL), the influence of phase error on the signal is analyzed, and the expression of phase error is given; Secondly, the phase compensation effect of the fast minimum entropy algorithm is analyzed. The problem of incomplete phase compensation is caused by the residual rotation phase of the algorithm. A method of circular shifting and windowing is proposed to eliminate the influence of rotation on the gate of the distance gate, and the concrete implementation steps of the algorithm are given. Finally, by comparing the simulation results, three indexes of image entropy, contrast and operation efficiency are used to prove that the algorithm can significantly improve the phase error compensation performance.

articleTitle: A multi-scale temporal model for multi-view radar high-resolution range profile recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the radar automatic target recognition (RATR) community, high-resolution range profile (HRRP) obtained from the target has been widely utilized for many recognition techniques. The information provided by one single HRRP is limited and unstable, utilizing multiple HRRPs for recognition is a better choice. However, common method such as the hidden Markov model (HMM) is not good at modeling high dimensional data and can only capture local dependencies. In this paper, a multi-scale temporal model is developed from the conditional restricted Boltzmann machine (CRBM). The proposed model can efficiently discover stochastic patterns in high dimensional data just as RBMs generally do. Besides that, it can capture multiple scales of temporal dependencies, which is especially beneficial when the angular sampling rate at testing phase is different from that at training phase. Experimental results on the Moving and Stationary Target Acquisition and Recognition (MSTAR) database validate the efficiency and robustness of the proposed method under various conditions.

articleTitle: RNASIM: A simulation tool for transcriptome sequencing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: DNA sequencing technology has played an important role on life sciences, especially Illumina's sequencer. It was used for more and more transcriptome projects. In this paper, we developed a tool named as RNASIM, which can simulate solexa transcriptome sequencing based on the reference sequences. The tool RNASIM can actually simulate random gene expression and insert size of library with normal distribution in solexa pair-end sequencing. In order to validate the tool, three times of experiments were simulated based on the reference Arabidopsis thaliana's transcripts and produced total reads' length of 1Gb, 2Gb and 4Gb. Simulated reads were assembled and compared with original reference sequences. There were respectively 19,704, 20,376 and 20,692 transcripts aligned to one assembled contig. And there were only 1,071(3.2%), 849(2.5%) and 778(2.3%) original transcripts were not found related contigs in three assembled transcripts. Others were assembled multiple copy because of alternative splicing or gene duplication.

articleTitle: Channel iterative optimization algorithm based on algebraic solution in MIMO relay system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, in the one-way two-hop multiple-input and multiple-output relay system, channel estimation algorithms based on tensor model were mainly used by alternating least squares (ALS) and khatri-rao Factorization (KRF) algorithm. ALS algorithm has high computational complexity and slow convergence. KRF algorithm is an algebraic solution based on no-iterative form and has low computational complexity, but its estimation performance is not optimal in the least squares sense. In this paper, a compromise channel iterative optimization algorithm (IOA) is proposed. In the algorithm, cost function is constructed and a regularization method is used to derive an update that minimizes the residual tensor. Initial value of the algorithm uses the estimation result of KRF algorithm, so only a small number of iterations is needed to be convergence. Therefore, compared with ALS algorithm, the proposed algorithm has lower complexity, and the simulation results show that the algorithm has almost the same performance as the ALS algorithm.

articleTitle: A Matlab toolbox for modelling viscoelastic constitutive equation and parameter optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A matlab toolbox for modelling viscoelastic constitutive equation has been implemented. It can be used to analysis the rheology properties of various viscoelastic constitutive equations by solving a time dependent PDE. The toolbox also provides support to calculate the optimized parameter of parameters to give a fine approximation with experiment data. We carefully designed the framework to make sure its extensibility and efficiency. Matlab parallel technology has been add to make the toolbox more computational efficient. The tool box does well on the rheology analysis of Rolie-Poly model and parameter optimization. This toolbox is significant to the study of viscoelastic models and provide a template for relative research areas.

articleTitle: Interference-aware clustering algorithm based on virtual-cell grouping with the optimal size in UDNs
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates the viable user-centric interference-aware clustering scheme in ultra dense network (UDN), by which the BSs resource is utilized rationally. Taking both of the capacity and resource availability into account, the proposed scheme is implemented by capitalizing on initial virtual cell with optimal size, and is designed into two steps. For the first step, determining the optimal virtual cell size for each user adaptively with the objective of maximizing the normalized goodput. For the second step, the clustering problem is reformulated by introducing the relative interference indicator between initial virtual cells, and the problem can be solved by an optimization algorithm with the grouping threshold constraint. Simulation results show that with the grouping threshold selected appropriately, the interference-aware clustering scheme improves average ergodic rate and normalized goodput that user received efficiently and fairly. A trade-off between capacity and resource availability can be achieved.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of reliable parallel transmission in heterogeneous networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Parallel transmission enabled by the stream control transport protocol (SCTP) could improve the performance of heterogeneous networks. However, the performance may be deteriorated by disordering caused by asymmetric paths and the limited size of receiver buffer would degrade the performance further. In this paper, to figure out how the parameters of asymmetric paths and receiver buffer size affect the performance of reliable transmission, we carry out the simulations on NS-2. Simulation results show that in most cases concurrent multipath transmission (CMT) based on CMT-SCTP could increase throughput compared with single path transmission. But it performs worse than bandwidth aggregation without loss assumed in most data distribution and resource allocation schemes.

articleTitle: A new affine invariant descriptor for shape recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Shape is considered to be one of the most promising tools to represent and recognize an object. In this paper, an effective and rigorous shape descriptor is developed for shape recognition under affine transformations. To reflect the gray information of the shape, two extended centroids with different orders are adopted to form the vector which is treated as the x-axis to establish a new positively oriented orthonormal frame. Then, the descriptor representing the distribution of all points within the shape region along the y-axis is captured to achieve shape recognition. In addition to its stable affine invariance and robustness to noise, the descriptor has low computational complexity. The proposed descriptor has been implemented on a famous database and gives encouraging results while it is compared to other two state-of-the-art algorithms including GC and EC-ARC.

articleTitle: Power control based caching incentive mechanism for base-station assisted device-to-device networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In D2D communication, user data is transmitted directly between terminals without network or Base Station (BS) transferring, which can reduce the burden on the BS, has a great prospect in improving the system performance. Compared with the traditional Pear-to-Pear (P2P) in 4G, the major advantage of D2D is introducing the power control mechanisms. So in this paper, we introduce a Stackelberg game based caching incentive strategy to promote D2D communication, at the same time, control the transmission power to reduce interference. The simulation results show that our proposed caching incentive strategy can minimize the total cost through promoting the D2D communication.

articleTitle: A method of detection weak moving target based on linear canonical ambiguity function
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As a new time-frequency transformation, linear canonical ambiguity function (AFL) which combined the inherent peculiarities of the linear canonical transform (LCT) with the ambiguity function (AF) can estimate the signal with cubic phase effectively. In this paper, a new method based on the time delay cancellation of the AFL to detect the weak moving target with cubic phase in sea clutter is proposed. The theoretical analysis and simulations show the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Keyword sequence extraction based on byte entropy iterative segmentation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the problem of mixed unknown message classification, variable field in message causes difficulty in keyword sequence extraction and message analysis. In this paper, we propose a message classification and keyword sequence extraction method based on byte entropy iterative segmentation (BEIS). In BEIS, firstly, we divide the messages into coarse clusters and extract the first keyword from each cluster. Secondly, we find the rest keywords in an iterative way. For each turn of a keyword extraction, we define links (two adjacent bytes) to find the keyword's offset in messages according to the frequency of links, and estimate the length of the keyword via byte entropy trend, the rest part excluding the extracted keyword being the object for next iterative extraction. Experimental results show that compared with relative existing algorithms, BEIS is more accurate and stable.

articleTitle: Research on access network MAC protocol based on polling control mechanism in Triple play
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: HINOC1.0 (High performance Network over Coax) standard has matured and HINOC2.0 standard is being researched about access networks HiNOC MAC protocol in Triple play. Polling control mechanism has been abroadly implicated in the field of access network. This paper uses Markov Chain and probability generating function as analytical method and proposes a new HM_QoS model based on parallel scheduling two-level priority polling control mechanism. Priority control field HM_QoS was added to the original frame header and differentiates traffics. Combining with polling orders and access policies including Gated and Exhaustive access policies the priority-based scheme was realized. Then the system characteristics including mean queue length, cycle time and system throughput were analyzed and simulated. At the same time, Theoretical calculations and simulation values are identical and show that a new HM_QoS model differentiates priorities efficiently and compared with original MAC protocol (OP) it has a better performance.

articleTitle: A reconstruction framework based on mixed sparse representations for compressive sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The theory of compressive sensing (CS) has been proposed for almost a decade, and massive experiments show that compressive sensing has favorable performance in signal processing. Assuming that a signal can be represented or approximated by only a few suitably chosen terms in a frame expansion, CS allows to recover this signal from much fewer samples than the Shannon-Nyquist theory requires. In general, a natural image can be regard as a combination of subimage of smooth, edges, and point-like components, respectively. Since each domain transformation method is capable of representing only a particular kind of ground object or texture, a group of domain transformations are used to sparsely represent each subimage. In this paper, a novel framework based on mixed sparse representations (MSRs) is proposed for solving the problem of CS image reconstruction. The split Bregman iteration is utilized in our framework for better performance both in terms of reconstruction quality and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: A new schedule algorithm for LTE signal processing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Scheduling applications on multi-processor is an effective core technology in using distributed systems. Task scheduling is to map applications to parallel system in order to minimize the makespan. Task scheduling is classified into static scheduling and dynamic scheduling. Most task scheduling is NP-complete problem. The authors come up with a new scheduling algorithm: Chunking Splicing Algorithm for a special type of DAG like the processing of PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) in LTE. When mapping that special type of DAG (like signal processing of PDSCH), its performance is quite good comparing with traditional list scheduling algorithms: HLFET, ISH, ETF, DLS algorithm. Also the authors use some random DAGs to test the performance of our new algorithm.

articleTitle: A time-threshold-based priority hopping scheme for vertical handoff in cellular/WLAN interworking
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel Time-threshold-based Priority Hopping Scheme (TPHS) for vertical handoff in WLAN-embedded cellular networks. In order to further improve the Upward Vertical Handoff (UVH) call dropping probabilities and newly blocking probability of cellular calls, proposed scheme designs a newly priority hopping scheme by adjusting priority of prioritized UVH calls in different circumstances and revising Downward Vertical Handoff (DVH) decision algorithm of cellular ongoing voice calls to modify the Time-threshold-based Upward Priority Scheme (TUPS). Simulation results show that the proposed scheme remarkably improves the UVH call dropping probabilities and newly cellular call blocking probability at the cost of slight sacrificing quality of service (QoS) of insensitive voice calls in cellular zone while ensuring high cellular bandwidth utilization compared with TUPS. The proposed scheme can offer preferable QoS than TUPS in WLAN-embedded cellular networks.

articleTitle: Discovery of online learning collaboration group based on two-stage clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Many studies have confirmed that the role of online learning collaboration group is very important. For large-scale online learning, how to effectively find the learning collaboration group is a difficult problem. The online learning forum is the main place for learners to learn and communicate, so it is the main venue for learning collaboration groups to implement collaborative learning. In the implementation process of learning collaboration, there are two characteristics between learning team members. First, there is interaction between them. Second, the contents of their discussion have high relevance. In this paper, the study uses these two important characteristics and carries out two-stage clustering algorithm based on the interaction structure and interactive contents of learners to find the potential learning collaboration groups in the large-scale online learning forum. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper is effective. This has practical significance for large-scale online learning support services.

articleTitle: Multivariate-based evaluation methods for system performance
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: It is hot research topic to evaluate the equipment performance quickly and accurately. The performance of complex product with high reliability and long-life is indicated frequently by more than single feature variable. And it is possible that multiple degradation modes coexist due to diverse number of performance degradation modes and their correlations. Considering the effects of the different degradation processes on the system performance and the dependences between the multivariate, the system performance status can be described accurately, which then will improve the safety and maintenance efficiency of the system and reduce its life cycle cost. Based on the State-of-the-art at home and abroad, this paper presents two kinds of performance evaluation methods, one is based on leading variables and the other is hybrid variables. Especially the typical methods and several performance degradation models used in the above two evaluation processes are introduced, in order to provide academic and engineering reference for the related research.

articleTitle: Group decoding for the uplink small packet multiple access
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Massive transmission of small data packets cause heavy signaling overhead to the current communication system, the small packet multiple access (SPMA) proposed by Xie and Yin is an attractive scheme to address this problem. Unfortunately, the scheme faces the challenge of large processing latency and high computation cost introduced by a great number of iterations. In this paper, we apply the group decoding method to small packet recovery. This method is highly depended on the stage of user detection, and the detected group size at each iteration is theoretically studied. A proper group detection strategy is finally given by considering both the iteration number and demodulation accuracy. Simulation results show that the group decoding method can greatly reduce the iteration number and the decoding time, it can also produce a better demodulation accuracy in certain conditions.

articleTitle: Exploring parallelism for automatic and scattered investing on P2P lending platform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The features of P2P lending are wide coverage, low threshold, relative simple procedure, easy to satisfy the borrowers' requirement. In order to spread credit risk for lenders, automatic and scattered investing become more and more popular nowadays. In this paper, we take advantage of the computing power of modern GPUs to accelerate scattered investing in large-scale lender scenarios. By abstracting the scattered investing as map-reduce operation, we extend two stages map-reduce to four stages according to our scattered investing business and exploit a novel parallel investing system based on GPUs. Experimental results show that we achieve a maximum speedup of 27.52 times.

articleTitle: An evaluation method for targets with surface defects
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposed a method based on vector cancellation to evaluate the scattering of surface defect. This method regards the carrier as a part of target background and subtracts it from the total vector field, which eliminates the influence of carrier scattering. RCS got from calculation and measurement showed that the scattering of the carrier had been greatly reduced and the accuracy of the defective target is effectively improved. This method solved the problem of the conventional evaluation method which suffering the influence of carrier for defect target. With this method, except the measurement accuracy improvement, the model cost can be significantly reduced because a very low scattering carrier is no more needed.

articleTitle: Optimization and design of the efficiency for W-band extended interaction oscillator
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the one-dimensional electron model, Under the interaction of gap field and space charge field, the nonlinear equation of Interaction between beams and microwaves in the extended interaction oscillator is obtained, and the W-band extended interaction oscillator as an example, so we analyze the influence of period number, the action current, the modulation coefficient, the distance of gap-gap and initial phase on the electronic conversion efficiency. The results shows that, with the increase in the number of gaps, the increase of modulation coefficient and the increase of action current, the conversion efficiency of electron disk is increased greatly and a maximum value appears. With the increase of modulation coefficient, the number of gaps corresponding to the maximum is reduced. Final optimization is obtained that under the conditions of working voltage 19kV, current 3A, number of gaps 9, modulation coefficient 0.20, the maximum efficiency is 13.7%.

articleTitle: A Bayesian-ANP-based expert group decision-making method to evaluate the location of military port
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Location of military port problem is a complex system engineering with the characteristics of general engineering site selection, but also a combination of military elements. To consider the correlation between evaluation indicators existing in the location of military port, as well as the strong subjectivity in the evaluation process, this study uses Analytic Network Process(ANP) to establish the evaluation model, then adopts expert group decision-making method and Bayesian fusion theory to optimize the system construction of ANP. Combined with case analysis and calculated by SUPER-DECISION software, the model is proved to be feasible.

articleTitle: Comparison of denoising methods in fault diagnosis with Gabor order tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on simulations of denoising of Gabor coefficient spectrum with Gaussian dual windows, threshold filter denoising and morphological Filter denoising methods have been implemented. With conventional Gabor order tracking algorithm, Gaussian window applied as analysis window and synthesis window, a trail-and-error threshold filter denoising method reconstructed original signal without noise, the choose of value of threshold filter is a waste of time. However, morphological Filter denoising is put forward as a alternative vision solutions, flood fill algorithm looks for all nodes in the array that are connected to the start node by a path of the target color and keep this area unchanged. Mask operation sets unselected region to zero, simulations indicate that should be rapid and effective.

articleTitle: Moving OS fingerprint adaptively in SDN network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Fingerprinting attack is a major threat to enterprise networks since it enables adversaries to easily figure out the operating system of target hosts. Due to the fact that OS fingerprint is a key indicator of a majority of vulnerabilities, it is critical to obfuscate the fingerprint. However, it is a challenge to achieve this goal with end-host transparency, lossless network functionality, and acceptable performance penalty. We propose a novel scheme named MOFA(Moving OS Fingerprint Adaptively), which makes full use of the packets monitoring and controlling capability of SDN switches to provide a convenient moving target defense service for fingerprint attacks. MOFA dynamically shifts various attack surface of fingerprinting with strategies determined by the possibility of undergoing fingerprint attacks. The result of experiments indicates that MOFA is capable of disrupting the fingerprinting attack with little burdens on network performance.

articleTitle: Recovery methods for 1-bit compressed sensing based on Hamming distance
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Hamming distance denotes the amount of the positions' difference between two bit strings. In the 1-bit compressed sensing (CS) technology, the Hamming distance between the measurement vector and the certain column of the measurement matrix can be calculated. We show the relationship between this Hamming distance and the corresponding entry of the signal. By exploiting this relationship, this paper proposes a recovery algorithm for 1-bit CS. Furthermore, we extend the algorithm to the joint sparse model, where multiple correlated signals are considered. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithms enjoy better performance when compared with the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of integrated bridge maneuver simulator based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of low integration of operating equipment, weak reality and backwardness of the data transmission interface in existing integrated bridge system simulator, a design scheme of bridge simulator based on ARM was proposed, it took microprocessor LPC1768 as core control unit, using its rich I/O resources to control equipment centrally with peripheral drive circuit. USB20D as a bridge chip was selected to achieve the data channel between host computer and microprocessor for high-speed data exchange; C language based KEIL MDK and VS2010 development platform was used to complete the firmware and application software design. The final completed bridge simulator has been already used in the Ningbo Maritime Bureau.

articleTitle: A viscoelastic flow solver for Rolie-Poly model based on OpenFOAM
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The understanding of flow instability of viscoelastic fluid is very important but far from sufficient. By combining the constitutive equation with Navier-Stoke governing equation, we implement a viscoelastic solver based on OpenFOAM for Rolie-Poly model, which is a single-mode constitutive model derived from the tube-based molecular theory. We numerically investigate two-dimensional viscoelastic flow around a circular cylinder with this solver. A second order parallelized finite volume method (FVM) is employed in the simulation in both spatial and the temporal domain. The numerical results illustrate the significant effects of the polymer elasticity on the flow structure. The vortex shedding and recirculation region exist behind the cylinder under low Reynolds numbers due to the elastic effect. Both drag reduction and enhancement have been observed in the simulation. Results are consistent with other literature. And the solver shows good parallel efficiency and scalability.

articleTitle: Improved GPS system performance estimation algorithm based on Gaussian sum filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Considering the traditional Kalman filter is unable to meet the requirement of GPS system performance estimation, the GPS performance estimation algorithm based on Gaussian sum filter is proposed. The algorithm is to superpose multiple Gaussian distributions, that is estimating the state of each Gaussian distribution and then to approximately estimate the global state distribution in the form of cumulative sum. The experimental result shows that the algorithm proposed herein has reduced the estimation error of GPS system performance and achieved high computing accuracy.

articleTitle: The study and analysis of enterprise quality credit report based on DEA fuzzy synthetic evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Issuing quality credit report by enterprise is an important approach of quality credit management work to the society in public. By put forward DEA fuzzy synthetic evaluation method, DEA fuzzy evaluation method had been introduced in the evaluation of enterprise quality credit report and a new system comprehensive evaluation model method had been constructed. Though specific application, this method had been verified to the scientific analysis of the content and quality of report. Therefore, the objectivity of the multievaluation of report had been improved, which provide effective method to objective and scientific analysis of report.

articleTitle: STS-MME algorithm for spectrum detection
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Spectrum sensing is one of the key technologies in cognitive radio, and there are many methods for spectrum detection. The method based on eigenvalue detection does not need to understand the primary user signal or the noise power level. Most of the proposed methods require multiple receiving antennas or too many samples. In this paper, an efficient method of (primary user) PU signal detection based on eigenvalue is proposed. This method uses temporal smoothing and space smoothing technique to form a virtual multi group multi antenna structure, and then takes the mean of the covariance matrix to obtain the maximum and minimum eigenvalues for detecting the PU signal. The method is superior to other algorithms. First, it uses the power method to calculate the maximum and minimum eigenvalues, which reduces the computational complexity. Second, the use of a single antenna instead of multi-antenna can reduce system overhead. The most important thing is that the algorithm can effectively reduce the number of sample, improving the system real-time. The simulation results show that the system has good detection performance with small sample.

articleTitle: Combination of bias-compensated normalized LMS algorithm for system identification with noisy input
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to improve the performance of the bias-compensated normalized least mean square (BCNLMS) algorithm by the convex combination scheme. Although the BCNLMS algorithm performs effective performance under input noisy case, but it still suffers from the contradiction between the steady-state accuracy and the convergence speed. To address this problem, we introduce the convex combination scheme into the BCNLMS to improve the performance by exploiting advantages of parallel BCNLMS algorithm with different parameters. Our simulations in different scenarios show the efficiency of the proposed convex combination of the BCNLMS algorithm that can outperforms the original NLMS and BCNLMS.

articleTitle: A highly-linearized ring amplifier with gain offset calibration
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a high-accuracy and highly-linearized self-biased ring amplifier for switched capacitor analog and RF circuits with offset cancellation and common-mode stabilization. The proposed ring amplifier alleviates the accuracy problems of the conventional ring amplifiers by cancelling the offset caused by the charge sharing due to the difference between the auto-zero voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">AZ</sub>) and the common-mode voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CM</sub>) while maintaining the benefits of low power, fast slew-based charging and rail-to-tail output swing. Moreover, the proposed architecture also introduces a signal-detection solution to balance the resetting speed and total power consumption for RF design. A prototype ring amplifier was designed and simulated in a 40-nm CMOS technology with a standard 1.1 V supply voltage. The simulated SFDR of the ring amplifier is 84.46dB (100MS/s), 74.12dB (200MS/s) and 61.4dB (300MS/s), respectively, with a total power consumption of 164 μW and a gain error within 1%.

articleTitle: Optimal transmission strategy in fading broadcasting channels with energy harvesting switching transmitters
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, the data transmission problem is considered with energy harvesting switching transmitters in the fading broadcasting channels. Firstly, the data transmission problem is formulated as the problem of throughput maximization in a given interval. The directional water-filling algorithm is used to obtain transmission rate under a new variation by combining the fading coefficients and noise power. Then, the data transmission problem is studied in an epoch. The optimal transmission strategy with the transmitters-switching method is also investigated in this paper. This strategy can improve the flexibility and robustness of the communication system and reduce the communication interrupt caused by transmitter malfunction or energy failure. Finally, the transmission strategy is verified by computer simulations.

articleTitle: A simple scheme for distributed deployment of controllers of SDN
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the overall performance of the software defined network, a simple deployment scheme is proposed for the controller deployment problem. Firstly, the number of controllers needed in the network is analyzed, and then the NMFRS algorithm is used to select the deployment location of the controller. Finally, the existing SOA service framework is used to realize the distributed collaboration among controllers. The experimental results show that NMFRS reduces the hops from switches to the controller, and at the same time, the existing SOA service framework can realize the distributed cooperation of controllers easily.

articleTitle: Multi-person tracking by discriminative affinity model and hierarchical association
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Occlusion is probably the most challenging part of multi-person tracking. In this paper, we exploit a new discriminative affinity model which combines deep convolution appearance features, random walk motion model, and object shape to robustly handle occlusion during a long period of time. Moreover, We propose a hierarchical association framework based on the observation that association increase the uncertainty when the object is occluded over time, and decompose a data association problem into several sub-problems. Our approach runs online from a single camera and does not require extra calibration information. Experiments on public Multiple Object Tracking 2016 benchmark datasets show distinct performance improvement compared to state-of-the-art online and batch multi-person tracking methods.

articleTitle: How app update affects app download in iOS appstore
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Mobile stores (appstores) are emerging digital distribution platforms with explosive growth, in which the mobile applications (apps) are directly published by the app developers and downloaded by the end users. Appstores attract a lot attention of academia, there are increasingly studies on many aspects of appstores, especially update or release strategy of apps. In this paper, we measured a third-party appstore and introduced a metric, named “Pulling Rate” to quantify the effect of update events on downloads through case study. The results showed that in the first ten days after update, downloads will increase about three times about average downloads. However, after about 45 days after update event, the effect of update event on downloads will exists no more. These results are useful for app developers to help with determining their release strategies.

articleTitle: A sentiment analysis method of Chinese specialized field short commentary
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of media technology, text sentiment analysis has become one of the focuses in recent years. How to solve the classification issue which is under the circumstance of lacking sentiment lexicons and labeled samples needs further study. In this paper, we choose Chinese finance news commentary as research corpus and propose a text model based on the word popularity by mining the time feature of text. Then, we use clustering methods to expand sentiment lexicon and complete classification by the method of supervised machine learning approach. The experimental results show that this method has high accuracy and good pertinence of specialized news commentary.

articleTitle: Target trajectory prediction based on optimized neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a target trajectory prediction method based on optimized Neural Network. First, to make the trajectory prediction independent on the moving model of the target, we use Back Propagation (BP) Neural Network which has the complex nonlinear mapping ability and large-scale parallel distribution processing ability to analyze and predict target trajectory. Then, in view of the defects of Back Propagation Neural Network, such as slow convergence speed, easily to be trapped in local minimum and processing results will produce large error when the data has big fluctuation, an improved method is put forward. Simulation results show that the proposed model has obvious advantages in nonlinear fitting, convergence speed and prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A VLC and IMU integration indoor positioning algorithm with weighted unscented Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, an indoor positioning algorithm based on visible light communication (VLC), combined with inertial measurement unit (IMU) is proposed to achieve the target of high-precision positioning in the indoor environment. A linearization method is proposed to estimate the quaternion errors and velocity errors with adaptive Kalman filtering (AKF). Then, the tilt angle is adopted in VLC received signal strength indicator (RSSI) propagation model to reduce the positioning errors, which is provided by IMU data. Furthermore, an indoor positioning algorithm based on VLC and IMU integration using weighted unscented Kalman filter (WUKF) is developed to obtain the final positioning solutions. Simulation results show that the proposed VLC and IMU integration algorithm can reduce the positioning solution errors to less than 0.23 m.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent vehicle for distribution system based on speech recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The paper presents a method of designing an intelligent vehicle for distribution system. The voice order of a human being operator can be recognized and transformed into digital information by iFlytek Input, which is installed on the Android smartphones as a mobile app. Moreover, based on the Bluetooth wireless communication technology, the digital information about voice order can be transmitted to the intelligent vehicle which is mainly made up of the Single Chip Microcomputer(SCM) MSP430F169. Finally, the SCM will deal with the received information and acquire the key content to control Direct Current (DC) driving device, which can actuate the DC motor to accomplish all kinds of basic distribution assignments.

articleTitle: Coverage hole detection algorithm without location information in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a simple and accurate coverage hole detection algorithm without location information for wireless sensor networks. The coverage hole detection algorithm consists of two components, named boundary edge detection and boundary cycle detection. In the first component, we use a graph to model the wireless sensor network, and each edge in the graph is checked to determine whether it is a boundary edge or not. In the second component, the boundary cycles of all coverage holes are discovered to localize each coverage hole. By comparing with a location based algorithm, it is shown that our proposed algorithm can accurately detect over 99% coverage holes.

articleTitle: Design of reverse-DCSK for chaos based communication system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a reverse differential chaos shift keying (RE-DCSK) system is proposed for reliable and high data rate non-coherent chaotic communication with low cost. RE-DCSK sends reference signals in the first time slots as in the conventional DCSK, and makes an improved design in the second time slot, where the time reverse unit strengthens the autocorrelation of chaotic signal and the sum of two orthogonal signals serves as information bearing signal. Without any extra cost of complexity, the proposed system allows double transmission rate and improves communication security as well in comparison with DCSK. To verify the effectiveness, the theoretical bit error rate (BER) expression is analyzed over Rayleigh fading channel and additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel. The BER performance of the proposed system outperforms that of DCSK and correlation delay shift keying (CDSK) systems over AWGN channel.

articleTitle: Medical image compression with thresholding denoising using discrete cosine-based discrete orthogonal stockwell transform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Discrete Cosine-based Discrete Orthogonal Stockwell Transform (DCST) provides a time-frequency representation method of signal, and has broad application prospects in image processing. Based on DCST transform, we propose a method for medical image compression while improving the image quality. Main steps of the method are as follows: the image is transformed into coefficients in DCST domain; and then these coefficients are handled using soft thresholding technique. Finally, Huffman coding is used to compress the image in DCST domain. Experimental results show that the method can substantially promote the compression ratio and time efficiency under the premise of increasing the signal-to-noise ratio. So the new method is feasible and practicable for medical image compression with noise reduction.

articleTitle: On the load imbalance problem of I/O forwarding layer in HPC systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As the computing capability of top HPC systems increases towards exascale, the I/O traffic from tremendous amount of compute nodes have stretched underlying storage system to its limit. I/O forwarding was proposed to address such problem by reducing the number of clients of storage system to a much smaller number of I/O nodes. In this paper, we study the load imbalance problem of I/O forwarding layer, and find that the bursty I/O traffic of HPC applications and the commonly existing rank 0 I/O pattern make the load on I/O nodes highly unbalanced. The application performance is limited if some of the I/O nodes become hot spots while others have little workload to manage. We propose to apportion the heavy I/O workloads of a single I/O node to multiple idle I/O nodes to alleviate the load imbalance. We implement our ideas on an open-sourced I/O forwarding software IOFSL. The preliminary results indicate that our approach can accelerate I/O performance greatly.

articleTitle: DTA: Double LSTM with temporal-wise attention network for action recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new architecture for human action recognition by using a convolution neural networks (CNN) and two Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM) networks with temporal-wise attention model. We call this network the Double LSTM with Temporal-wise Attention network (DTA). The features extracted by our model are both spatially and temporally. The attention model can learn which parts in which frames in a video are relevant to the video label and pay more attention on them. We designed a joint optimization layer (JOL) to jointly process two kinds of feature produced by two LSTMs. The proposed networks achieved improved performance on three widely used datasets — the UCF Sports dataset, the UCF11 dataset and the HMDB51 dataset.

articleTitle: A real time vehicle collision detecting and reporting system based on Internet of Things technology
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Hundreds and thousands of vehicle are involved in severe traffic accident every year world-wide. The place where accidents are more likely to happen include someplace where has few inhabitants or no camera surveillance such as highway and Country trail. In this situation, it will impede rescuing process when driver is comatose by a severe collision accident. Vehicle Collision Sensor Systems are a valid device for increasing drivers safety by informing the police of precise location of the accident automatically through telephone after accidents. In this work, we present a collision reporting system based on TCP/IP protocol. The system is composed of three parts, vehicle collision sensor terminal worked on car cigarette lighter, application used on smartphones and remote server based on LabVIEW software. At the end of the paper, remote control and alarm tests are carried out. A detailed evaluation of the proposed system and collision reporting demonstrates the suitability as Vehicle Collision Reporting System for human drivers.

articleTitle: Grating lobes suppression for ultra-wideband MIMO radar imaging
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Though high range and azimuth resolutions can be achieved through back projection imaging for ultra-wideband multi-input multi-output (MIMO) radar, significant grating lobes are also observed that deteriorate the imaging performance. Since the existing coherence factor approaches may also reduce the magnitude of extended targets when suppressing the grating lobes, a novel correction, named as power spectrum coherence factors (PSCF) approach is proposed in this work. The real data experiment of a MIMO through-the-wall imaging radar shows that PSCF correction can preserve higher magnitude for extended targets than traditional approaches while suppressing grating lobes effectively.

articleTitle: An improved caching scheme for nonuniform demands and its optimal allocation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In content delivery networks, as more contents are being generated and the size of contents is increasing, caching has been identified as a solution to cope with congestion in communication links. The idea is to prepopulate users' cache with parts of files in off-peak time to ease the peak-time delivery traffic. In this paper, we consider nonuniform demands, where different files have different probability of being requested. We consider networks with a server connected to multiple users through a shared link. The goal is to design cache placement schemes that minimize the transmission rate from the server during peak-time content delivery. In this paper, we analytically prove that a caching scheme proposed by Zhang et al., which they showed to achieve within a constant multiplicative and additive gap from the optimal rate, is indeed optimal when there are only two users.

articleTitle: High-speed FPGA-GPU processing for 3D-OCT imaging
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Three dimensional (3D) imaging using optical coherence tomography (OCT) is equipped with a field-programmable gate array and graphics processing unit (FPGA-GPU) acquisition and processing architecture, thereby making it highly advantageous in the domain of parallel computing. To realize the full benefit of the data acquisition and processing capabilities, it is preferable to increase the number of high-speed processing modules capable of running the complicated image processing algorithms at comparable speeds. In this paper, we propose the design of a real-time image acquisition and pre-processing FPGA via LabVIEW (National Instruments (NI)) with GPU-based acceleration that is capable of sustaining the rate of data acquisition. When using the NI LabVIEW FPGA to develop high-speed processing, FPGA cores are modeled as reusable code modules and comprise subVIs, which are commonly implemented in the LabVIEW environment. The OCT pre-processing was implemented and performed via subVIs in LabVIEW FPGA. Additionally, we utilized GPU-based acceleration, which employs the use of a general purpose GPU (GP-GPU) together with a CPU, to accelerate the operation at hand. Finally, we implemented the LabVIEW FPGA core to perform data acquisition and image pre-processing in the frame grabber. Results showed that, by applying GPU acceleration to the tomographic inspection of biological samples, SD-OCT imaging in excess of 40 frames/s (FPS) for the NVIDIA M6000 GPU-accelerated SD-OCT with frame size 4096 (axial) × 512 (lateral) becomes feasible, and more than 512 × 512 × 500 volumes can be reconstructed with a speed increase of at least 7x that of a non-GPU.

articleTitle: Access selection considering mobile edge computing in ultra dense network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays, wireless communications are entering the 5G era, in which Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) and Ultra Dense Network (UDN) architecture are the two core technologies. In UDN architecture, deploying MEC servers at both macro eNodeB and small eNodeB can effectively reduce delay and energy consumption, and improve the user's Quality of Experience (QoE). However, the access selection is challenging due to the dense allocation of small eNodeBs. In this paper, we propose a user access selection algorithm considering MEC in UDN. A QoE-aware cost function related to energy consumption and service delay is adopted as the performance metric. The energy consumption is calculated as the uplink transmission power of User Equipment (UE), and the service delay is counted as the sum of the transmission delay from UE to the MEC server and the processing delay of user services at the MEC server. This method is compared with the traditional optimal channel quality access method. Numerical results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the delay and energy consumption, and thus, improve the QoE of users.

articleTitle: Time series prediction using graph model
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A time series prediction model is proposed based on combination of the long-short time memory neural network model and the Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN). Our contribution includes (1) An optimal estimation theorem is proposed and proved. We can get the optimal prediction estimation based on the proposed estimation theorem. (2) Based on the theorem, the recursion-based graph model is used to enhance prediction performance through probability inference. A new graph model called LSTM-DBN generated from a combination of LSTM prediction and DBN is developed to predict series data. The simulation results show that the model is premising.

articleTitle: Joint energy-aware and buffer-assisted relay selection method for relay-aided D2D communications
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Device-device (D2D) communications is an effective technique to improve performance on overall throughput and energy efficiency in cellular network. However, owing to the long separation distance or poor link quality between the source and destination user device (UD), the advantages of D2D communications are limited by only using direct D2D communications. For improving the system performance of cellular network, relay-aided D2D communications was put forward as a complement for direct D2D communications. The purpose of this article is to devise a relay selection method that improves the D2D communications performance. In this paper, we propose an Energy-Aware and Buffer-Assisted (EABA) relay selection method that take account of several conditions jointly, including transmission rate, relay-available UD (RUD) residual energy, and RUD buffer state. At each time slot, according to the channel state, energy, and buffer size, a scheduling rule is calculated dynamically by the EABA relay selection method. And then, which of the links activated to transmit packet is specified by the scheduling rule. Numerical examples are presented to show the performance of the EABA method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a LTE-WiFi aggregation system based on SDR
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With explosive growth of the mobile Internet access and the popularization of Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) Access Points (APs), wireless fidelity (WiFi) offloading is considered as an important supplementary technique to reduce the load of cellular infrastructure and enhance quality of network service. In this paper, we design and implement the framework of LTE-WiFi aggregation (LWA) which is in line with the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) released standard recently. In the LWA system, the process of data offloading is different from that of WiFi interworking on the cellular core network. WLAN APs directly connect to eNodeBs (eNBs), and the offloading is realized in Packet Data Convergence Protocol layer (PDCP). Thus, this architecture makes full use of existed WLAN APs to improve the performance of indoor cellular network. Besides, benefiting from the flow control between LTE and WiFi, eNB schedule can be more flexible and efficient. Next, it is implemented based on open source OpenAirInterface (OAI) Software Defined Radio (SDR) platform, where a simple and practical reordering method is proposed and carried out. Experimental results demonstrate that our design works stably with the WiFi-offloading and reordering functions.

articleTitle: Combining brain-computer interface with virtual reality: Review and prospect
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper illustrates the architecture and principles of brain-computer interface and virtual reality (BCI-VR) system respectively, and how they are interrelated. In this brand-new hybrid system, BCI uses bio-signal to serve as input and VR displays the result and serves as output. Current research and applications are mainly focus on the new input and output characteristics of BCI-VR respectively in terms of different effects, purposes and functions.
