Second, for the small group phenomenon, we divided the cluster subgroup with four different methods. Results indicated that the 3-cores degree-based method can best reflect the core structure of the online community. Third, we simplified the online community to form a better yet simplified network. Finally, we compared online community with four typical network structures, and found that its structure has higher cohesion and vitality.

articleTitle: Signal distribution optimization for cabin visible light communications by using weighted search bat algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With increasing demand for travelling, high-quality network service is important to people in vehicle cabins. Visible light communication (VLC) system is more appropriate than wireless local area network considering the security, communication speed, and narrow shape of the cabin. However, VLC exhibits technical limitations, such as uneven distribution of optical signals. In this regard, we propose a novel weight search bat algorithm (WSBA) to calculate a set of optimal power adjustment factors to reduce fluctuation in signal distributions. Simulation results show that the fairness of signal distribution in the cabin optimized by WSBA is better than that of the non-optimized signal distribution. Moreover, the coverage rate of WSBA is higher than that of genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization.

articleTitle: A cooperative spectrum sensing algorithm based on Bayesian Compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Compressed sensing (CS) has been applicably used in cognitive radio (CR) to sense wide-band spectrum, solving the wide-band sensing rate restriction problem. For a CR network which includes multiple nodes, it's considered that the received signals is high correlated. So in this paper, we focus on efficient compressed spectrum sensing reconstructions in CR network, proposing a probabilistic model called Cooperative Bayesian Compressed Spectrum Sensing (C-BCSS) algorithm. In the algorithm, node samples locally and a common sparse signal model is developed to the received signals where correlation exists. And then C-BCSS reconstruction is performed cooperatively at fusion center utilizing the information from all nodes. We compared C-BCSS with Multitask BCS and simulation results show that C-BCSS outperforms in condition of severe under-sampling and heavy noise.

articleTitle: A modified uni-vector-hydrophone ESPRIT algorithm for multisource joint DOA-frequency estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper introduces a modified estimation of signal parameters via rotational invariance techniques (ESPRIT) algorithm for multisource joint direction of arrival (DOA) and frequency estimation using a single vector hydrophone. Based on TLS-ESPRIT, the proposed algorithm may jointly estimate the two-dimensional DOAs and frequencies up to four uncorrelated narrow-band sources under most circumstances, and can pairs all of the parameters automatically. Compared with the previous ESPRIT-based algorithms, the proposed algorithm adopts modified formulas for computing the directional cosines, making it possible to estimate the omnidirectional azimuths and elevations. Monte Carlo simulation results indicate that the proposed algorithm performances better than other methods.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of marine environment monitoring application based on Android platform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the further exploring to the ocean, the pace of development to the ocean has been accelerating. The marine environmental monitoring system can provide support for real-time query, forecasting, optimization management, statistical analysis and decision for marine environmental data. It lays a solid foundation for marine planning and management toward informatization, networking and intelligence. In this paper, we have finished some data collection and analysis for the development of marine fish farming, which dividing into environmental testing, environmental forecasting and environmental warning these three sections. We use the Android AChartEngine to draw a histogram, line graphs and so on, from which the changes of data could be observed more convenient.

articleTitle: An improved approach of blind source separation for delayed sources using taylor series expansion
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes blind source separation (BSS) method to retrieve the signals of wireless communication environment (WCE) mainly based on the statistic properties of the wireless channel model. First, a statistical model for three-dimensional (3-D) spatial domain channel and its analytical expression of the probability density functions (PDF) of the time of arrival (TOA) is introduced. Then, BSS method based on second-order blind identification (SOBI) is proposed to address the separation problem of delayed sources based on the statistical channel model. The improved approach is much efficient in terms of separation quality, especially when the noise is considered. The performance of this proposed method is validated through simulations, which are performed under different delay time and signal to noise ratio (SNR) conditions. The results show that this new approach not only provides a good performance when the delay is large, but also is robust in the noise environment.

articleTitle: Spectrum allocation for cognitive multi-homing networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cognitive heterogeneous networks is an important scenario for 5G. Additionally, multi-homing technology can aggregate different network spectrum resource to improve the quality of service for secondary Mobile Terminals (MTs). In this paper, a spectrum allocation problem with multi-homing technology is studied for cognitive heterogeneous networks. The spectrum allocation is subject to constraints in the required transmission rate for heterogeneous constant bit rate and variable bit rate services. The spectrum allocation among secondary MTs is solved by a convex optimization theory. To obtain the optimal spectrum allocation, a spectrum allocation algorithm is proposed via the dual decomposition method. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm improves the quality of service for secondary MTs significantly.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised entity relation extraction based on trigger word
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Relation extraction is one of the most important tasks in the process of information extraction. This paper studies a semi-supervised entity relation extraction method, most of the existing semi-supervised relation extraction methods are based on the bootstrapping algorithm, the obvious drawback of this method is that it is prone to semantic drift, resulting in the lower recall rate. In order to solve this problem, this paper based on the traditional method of trigger words extraction, presents an advanced trigger words extraction method (ATW), it is more flexible and accurate, effectively alleviates the problem of semantic drift. The experimental result show that the method has a good performance, precision, recall rate and F value have been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Architecture and implementation of Shape Adaptive Discrete Wavelet Transform for remote sensing image onboard compression
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Shape Adaptive Discrete Wavelet Transform (SA-DWT) is an important part of the onboard compression for remote sensing image with cloud region. This paper designs and implements a fast, memory efficient multi-level two-dimensional SA-DWT architecture. The stage-based boundary extension strategy is used to extend the boundary locally in every lifting stage, which is the most important difference contrasting to the general DWT. Through changing the pixel scanning order by the interlaced read scan algorithm, the amount of memory needed between the row and column transform is significantly reduced. Finally, our proposed architecture is implemented by using the Xilinx XC5VFX130T FPGA. The experimental results show that the proposed architecture has high performance and advantages in terms of processing speed and resource consumption, and satisfies the requirement of the onboard compression for remote sensing image.

articleTitle: Per-flow end-to-end delay bounds in heterogeneous wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the influence of network topology on the delay analysis in a large scale wireless Ad hoc network. The packet transmission delay is an important target in the network design, which is always used to evaluate the network QoS performance. Different from previous works focused on the analysis of average delay, we address the stochastic end-to-end delay based on a stochastic network calculus approach. Due to the heterogeneity of network topology, we exploit percolation theorem to divide the topology into a grid with number of squares. According to the tessellation, a novel routing policy is proposed. Based on the routing policy, we deduce the stochastic service curves. Under the framework of stochastic network calculus, per-flow end-to-end stochastic delay bounds are derived. The derivation provides some guidelines for packet delivering and network design in a heterogeneous wireless network.

articleTitle: Current model and Doppler effect based time synchronization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Clock synchronization technology is the fundamental problem of wireless sensor networks and a necessary condition for underwater sensor network nodes to collaboratively work. Transmission fading of radio in underwater environment is extremely large, so it often uses acoustic to transmit data in underwater wireless sensor networks. Due to high latency caused by low sound speed in the underwater acoustic environment, it is difficult to apply mature radio time synchronization algorithms to underwater environments. In recent years, several time synchronization algorithms for underwater sensor networks have been developed. However, most of these algorithms require large energy for data exchange and for complex linear regression calculations. When taking the mobile platform as the time reference node, the time synchronization between nodes will lead to the problem of bidirectional delay inequality. In order to solve these problems, we design a low consumption time synchronization algorithm based on ocean current model and Doppler effect for UWSNs. It can estimate the propagation delay by detecting the received acoustic frequency variation to achieve time synchronization correction. MATLAB simulations show that, compared with existing clock synchronization protocols, our algorithm not only degrades energy consumption, but also behaves high precision.

articleTitle: Optimized indoor lighting system to save energy through window blinds management
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A significant portion of energy is used in a building for the indoor lighting system. Energy consumption issue of the indoor lighting system is increasing day by day which is analyzed through the systematic point of view as well as optimization scheme. Most of the building energy consumption is due to lighting system consumption, which consumes almost 30 to 40% of whole building energy consumption. The existing lighting system is typically operated independently, which performance is not optimized. To maximize the energy efficiency, an optimized control system has been proposed. In this paper, blinds are controlled automatically for full utilization of daylight to reduce the building lighting energy consumption and more comfortable. A proposed system can reduce the running system energy cost by optimizing the window blind management system by linking with daylight. The improved genetic scheme is used to reduce the building light energy consumption and the result shows that the building lighting energy cost can be reduced 25 to 32% depending on the environmental effect.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of flow-based programmable nodes in software-defined sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a Software-Defined Sensor Network (SDSN) is proposed by applying Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and OpenFlow protocol into the Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). We firstly investigate the main system architecture of SDSN, which includes the application plane, the control plane, and the data plane. Then, we design and implement the programmable nodes, which could achieve various functions, such as topology discovery, sensor data acquisition and processing. Additionally, to realize the efficient forwarding among sensor nodes according to specific rules, we utilize the flow table with the detailed definition of the match field, action field, next hop field and Time To Live (TTL) field for each entry. Based on the design of data plane in SDSN, a physically-implemented SDSN platform can be provided. The results of experiment conducted on this platform reveal that the data plane based on flow table forwarding has lower packet loss rate.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of power transformer using feature selection techniques and KNN
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Effective and correct fault diagnosis of power transformer is essential prerequisite for reliable power delivery. This paper presents a novel approach for power transformer incipient fault diagnosis based on feature selection techniques and K nearest neighbor algorithm. ReliefF, Laplacian Score and Fisher Score are employed to rank and select the most discriminative feature from 22 different features. 268 DGA samples are used to establish fault diagnosis model with the selected features. Fault diagnosis performance is evaluated with 5-fold cross validation methods. Fault diagnosis accuracy of the proposed methods achieves 72.5%. Results and comparisons against other conventional methods show relative superiority of feature selection based DGA interpretation approach in term of fault diagnosis accuracy.
